function xoaPhong(P) { PHONG.delete(P.id); for (const x of P.tv) if (PHONG_TK.get(x.tk) === P.id) PHONG_TK.delete(x.tk); }
// tk ra khá»i áº£i (tá»­ vong, háº¿t áº£i, rá»i bÃ£i quÃ¡ vangGiay): khÃ´ng nháº­n thÆ°á»Ÿng ná»¯a; háº¿t ngÆ°á»i thÃ¬ bá» phÃ²ng
function roiPhong(P, tk) {
  if (!P.trong.delete(tk)) return;

  if (!P.trong.size) xoaPhong(P);
}
// chá»§ bÃ£i: Ä‘á»™i trÆ°á»Ÿng náº¿u Ä‘ang á»Ÿ bÃ£i áº£i (kÃªnh tá»©c thá»i má»Ÿ) vÃ  tab khÃ´ng áº©n; khÃ´ng thÃ¬ ngÆ°á»i káº¿ theo thá»© tá»± Ä‘á»™i cÃ²n trong áº£i (tab hiá»‡n trÆ°á»›c)
function chonChu(P) {

  if (moi !== P.chu) { P.chu = moi; P.doi = true; }
}

function quaiChetP(P, m) {

  const v = P.vt.get(m.uid), x = v ? v[0] : m.x, y = v ? v[1] : m.y, L0 = CF.leBao, T0 = CF.thuoc;
  for (const tk of P.trong) {
    const mon = [];
    if (m.boss && L0 && Math.random() < L0.roi) mon.push({ k: L0.k, n: 1 });
    if (T0 && Math.random() < T0.tiLe) { const [a, b] = Array.isArray(T0.n) ? T0.n : [T0.n, T0.n]; mon.push({ k: T0.k, n: a + Math.floor(Math.random() * (b - a + 1)) }); }
    if (mon.length) choThuong(tk, { mon, z: P.bai, x, y });
  }
  const d = capCua(P.cap).dot[P.dot - 1];
  if (d.ds.every((g, i) => (P.giet[i] | 0) >= g.n)) xongDotP(P);
}
// háº¿t Ä‘Ã¡m: má»—i ngÆ°á»i cÃ²n trong áº£i nháº­n kinh nghiá»‡m cá»§a Ä‘Ã¡m (Ã— Ä‘á»™i trÆ°á»Ÿng Ã— cao cáº¥p); sang Ä‘Ã¡m sau sau nghi giÃ¢y; háº¿t 28 Ä‘Ã¡m: kinh nghiá»‡m theo phÃºt

  const xu = CF.xuSo | 0, trungXu = xu > 0 && Math.random() < Math.max(0, (+CF.xuDoi || 0) * (P.tv.length - 1));
  for (const tk of P.trong) {
    const ld = P.tv[0].tk === tk, cuoi = T > 0 ? Math.round(T * (ld ? CF.doiTruong : 1)) : 0; // anh 17/11: qua áº£i cuá»‘i thÆ°á»Ÿng thÃªm (10 triá»‡u Ã— há»‡ sá»‘)
    choThuong(tk, { kn: Math.round(e * heSoTv(P, tk)) + cuoi, ket: P.ket, phong: P.id, rx: CF.ruongXanh | 0, ...(cuoi ? { tinVa: [cauThuong(P.dot, tong, cuoi, nVao, ld)] } : {}), ...(ev.length ? { ev: ev.map((x) => ({ ...x })) } : {}), ...(trungXu ? { xu } : {}) });

// sÃ¡t thÆ°Æ¡ng cá»§a tÃ i khoáº£n tk (kÃªnh tá»©c thá»i "vad" / nhá»‹p b.vad): { s: sá»‘ tin, d: [[uid, sÃ¡t thÆ°Æ¡ng]], st: [[uid, choÃ¡ng ms, cháº­m ms]] }. Chá»‰
// tÃ­nh khi ngÆ°á»i Ä‘Ã³ cÃ²n trong áº£i, Ä‘á»©ng á»Ÿ bÃ£i áº£i, Ä‘Ã¡m Ä‘Ã£ ra; tá»•ng má»—i ngÆ°á»i theo háº¡n má»©c stGiay. Tráº¡ng thÃ¡i choÃ¡ng / cháº­m chuyá»ƒn cho mÃ¡y khÃ¡c
const QT_ = (tk) => { try { return require("./bao-mat.js").qtMo(tk); } catch { return false; } }; // quáº£n trá»‹ Ä‘Ã£ má»Ÿ khÃ³a an toÃ n: bá» háº¡n má»©c sÃ¡t thÆ°Æ¡ng / giÃ¢y (anh 18/11 â€” "Má»™t Ä‘Ã²n cháº¿t" cá»§a cÃ´ng cá»¥ thá»­)
function danhP(tk, tin) {
  const P = PHONG.get(PHONG_TK.get(tk)); if (!P || !tin || typeof tin !== "object") return;
  const s = Math.floor(+tin.s || 0); if (s > (P.ack.get(tk) || 0)) { P.ack.set(tk, s); P.doi = true; }
  const t = Date.now(), p = TG().dangChoi(tk);
  if (P.ket || !P.trong.has(tk) || t < P.sinh || !p || p.zone !== P.bai) return;
  const H = P.han.get(tk) || { han: CF.stGiay * 3, luc: t }, so = tvSo(P, tk);
  H.han = Math.min(CF.stGiay * 3, H.han + ((t - H.luc) / 1000) * CF.stGiay); H.luc = t; P.han.set(tk, H);
  if (QT_(tk)) H.han = Infinity;
  for (const r of Array.isArray(tin.d) ? tin.d.slice(0, 120) : []) {
    const m = Array.isArray(r) && P.q.get(r[0] | 0), v = Math.floor(+r[1] || 0);
    if (!m || m.mau <= 0 || !(v > 0)) continue;
    const nhan = Math.min(v, H.han, m.mau); if (!(nhan > 0)) continue;
    H.han -= nhan; m.mau -= nhan; P.dan.set(m.uid, so); P.doi = true;
    if (m.mau <= 0) quaiChetP(P, m);
  }
  const st = (Array.isArray(tin.st) ? tin.st.slice(0, 60) : []).filter((r) => Array.isArray(r) && P.q.has(r[0] | 0))
    .map((r) => [r[0] | 0, Math.max(0, Math.min(30000, r[1] | 0)), Math.max(0, Math.min(30000, r[2] | 0))]);
  if (st.length) guiKhac(P, tk, { t: "vat", st });
}

// dragon_join + COT_TeamMemberJoin: Ä‘á»§ Ä‘iá»u kiá»‡n -> ná»™p phÃ­, vÃ o áº£i Ä‘Ã¡m 1 (cÃ³ tá»• Ä‘á»™i 2 ngÆ°á»i trá»Ÿ lÃªn: vaoDoi)
function vao(h, tk) {
  const r = mo(h, tk); if (!r.say || !r.say.opts.some((o) => o[1] === "vaoAi")) return r;
  const T = doiCua(tk && tk.ten);

// ra áº£i: xong / háº¿t giá» (timer_close) / tá»­ vong (player_death) -> vá» Ba LÄƒng chá»— Nhiáº¿p ThÃ­ Tráº§n. CÃ²n giá» mÃ  chÆ°a xong thÃ¬ khÃ´ng ra Ä‘Æ°á»£c
// (client: chá»‰ ra khi háº¿t áº£i, háº¿t giá», tá»­ vong). Tá»• Ä‘á»™i: ra khá»i phÃ²ng (khÃ´ng nháº­n thÆ°á»Ÿng ná»¯a)
function ra(h, chet) {
  const S = tt(h), D = dangCua(h), ve = { z: VA.ve.z, at: VA.ve.at };
  if (!D) return { di: ve };
  const tin = [];
  if (chet) tin.push("KhÃ´ng may táº¡i tráº­n tá»­ vong!");
  else if (!D.ket && conGiay(D) > 0) return { talk: ["Nhiá»‡m vá»¥ chÆ°a káº¿t thÃºc â€” háº¡ háº¿t 28 Ä‘Ã¡m quÃ¡i hoáº·c chá» háº¿t giá»."] };
  else if (!D.ket || D.ket.thua) tin.push("Thá»i gian lÃ m nhiá»‡m vá»¥ Ä‘Ã£ káº¿t thÃºc, khiÃªu chiáº¿n tháº¥t báº¡i.");
  if (D.P) roiPhong(D.P, D.tk);
  delete S.dang;
  return { tin, di: chet ? { ...ve, hoiSinh: 1 } : ve };
}

// ---------- dÃ¹ng á»Ÿ do.js gietQuai (loáº¡i 4) ----------
// háº¡ quÃ¡i máº«u id cáº¥p L á»Ÿ bÃ£i áº£i Z: Ä‘Ãºng nhÃ³m cÃ²n thiáº¿u cá»§a Ä‘Ã¡m Ä‘ang Ä‘Ã¡nh (trong giá» + treGiay) -> Ä‘áº¿m; háº¿t Ä‘Ã¡m -> thÆ°á»Ÿng Ä‘Ã¡m, sang Ä‘Ã¡m sau;
// háº¿t 28 Ä‘Ã¡m -> thÆ°á»Ÿng xong áº£i. Tráº£ { kn, mon: [{ k, n }] (rÆ¡i á»Ÿ chá»— con nÃ y), tin, loa } | null (khÃ´ng nháº­n). Tá»• Ä‘á»™i: quÃ¡i cháº¿t á»Ÿ mÃ¡y chá»§
// (danhP) â€” bÃ¡o giáº¿t loáº¡i 4 khÃ´ng nháº­n
function nhanGiet(h, Z, id, L) {
  const S = h.vuotAi, D = S && S.dang;
  if (!VA || !D || D.ket || D.phong || !Z || Z.kind !== "áº£i" || Z.cap !== D.cap) return null;
  if (Date.now() < D.bd || Date.now() - D.bd > (VA.han + CF.treGiay) * 1000) return null;
  const B = capCua(D.cap), d = B && B.dot[D.dot - 1]; if (!d) return null;
  const gi = d.ds.findIndex((g, i) => (D.giet[i] | 0) < g.n && g.lv === L && (g.tpl ? g.tpl === id : g.tieuBoss.some(([a, b]) => id >= a && id <= b)));
  if (gi < 0) return null;
  D.giet[gi] = (D.giet[gi] | 0) + 1;
  const r = { kn: 0, mon: [], tin: [], loa: [] }, L0 = CF.leBao, T0 = CF.thuoc;
  if (d.ds[gi].boss && L0 && Math.random() < L0.roi) r.mon.push({ k: L0.k, n: 1 }); // háº¡ boss: há»™p lá»… váº­t vÆ°á»£t áº£i
  // má»—i con: NgÅ© Hoa Ngá»c Lá»™ HoÃ n tiáº¿p táº¿ â€” anh 28/10 láº§n 7: n = [Ã­t, nhiá»u] -> ngáº«u nhiÃªn 1â€“3 bÃ¬nh
  if (T0 && Math.random() < T0.tiLe) { const [a, b] = Array.isArray(T0.n) ? T0.n : [T0.n, T0.n]; r.mon.push({ k: T0.k, n: a + Math.floor(Math.random() * (b - a + 1)) }); }
  if (!d.ds.every((g, i) => (D.giet[i] | 0) >= g.n)) return r;
  r.kn += Math.round(d.kn * heSo(D)); // sá»‘ mÃ³n rÆ¡i cá»§a Ä‘Ã¡m (d.roi â€” trang bá»‹ client) bá»: anh 28/10 khÃ´ng rÆ¡i trang bá»‹ tráº¯ng / xanh
  r.bhDam = D.dot; // bang há»™i Ä‘á»£t 2: Ä‘Ã¡m vá»«a xong -> do.js gietQuai cá»™ng cá»‘ng hiáº¿n (BH.cong "vuotAi")
  r.tin.push(`Äá»™i ngÅ© Ä‘Ã£ tiÃªu diá»‡t toÃ n bá»™ ${D.dot} Ä‘Ã¡m quÃ¡i!`);
  // anh 17/11: thÆ°á»Ÿng thÃªm má»—i áº£i nhÆ° tá»• Ä‘á»™i (Ä‘i 1 mÃ¬nh = Ä‘á»™i trÆ°á»Ÿng, 1 ngÆ°á»i â€” chá»‰ khi toiThieu cho phÃ©p)
  const T1 = Math.round(thuongAi(D.cap, D.dot, B.dot.length, 1) * CF.doiTruong);
  if (T1 > 0) { r.kn += T1; r.tin.push(cauThuong(D.dot, B.dot.length, T1, 1, true)); }
  if (D.dot < B.dot.length) { D.dot++; D.giet = []; return r; }
  // Mission_Complete: kinh nghiá»‡m theo phÃºt Ä‘Ã£ dÃ¹ng
  const giay = Math.floor((Date.now() - D.bd) / 1000), phut = Math.floor(giay / 60), X = B.xong;
  const e = (phut >= X.m ? X.c : Math.floor(X.a * (1 - phut / X.m)) + X.b) * 1000;
  r.kn += Math.round(e * heSo(D));
  D.ket = { xong: 1, giay };
  const rx = DO.choRuongXanh(h, CF.ruongXanh | 0);
  if (rx) r.tin.push(`ThÆ°á»Ÿng hoÃ n thÃ nh áº£i: ${rx}`);
  const ev = bdMon("vuotAi"); if (ev.length) r.tin.push(bdGiao(h, ev)); // anh 16/11 â€” BÃ¡o ÄÃ¡p Ã‚n SÆ°: mÃ³n sá»± kiá»‡n xong áº£i (Ä‘i 1 mÃ¬nh)
  r.loa.push(`${MT.ten(h.name)}: Ä‘á»™i ngÅ© Ä‘Ã£ tháº¯ng lá»£i hoÃ n thÃ nh nhiá»‡m vá»¥ ThÃ¡ch thá»©c thá»i gian ${tenBac(D.cap)}, Ä‘Ã£ dÃ¹ng ${phut} phÃºt ${giay % 60} giÃ¢y!`);

// nhá»‹p (z = bÃ£i Ä‘ang Ä‘á»©ng â€” trong lÃºc Ä‘á»•i báº£n Ä‘á»“ trÃ¬nh duyá»‡t bÃ¡o bÃ£i Ä‘ang tá»›i): rá»i áº£i báº±ng Ä‘Æ°á»ng khÃ¡c (thoÃ¡t game, Ä‘á»•i bÃ£i) quÃ¡ 45 giÃ¢y
// sau lÃºc vÃ o -> bá» áº£i (phÃ­ Ä‘Ã£ ná»™p khÃ´ng tráº£ â€” nhÆ° client SetLogoutRV / kickout). 45 giÃ¢y (báº£n Ä‘áº§u 20): táº£i báº£n Ä‘á»“ qua Ä‘Æ°á»ng háº§m cháº­m khÃ´ng bá»‹
// coi lÃ  rá»i áº£i (anh 28/10 "trÃ¡nh lá»—i dáº«n Ä‘áº¿n khÃ´ng Ä‘á»“ng bá»™ game"). Tráº£ true náº¿u Ä‘á»•i
function nhip(h, z) {
  const S = h.vuotAi, D = S && S.dang; if (!D || z == null || Date.now() - (D.luc || 0) < 45000) return false;
  const B = capCua(D.cap);
  if (B && z === B.bai) return false; // cÃ²n trong áº£i (cáº£ lÃºc Ä‘Ã£ xong / háº¿t giá»: trÃ¬nh duyá»‡t tá»± há»i "ra")
  const P = D.phong ? PHONG.get(D.phong) : null;
  if (P && P.hoi > Date.now()) return false; // phÃ²ng vá»«a dá»±ng láº¡i sau khá»Ÿi Ä‘á»™ng láº¡i mÃ¡y chá»§ (giu-phong.js): chá» ngÆ°á»i vÃ o láº¡i (Nhiáº¿p ThÃ­ Tráº§n "Trá»Ÿ láº¡i áº£i")
  if (P) roiPhong(P, D.tk);
  delete S.dang; return true;
}
// gá»­i kÃ¨m nhÃ¢n váº­t (hero.va): ngÃ y, sá»‘ láº§n, phÃ­ láº§n káº¿, áº£i Ä‘ang Ä‘Ã¡nh + giá» mÃ¡y chá»§ (Ä‘áº¿m giá»); tá»• Ä‘á»™i: phong = mÃ£ phÃ²ng (trÃ¬nh duyá»‡t dÃ¹ng
// tráº¡ng thÃ¡i phÃ²ng â€” src/game/vadoi.js)
function tomTat(h) {
  if (!VA) return null;
  const S = h.vuotAi || {}, hn = S.ngay === N.ngayVN(Date.now()), luot = hn ? S.luot | 0 : 0, D = dangCua(h);
  return { luot, toiDa: CF.luot, phi: luot < CF.luot ? phiLan(luot) : null, lo: VA.cap[0].lo, mau: CF.mau, mauDat: CF.mauDat || null, nhin: CF.nhin, keo: CF.keo,
    dang: D ? { cap: D.cap, bd: D.bd, dot: D.dot, giet: D.giet, tong: (capCua(D.cap) || { dot: [] }).dot.length, han: VA.han, ket: D.ket || null, ...(D.phong ? { phong: D.phong } : {}) } : null, gio: Date.now() };
}

// ---------- nhá»‹p cá»§a thÃ nh viÃªn phÃ²ng (api.js) ----------
// thÆ°á»Ÿng Ä‘ang chá» (kinh nghiá»‡m Ä‘Ã¡m / xong áº£i, Ä‘á»“ rÆ¡i cá»§a con cháº¿t) -> cá»™ng vÃ o nhÃ¢n váº­t, Ä‘á»“ náº±m Ä‘áº¥t cá»§a riÃªng ngÆ°á»i Ä‘Ã³ (DO.roiMon) ->
// { kn, len, nhan: [{ â€¦mÃ³n, x, y, z }], tin, luyen? } | null
function nhanPhong(h, tk, key) {
  const L = CHO.get(tk); if (!h || !L || !L.length) return null;
  CHO.delete(tk);
  const kq = { kn: 0, len: 0, nhan: [], tin: [] };
  h.lvl = h.lvl || 1; h.exp = h.exp || 0;
  for (const r of L) {
    if (r.kn > 0) { h.exp += r.kn; kq.kn += r.kn; kq.len += N.lenCap(h); }
    for (const it of r.mon || []) kq.nhan.push({ ...DO.roiMon(h, key, { z: r.z, x: Math.round(r.x), y: Math.round(r.y) }, { ...it }), x: Math.round(r.x), y: Math.round(r.y), z: r.z });
    if (r.tin) kq.tin.push(...r.tin);

// khung mÃ¡y chá»§ gá»­i (khÃ´ng máº·t náº¡): FIN + mÃ£, Ä‘á»™ dÃ i 7 / 16 / 64 bit
function khung(op, data) {
  const n = data.length;
  let dau;
  if (n < 126) dau = Buffer.from([0x80 | op, n]);
  else if (n < 65536) dau = Buffer.from([0x80 | op, 126, n >> 8, n & 255]);
  else { dau = Buffer.alloc(10); dau[0] = 0x80 | op; dau[1] = 127; dau.writeBigUInt64BE(BigInt(n), 2); }
  return Buffer.concat([dau, data]);
}

const BO = 64 * 1024, LUI = 1024 * 1024, CAT = 4 * 1024 * 1024;
function huyKn(kn) {
  kn.dong = true;
  if (ds.get(kn.ten) === kn) ds.delete(kn.ten);

function ghi(kn, k, roi) {
  const s = kn.sock; if (s.destroyed) return;
  const L = s.writableLength;
  if (L > CAT) return huyKn(kn);
  if (roi && L > BO) return;
  try { s.write(k); } catch {}
}

function dongKn(kn, ma) {
  if (kn.dong) return;
  kn.dong = true;
  if (ds.get(kn.ten) === kn) ds.delete(kn.ten);

  if (s.writableLength > BO) { try { s.destroy(); } catch {} return; }
  try { const b = Buffer.alloc(2); b.writeUInt16BE(ma); s.end(khung(8, b)); } catch {}
  setTimeout(() => { try { if (!s.destroyed) s.destroy(); } catch {} }, 3000).unref();
}

// Chá»n bá»™ hÃ¬nh theo "Ä‘iá»ƒm lá»—i hiá»ƒn thá»‹" (tháº¥p hÆ¡n = tá»‘t hÆ¡n):
// HOLE  â€” bá»™ nÃ y khÃ´ng váº½ Ä‘Æ°á»£c bá»™ pháº­n Ä‘Ã³ (khÃ´ng hÃ¬nh tháº­t, khÃ´ng tháº¿ chá»—, khÃ´ng máº·c Ä‘á»‹nh) trong khi bá»™ kia CÃ“ hÃ¬nh tháº­t.
//         Vd bá»™ B nam khÃ´ng cÃ³ file tay trÃ¡i nÃ o -> máº·c Ã¡o thÆ°á»ng sáº½ cá»¥t tay. (Bá»™ kia chá»‰ cÃ³ hÃ¬nh tháº¿ chá»— thÃ¬ khÃ´ng tÃ­nh:
//         vd Ã¡o bÃ o #43 nam â€” bá»™ A cÅ©ng chá»‰ cÃ³ tay tháº¿ chá»—, cÃ²n bá»™ B váº½ tay trong á»‘ng tay Ã¡o.)
// WRONG â€” bá»™ nÃ y pháº£i dÃ¹ng hÃ¬nh tháº¿ chá»— / máº·c Ä‘á»‹nh trong khi bá»™ kia cÃ³ hÃ¬nh tháº­t.
// SET_PENALTY â€” bá»™ B Ã­t Ä‘á»™ng tÃ¡c (khÃ´ng cÃ³ bá»‹ Ä‘Ã¡nh, cháº¿t, ra chiÃªu) vÃ  Ã­t khung hÆ¡n.
const HOLE = { body: 100, horsem: 100, lhand: 50, rhand: 50, rweapon: 50, head: 40, lweapon: 30, horsef: 20, horseb: 20, hair: 5, shoulder: 5 };
const WRONG = { body: 40, horsem: 30, rweapon: 20, head: 15, lweapon: 10, rhand: 5, lhand: 5, horsef: 5, horseb: 5, hair: 3, shoulder: 3 };
const SET_PENALTY = { a: 0, b: 10 };
const PART_VI = { head: "Ä‘áº§u", hair: "tÃ³c", shoulder: "vai", body: "thÃ¢n", lhand: "tay trÃ¡i", rhand: "tay pháº£i", lweapon: "vÅ© khÃ­ trÃ¡i", rweapon: "vÅ© khÃ­ pháº£i", horsef: "ngá»±a trÆ°á»›c", horsem: "ngá»±a giá»¯a", horseb: "ngá»±a sau" };
const SEMANTIC = new Set(["stand", "run", "attack", "hurt", "die", "magic"]);
const RETRY_MS = 2000;

export class CharPack {
  static async load(base) {
    base = base.endsWith("/") ? base : base + "/";
    const res = await fetch(base + "pack.json");
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`KhÃ´ng Ä‘á»c Ä‘Æ°á»£c ${base}pack.json (${res.status})`);
    const meta = await res.json();
    if (meta.format !== "vl-char-pack") throw new Error("pack.json khÃ´ng Ä‘Ãºng Ä‘á»‹nh dáº¡ng vl-char-pack");
    return new CharPack(base, meta);
  }

  constructor(base, meta) {
    this.base = base;
    this.meta = meta;
    this.code = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(meta.parts).map(([c, p]) => [p, +c]));
    this._items = new Map();  // "a/m/body_5" -> { p: Promise<json>, failed }
    this._json = new Map();   // "a/m/body_5" -> json Ä‘Ã£ táº£i
    this._imgs = new Map();   // url -> HTMLImageElement (Ä‘Ã£ decode)
    this._imgP = new Map();   // url -> { p: Promise<img>, failed }
  }

  // ---------- Tra cá»©u ----------
  partSex(part, sex) { return this.meta.groups.horse.includes(part) ? this.meta.horseSex : sex; }

  // Tráº¡ng thÃ¡i 1 mÃ³n trong 1 bá»™: { real: true, acts } | { sub: id } | null
  entry(set, sex, part, id) {
    const e = (((this.meta.sets[set].items[this.partSex(part, sex)] || {})[part]) || {})[id];
    if (!e) return null;
    return Array.isArray(e) ? { real: true, acts: e } : e;
  }

  // Danh sÃ¡ch id cá»§a 1 bá»™ pháº­n (cáº£ 2 bá»™), kÃ¨m tráº¡ng thÃ¡i
  listIds(sex, part) {
    const ids = new Set();
    for (const set of ["a", "b"]) for (const id of Object.keys(((this.meta.sets[set].items[this.partSex(part, sex)] || {})[part]) || {})) ids.add(+id);
    return [...ids].sort((x, y) => x - y).map((id) => ({ id, a: this.entry("a", sex, part, id), b: this.entry("b", sex, part, id) }));
  }

  // CÃ³ hÃ¬nh tháº­t á»Ÿ bá»™ nÃ o khÃ´ng (dÃ¹ng khi chá»n id cho 1 mÃ³n Ä‘á»“)
  isReal(sex, group, id) {
    return this.meta.groups[group].some((p) => ["a", "b"].some((s) => (this.entry(s, sex, p, id) || {}).real));
  }

  // Chá»n id kiá»ƒu dÃ¡ng cho 1 mÃ³n Ä‘á»“ (tá»« item-looks.json): Æ°u tiÃªn id cÃ³ hÃ¬nh tháº­t.
  // Thá»© tá»± xÃ©t: kiá»ƒu theo báº£n 1 (gáº§n báº£ng gá»‘c nháº¥t), rá»“i kiá»ƒu báº£n 2 chá»n.
  pickLookId(sex, item) {
    const cands = [item.a, item.b, ...(item.bAlt || [])].filter((x) => x > 0);
    const real = cands.find((id) => this.isReal(sex, item.g, id));
    if (real) return { id: real, why: real === item.a ? "theo báº£n 1" : "theo báº£n 2" };
    if (cands.length) return { id: cands[0], why: "chÆ°a cÃ³ hÃ¬nh tháº­t, dÃ¹ng hÃ¬nh tháº¿ chá»—" };
    return { id: 0, why: "khÃ´ng cÃ³ kiá»ƒu dÃ¡ng" };
  }

  // ---------- Giáº£i kiá»ƒu dÃ¡ng: chá»n bá»™ hÃ¬nh + id tá»«ng bá»™ pháº­n ----------
  // req: { sex, armor, helm, weapon, horse, set: "auto" | "a" | "b" }
  // Tá»± chá»n: bá»™ nÃ o cÃ³ Ä‘iá»ƒm lá»—i hiá»ƒn thá»‹ tháº¥p hÆ¡n thÃ¬ dÃ¹ng (xem HOLE / WRONG / SET_PENALTY á»Ÿ Ä‘áº§u file); báº±ng nhau -> bá»™ A.
  // KhÃ´ng bao giá» trá»™n 2 bá»™ trÃªn 1 nhÃ¢n váº­t.
  resolve(req) {
    const sex = req.sex === "f" ? "f" : "m";
    const d = this.meta.defaults;
    const want = { armor: req.armor || d.armor, helm: req.helm || d.helm, weapon: req.weapon || d.weapon, horse: req.horse || 0 };
    const plans = {};
    for (const set of ["a", "b"]) plans[set] = this._plan(set, sex, want);
    const describe = (s) => plans[s].defects.length ? plans[s].defects.map((x) => x.text).join("; ") : "khÃ´ng cÃ³ lá»—i";
    let set, why;
    if (req.set === "a" || req.set === "b") { set = req.set; why = `chá»n tay Â· lá»—i bá»™ ${set.toUpperCase()}: ${describe(set)}`; }
    else {
      set = plans.a.cost <= plans.b.cost ? "a" : "b";
      const other = set === "a" ? "b" : "a";
      why = `Ä‘iá»ƒm lá»—i A ${plans.a.cost} Â· B ${plans.b.cost} â€” bá»™ ${other.toUpperCase()}: ${describe(other)}` +
        (plans[set].defects.length ? ` Â· bá»™ ${set.toUpperCase()}: ${describe(set)}` : "");
    }
    const plan = plans[set];
    const riding = !!plan.parts.horsem;
    // Kiá»ƒu Ä‘Ã¡nh theo vÅ© khÃ­ Ä‘ang cáº§m (ká»ƒ cáº£ khi hÃ¬nh vÅ© khÃ­ lÃ  hÃ¬nh tháº¿ chá»—, vd Ã¡m khÃ­ mÆ°á»£n hÃ¬nh tay khÃ´ng).
    // Chá»‰ khi bá»™ hÃ¬nh khÃ´ng cÃ³ vÅ© khÃ­ nÃ y vÃ  pháº£i váº½ vÅ© khÃ­ máº·c Ä‘á»‹nh thÃ¬ kiá»ƒu Ä‘Ã¡nh theo vÅ© khÃ­ máº·c Ä‘á»‹nh cho khá»›p hÃ¬nh.
    const wp = plan.parts.rweapon || plan.parts.lweapon;
    const wid = wp && wp.why === "máº·c Ä‘á»‹nh" ? wp.id : want.weapon;
    const weapon = (this.meta.weapons[sex] || {})[wid] || { kind: "free" };
    return {
      set, why, sex, want, riding, weapon, weaponId: wid,
      parts: plan.parts, notes: plan.notes,
      cost: { a: plans.a.cost, b: plans.b.cost }, defects: { a: plans.a.defects, b: plans.b.defects },
      key: `${set}|${sex}|${JSON.stringify(plan.parts)}`,
    };
  }

  _plan(set, sex, want) {
    const other = set === "a" ? "b" : "a", S = set.toUpperCase(), O = other.toUpperCase();
    const parts = {}, notes = [], real = new Set(), defects = [];
    let cost = SET_PENALTY[set] || 0;
    // VÅ© khÃ­ trÃ¡i chá»‰ Ä‘Ã¡ng ká»ƒ vá»›i song binh; vÅ© khÃ­ 1 tay thÃ¬ "vÅ© khÃ­ trÃ¡i" chá»‰ lÃ  cháº¥m náº¯m tay 3px -> khÃ´ng tÃ­nh lá»—i
    const double = ((this.meta.weapons[sex] || {})[want.weapon] || {}).kind === "double";
    const defect = (part, w, text) => { if (part === "lweapon" && !double) return; cost += w; defects.push({ part, w, text }); };
    for (const [group, list] of Object.entries(this.meta.groups)) {
      const id = want[group];
      if (!id) continue;
      for (const part of list) {
        const mine = this.entry(set, sex, part, id), theirs = this.entry(other, sex, part, id);
        if (!mine && !theirs) continue; // bá»™ pháº­n nÃ y khÃ´ng thuá»™c kiá»ƒu dÃ¡ng nÃ y
        const theirsReal = !!(theirs && theirs.real);
        if (mine && mine.real) { parts[part] = { id, real: true }; real.add(part); continue; }
        if (mine && mine.sub) {
          parts[part] = { id: mine.sub, real: false, want: id, why: "tháº¿ chá»—" };
          notes.push(`${PART_VI[part]} #${id}: bá»™ ${S} khÃ´ng cÃ³ hÃ¬nh tháº­t, dÃ¹ng hÃ¬nh tháº¿ chá»— #${mine.sub}`);
          if (theirsReal) defect(part, WRONG[part], `${PART_VI[part]} #${id} dÃ¹ng hÃ¬nh tháº¿ chá»— (bá»™ ${O} cÃ³ hÃ¬nh tháº­t)`);
          continue;
        }
        // Bá»™ nÃ y khÃ´ng cÃ³, bá»™ kia cÃ³ -> khÃ´ng trá»™n 2 bá»™: dÃ¹ng kiá»ƒu máº·c Ä‘á»‹nh cá»§a nhÃ³m náº¿u cÃ³, khÃ´ng thÃ¬ bá» trá»‘ng
        const def = this.meta.defaults[group];
        const de = def && this.entry(set, sex, part, def);
        if (de && (de.real || de.sub)) {
          parts[part] = { id: de.real ? def : de.sub, real: false, want: id, why: "máº·c Ä‘á»‹nh" };
          notes.push(`${PART_VI[part]} #${id}: chá»‰ bá»™ ${O} cÃ³, bá»™ ${S} dÃ¹ng kiá»ƒu máº·c Ä‘á»‹nh #${def}`);
          if (theirsReal) defect(part, WRONG[part], `${PART_VI[part]} #${id} pháº£i dÃ¹ng kiá»ƒu máº·c Ä‘á»‹nh (bá»™ ${O} cÃ³ hÃ¬nh tháº­t)`);
        } else {
          const noneAtAll = !((this.meta.sets[set].items[this.partSex(part, sex)] || {})[part]);
          notes.push(`${PART_VI[part]} #${id}: bá»™ ${S} ${noneAtAll ? "khÃ´ng cÃ³ hÃ¬nh " + PART_VI[part] + " nÃ o cho giá»›i nÃ y" : "khÃ´ng cÃ³ hÃ¬nh"}, bá» trá»‘ng`);
          if (theirsReal) defect(part, HOLE[part], `thiáº¿u háº³n ${PART_VI[part]} (bá»™ ${O} cÃ³ hÃ¬nh tháº­t)`);
        }
      }
    }
    return { parts, notes, real, cost, defects };
  }

  // ---------- Äá»™ng tÃ¡c ----------
  // Danh sÃ¡ch Ä‘á»™ng tÃ¡c cá»§a 1 bá»™ pháº­n trong look
  actsOf(look, part) {
    const p = look.parts[part];
    if (!p) return [];
    const e = this.entry(look.set, look.sex, part, p.id);
    return e && e.real ? e.acts : [];
  }
  refPart(look) { return look.parts.body ? "body" : look.parts.horsem ? "horsem" : Object.keys(look.parts)[0]; }

  // Äá»•i Ä‘á»™ng tÃ¡c ngá»¯ nghÄ©a (stand/run/attack/hurt/die/magic) thÃ nh tÃªn Ä‘á»™ng tÃ¡c tháº­t cÃ³ hÃ¬nh.
  // Tráº£ vá» { act, sem, exact } hoáº·c null. act cá»¥ thá»ƒ (vd "MeleeWCut") thÃ¬ dÃ¹ng tháº³ng náº¿u cÃ³.
  actFor(look, want) {
    const have = new Set(this.actsOf(look, this.refPart(look)));
    if (!SEMANTIC.has(want)) return have.has(want) ? { act: want, sem: this._semOf(want), exact: true } : null;
    const k = this.meta.kinds;
    const table = look.riding ? look.weapon.ride || k.ride : look.weapon.acts || k[look.weapon.kind] || k.free;
    const kindTable = look.riding ? k.ride : k[look.weapon.kind] || k.free;
    for (const sem of [want, ...(this.meta.fallback[want] || [])]) {
      for (const act of [table[sem], kindTable[sem]]) {
        if (act && have.has(act)) return { act, sem, exact: sem === want && act === table[want] };
      }
    }
    return null;
  }
  _semOf(act) {
    for (const [sem, a] of Object.entries(this.meta.kinds.free)) if (a === act) return sem;
    if (/Stand/.test(act)) return "stand";
    if (/Run/.test(act)) return "run";
    if (/Wound/.test(act)) return "hurt";
    if (/Die/.test(act)) return "die";
    if (/Magic/.test(act)) return "magic";
    return "attack";
  }

  // ---------- Táº£i ----------
  _itemKey(look, part) { return `${look.set}/${this.partSex(part, look.sex)}/${part}_${look.parts[part].id}`; }
  // Táº£i cÃ³ nhá»› Ä‘á»‡m. Lá»—i thÃ¬ cho thá»­ láº¡i sau RETRY_MS (khÃ´ng thá»­ láº¡i liÃªn tá»¥c má»—i khung hÃ¬nh).
  _cached(map, key, make) {
    const c = map.get(key);
    if (c && (!c.failed || performance.now() - c.failed < RETRY_MS)) return c.p;
    const entry = { p: null, failed: 0 };
    entry.p = make().then((v) => { if (v == null) entry.failed = performance.now(); return v; },
      () => { entry.failed = performance.now(); return null; });
    map.set(key, entry);
    return entry.p;
  }
  _loadItem(key) {
    return this._cached(this._items, key, () => fetch(this.base + key + ".json")
      .then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : null)).then((j) => { if (j) this._json.set(key, j); return j; }));
  }
  // Chá» onload chá»© khÃ´ng chá» img.decode(): decode() cÃ³ thá»ƒ treo mÃ£i khi tab/khung Ä‘ang áº©n (Ä‘Ã£ gáº·p tháº­t).
  // decode() váº«n Ä‘Æ°á»£c gá»i thÃªm Ä‘á»ƒ trÃ¬nh duyá»‡t giáº£i mÃ£ sá»›m, nhÆ°ng khÃ´ng chá».
  _loadImg(url) {
    return this._cached(this._imgP, url, () => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const img = new Image();
      img.onload = () => {
        if (!img.naturalWidth) return reject(new Error("áº¢nh rá»—ng: " + url));
        this._imgs.set(url, img);
        if (img.decode) img.decode().catch(() => {});
        resolve(img);
      };
      img.onerror = () => reject(new Error("KhÃ´ng táº£i Ä‘Æ°á»£c áº£nh: " + url));
      img.src = url;
    }));
  }
  _imgUrl(key, file) { return this.base + key.slice(0, key.lastIndexOf("/") + 1) + file; }

  // Táº£i Ä‘á»§ dá»¯ liá»‡u + áº£nh Ä‘á»ƒ váº½ 1 Ä‘á»™ng tÃ¡c cá»§a look. Tráº£ vá» tÃªn Ä‘á»™ng tÃ¡c tháº­t (hoáº·c null).
  async ensure(look, want) {
    const keys = Object.keys(look.parts).map((p) => this._itemKey(look, p));
    await Promise.all(keys.map((k) => this._loadItem(k)));
    const r = this.actFor(look, want);
    if (!r) return null;
    await Promise.all(keys.map((k) => {
      const a = (this._json.get(k) || { acts: {} }).acts[r.act];
      return a ? this._loadImg(this._imgUrl(k, a.img)) : null;
    }));
    return r;
  }

  // ---------- Váº½ ----------
  // Sá»‘ khung cá»§a Ä‘á»™ng tÃ¡c (theo bá»™ pháº­n chuáº©n)
  frameCount(look, act) {
    const a = ((this._json.get(this._itemKey(look, this.refPart(look))) || { acts: {} }).acts || {})[act];
    return a ? a.n : 0;
  }

  // Äá»™ dÃ i 1 lÆ°á»£t Ä‘á»™ng tÃ¡c theo nhá»‹p máº·c Ä‘á»‹nh cá»§a bá»™ hÃ¬nh (giÃ¢y)
  actDuration(look, act) {
    const ref = (this._json.get(this._itemKey(look, this.refPart(look))) || { acts: {} }).acts[act];
    if (!ref) return 0;
    const tm = this.meta.sets[look.set].timing, sem = this._semOf(act);
    const ms = look.set === "b" ? ref.i * tm.unitMs : tm.msPerFrame[sem] || tm.onceMsPerFrame;
    return (ref.n * ms) / 1000;
  }

  // TÃªn file áº£nh cá»§a 1 bá»™ pháº­n cho 1 Ä‘á»™ng tÃ¡c (Ä‘Ã£ táº£i), vd "a/m/ma_bd_001_st03.webp"
  partFile(look, part, act) {
    if (!look.parts[part]) return null;
    const key = this._itemKey(look, part);
    const a = (this._json.get(key) || { acts: {} }).acts[act];
    return a ? key.slice(0, key.lastIndexOf("/") + 1) + a.img : null;
  }

  // VÃ¹ng cáº¯t [x, y, rá»™ng, cao, lá»‡chX, lá»‡chY] cá»§a 1 Ä‘á»™ng tÃ¡c á»Ÿ hÆ°á»›ng dir, khi bá»™ pháº­n chuáº©n Ä‘ang á»Ÿ khung j / n.
  // - LÆ°á»›i (bá»™ a): hÃ ng = hÆ°á»›ng, cá»™t = khung.  - Tá»‰a (bá»™ b): f[hÆ°á»›ng * n + khung].
  // - CÃ³ seg (táº¥m xáº¿p 8 hÆ°á»›ng trÃªn 1 hÃ ng, sá»‘ khung má»—i hÆ°á»›ng khÃ´ng Ä‘á»u): seg[hÆ°á»›ng] = [khung Ä‘áº§u, sá»‘ khung].
  _rect(a, dir, j, n) {
    let idx, row = 0;
    if (a.seg) {
      const [s0, len] = a.seg[dir];
      idx = s0 + Math.min(len - 1, Math.floor((j * len) / n));
    } else {
      const k = Math.min(a.n - 1, Math.floor((j * a.n) / n));
      row = a.d >= 8 ? dir : Math.floor((dir * a.d) / 8);
      idx = a.grid ? k : row * a.n + k;
    }
    if (a.grid) { const [w, h, ox, oy] = a.grid; return [idx * w, a.seg ? 0 : row * h, w, h, ox, oy]; }
    return a.f[idx];
  }

  // Khung k, hÆ°á»›ng dir cá»§a 1 bá»™ pháº­n: { w, h, ox, oy } (lá»‡ch so vá»›i Ä‘iá»ƒm chÃ¢n), hoáº·c null
  frameRect(look, part, act, dir = 0, k = 0) {
    if (!look.parts[part]) return null;
    const a = (this._json.get(this._itemKey(look, part)) || { acts: {} }).acts[act];
    if (!a) return null;
    const per = a.seg ? a.seg[dir][1] : a.n;
    const f = this._rect(a, dir, Math.min(k, per - 1), per);
    return { w: f[2], h: f[3], ox: f[4], oy: f[5] };
  }

  // Khung thá»© máº¥y táº¡i thá»i Ä‘iá»ƒm t (giÃ¢y). duration (giÃ¢y) = Ä‘á»™ dÃ i Ä‘á»™ng tÃ¡c 1 láº§n, náº¿u game muá»‘n Ã©p.
  frameAt(look, act, t, duration) {
    const ref = (this._json.get(this._itemKey(look, this.refPart(look))) || { acts: {} }).acts[act];
    if (!ref) return 0;
    const sem = this._semOf(act), loop = !!this.meta.loop[sem], n = ref.n;
    if (!loop && duration > 0) return Math.min(n - 1, Math.floor((t / duration) * n));
    const tm = this.meta.sets[look.set].timing;
    const ms = look.set === "b" ? ref.i * tm.unitMs : tm.msPerFrame[sem] || tm.onceMsPerFrame;
    const j = Math.floor((t * 1000) / ms);
    return loop ? j % n : Math.min(j, n - 1);
  }

  // Thá»© tá»± váº½ cÃ¡c bá»™ pháº­n (mÃ£) cho Ä‘á»™ng tÃ¡c/hÆ°á»›ng/khung
  order(look, act, dir, j) {
    const tbl = this.meta.sets[look.set].order[look.sex] || {};
    const key = String(dir * 2 + 1);
    const t = tbl[act], def = tbl.DEFAULT || { dirs: {} };
    if (t && t.lines) {
      const mark = j * (this.meta.sets[look.set].lineStep || 1);
      const line = t.lines.find((l) => l[0] === mark);
      if (line) return line.slice(1);
    }
    return (t && t.dirs[key]) || def.dirs[key] || def.dirs["1"] || [this.code.body];
  }

  // Váº½ 1 nhÃ¢n váº­t. opt: { act (ngá»¯ nghÄ©a hoáº·c tÃªn tháº­t), dir 0..7, t (giÃ¢y), duration, x, y (Ä‘iá»ƒm chÃ¢n), scale, alpha, frame (Ã©p khung), snap }
  // Tráº£ vá» { act, frame, n, top } hoáº·c null náº¿u chÆ°a táº£i xong pháº§n thÃ¢n.
  draw(ctx, look, opt) {
    const r = this.actFor(look, opt.act);
    if (!r) return null;
    const act = r.act, dir = ((opt.dir | 0) % 8 + 8) % 8, scale = opt.scale || 1, snap = opt.snap !== false;
    const refKey = this._itemKey(look, this.refPart(look));
    const ref = (this._json.get(refKey) || { acts: {} }).acts[act];
    if (!ref) { this.ensure(look, opt.act); return null; }
    const n = ref.n;
    const j = opt.frame != null ? Math.min(n - 1, Math.max(0, opt.frame | 0)) : this.frameAt(look, act, opt.t || 0, opt.duration);
    const px = (v) => (snap ? Math.round(v) : v);
    let top = 0, drewRef = false, pending = false;

      if (key === refKey) drewRef = true;

    ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = prevSmooth;

  }

//   T.range("lifemax_v", [[50, 80]])  -> { min: "...+50...", max: "...+80..." }

export function makeAttrText(attr, skills) {
  const DESC = {};
  for (const a of attr.attrs) if (a.vi != null) DESC[a.key] = a.vi;
  Object.assign(DESC, attr.descOnly);
  const SER = attr.serDmg || {};
  const key = (id) => (attr.attrs[id] ? attr.attrs[id].key : `#${id}`);
  // "Táº¥t cáº£ ká»¹ nÄƒng: +N cáº¥p" / "Ká»¹ nÄƒng X: +N cáº¥p"
  const skPlus = (t) => {
    const r = Math.round(t[0] || 0), e = t[2] || 0;
    if (!(e > 0)) return `Táº¥t cáº£ ká»¹ nÄƒng: +${r} cáº¥p`;
    const s = skills[e];
    return `Ká»¹ nÄƒng ${s ? s.n : "#" + e}: +${r} cáº¥p`;
  };
  // Máº«u: #<chá»¯><1|2|3|A><dáº¥u> â€” sá»‘ = tham sá»‘ 1/2/3 (A = tham sá»‘ 1 / 256); dáº¥u "+" thÃªm "+" khi > 0, "~" thÃªm "-";
  // chá»¯ "l" = tÃªn vÃµ cÃ´ng. Sau Ä‘Ã³ bá» máº«u thá»«a, tháº» mÃ u; "Ká»¹ nÄƒng N" -> tÃªn vÃµ cÃ´ng N.
  const text = (k, t) => {
    k = SER[k] || k;
    if (k === "allskill_v") return skPlus(t);
    const e = DESC[k];
    if (!e) return k + ": " + t.filter((s) => s).join(" / ");
    return e
      .replace(/#([a-zA-Z])([123A])([-+~%]?)/g, (s, o, a, c) => {
        const r = a === "A" ? Math.floor((t[0] || 0) / 256) : t[+a - 1] || 0;
        return o === "l" ? (skills[r] ? skills[r].n : "#" + r) : (c === "+" && r > 0 ? "+" : c === "~" && r > 0 ? "-" : "") + r;
      })
      .replace(/#[a-zA-Z][123A][-+~]?/g, "")
      .replace(/<\/?color(?:=[^>]*)?>|<color>/gi, "")
      .replace(/Ká»¹ nÄƒng (\d+)/, (s, o) => (skills[o] ? "Ká»¹ nÄƒng " + skills[o].n : s));
  };
  const range = (k, p) => ({ min: text(k, p.map((x) => x[0])), max: text(k, p.map((x) => x[1])) });
  return { text, key, range };
}

const GAP = 0.06;
const MAX_VOICES = 12;

export class GameAudio {
  static async load(base = "assets/web/sound/") {
    const r = await fetch(base + "sound.json");
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error("KhÃ´ng Ä‘á»c Ä‘Æ°á»£c sound.json");
    return new GameAudio(base, await r.json());
  }

  constructor(base, meta) {
    this.base = base;
    this.meta = meta;
    this.ctx = null;
    this.buf = new Map();    // file -> Promise<AudioBuffer|null>
    this.last = new Map();   // file -> thá»i Ä‘iá»ƒm phÃ¡t gáº§n nháº¥t
    this.voices = 0;
    this.music = new Audio();
    this.music.loop = true;
    this.musicFile = null;
    this.vol = { music: 0.45, sfx: 0.7 };
    this.muted = false;
  }

  unlock() {
    if (!this.ctx) {
      const AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
      if (!AC) return;
      this.ctx = new AC();
      this.out = this.ctx.createGain();
      this.out.connect(this.ctx.destination);
      this._applyVol();
    }
    if (this.ctx.state === "suspended") this.ctx.resume();
    if (this.musicFile && this.music.paused && !this.muted) this.music.play().catch(() => {});
  }

  setMuted(m) { this.muted = m; this._applyVol(); if (m) this.music.pause(); else if (this.musicFile) this.music.play().catch(() => {}); }
  // Ã¢m lÆ°á»£ng nháº¡c ná»n / tiáº¿ng (0..1) â€” thanh trÆ°á»£t cá»§a cá»­a sá»• TÃ¹y chá»n
  setVolume(kind, v) { this.vol[kind] = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, v)); this._applyVol(); }
  _applyVol() {
    this.music.volume = this.muted ? 0 : this.vol.music * (this._musicVol || 1);
    if (this.out) this.out.gain.value = this.muted ? 0 : this.vol.sfx;
  }

  // Nháº¡c ná»n cá»§a báº£n Ä‘á»“ (khÃ³a áº£nh báº£n Ä‘á»“, nhÆ° music trong sound.json)
  playMapMusic(mapKey) {
    const m = this.meta.music[mapKey];
    if (!m || m.file === this.musicFile) return;
    this.musicFile = m.file;
    this._musicVol = (m.vol || 100) / 100;
    this.music.src = this.base + m.file;
    this._applyVol();
    if (!this.muted) this.music.play().catch(() => {}); // chÆ°a báº¥m láº§n nÃ o thÃ¬ trÃ¬nh duyá»‡t cháº·n -> unlock() phÃ¡t láº¡i
  }

  stopMusic() { this.music.pause(); this.musicFile = null; }

  _get(file) {
    let p = this.buf.get(file);
    if (!p) {
      p = fetch(this.base + file).then((r) => (r.ok ? r.arrayBuffer() : null))
        .then((ab) => (ab && this.ctx ? this.ctx.decodeAudioData(ab) : null)).catch(() => null);
      this.buf.set(file, p);
    }
    return p;
  }

  // PhÃ¡t 1 file (Ä‘Æ°á»ng dáº«n trong sound.json). vol 0..1
  play(file, vol = 1) {
    if (!file || !this.ctx || this.muted) return;
    const now = this.ctx.currentTime, l = this.last.get(file);
    if (l != null && now - l < GAP) return;
    if (this.voices >= MAX_VOICES) return;
    this.last.set(file, now);
    this._get(file).then((b) => {
      if (!b) { this.buf.delete(file); return; }
      const s = this.ctx.createBufferSource(), g = this.ctx.createGain();
      s.buffer = b; g.gain.value = vol;
      s.connect(g).connect(this.out);
      this.voices++;
      s.onended = () => { this.voices--; };
      s.start();
    });
  }

  // Tiáº¿ng NPC / quÃ¡i theo loáº¡i hÃ¬nh + Ä‘á»™ng tÃ¡c (die, attack1, attack2, magicâ€¦); khÃ´ng cÃ³ thÃ¬ tiáº¿ng dá»± phÃ²ng theo há»
  npc(type, act, vol = 0.8) {
    const t = String(type).toLowerCase(), own = this.meta.npc[t];
    const fam = (/^[a-z]+/.exec(t) || [""])[0], fb = this.meta.npcFallback[fam];
    this.play((own && own[act]) || (fb && fb[act]), vol);
  }
  ui(name, vol = 0.8) { this.play(this.meta.ui[name], vol); }
  // tiáº¿ng Ä‘Ã²n thÆ°á»ng: missile(1, 0) lÃºc vung, missile(1, 1) lÃºc trÃºng (sound.json missile[1] â€” tiáº¿ng Ä‘áº¡n 1 cá»§a client)
  missile(id, k = 0, vol = 0.8) { const f = this.meta.missile[id]; this.play(f && f[Math.min(k, f.length - 1)], vol); }
}

export function nhatMon(N, m, laTrangSuc) {
  if (!N) return true;
  if (m.loai === "tien") return !!N.tien;
  const ten = String(m.ten || "").normalize("NFC").toLowerCase();
  if ((N.boQua || []).some((t) => ten.includes(String(t).normalize("NFC").toLowerCase()))) return false;
  if (m.loai === "thuoc") return !!N.thuoc;
  if (m.loai === "db") return true;
  if (N.kieu === "rac") return true; // Nháº·t rÃ¡c (anh 08/11): má»i trang bá»‹ rÆ¡i â€” vá» thÃ nh bÃ¡n, giá»¯ mÃ³n Ä‘Ãºng dÃ²ng (main.js giuRac)
  if (N.trangSuc && !laTrangSuc(m.k)) return false;
  if (N.kieu === "train") return !!m.dong && m.dong >= N.dong && hopLoc(N.loc, m.dl); // Train lá»c Ä‘á»“ (anh 08/11): chá»‰ Ä‘á»“ xanh qua bá»™ lá»c, Ã­t vá» thÃ nh
  if (!m.dong) return !!N.trang;
  return m.dong >= N.dong && hopLoc(N.loc, m.dl);
}

export function hopLoc(L, dl) {
  if (!L || !L.on || !Object.values(L.ds || {}).some((v) => v.on)) return true;

}

// cÃ²n chá»— Ä‘áº·t 1 mÃ³n w Ã— h Ã´ trong tÃºi 6 Ã— 10 khÃ´ng, theo chá»— tháº­t cá»§a tá»«ng mÃ³n (x, y) â€” anh 08/11 (Trá»£ Thá»§ â†’ Vá» thÃ nh: Ä‘áº¿m tá»•ng Ã´ trá»‘ng thÃ¬ tÃºi lá»— chá»— váº«n tÆ°á»Ÿng cÃ²n chá»—)
export function coCho(bag, cellOf, w, h) {
  const W = 6, H = 10, g = new Uint8Array(W * H);
  for (const b of bag || []) {
    if (b.x == null) continue;
    const [bw, bh] = cellOf(b);
    for (let y = b.y; y < b.y + bh && y < H; y++) for (let x = b.x; x < b.x + bw && x < W; x++) g[y * W + x] = 1;
  }
  for (let y = 0; y + h <= H; y++) next: for (let x = 0; x + w <= W; x++) {
    for (let j = y; j < y + h; j++) for (let i = x; i < x + w; i++) if (g[j * W + i]) continue next;
    return true;
  }
  return false;
}
// sá»‘ Ã´ trá»‘ng cá»§a tÃºi 6 Ã— 10 (mÃ³n chiáº¿m w Ã— h Ã´ â€” c cá»§a kho Ä‘á»“)
export function oTrong(bag, cellOf) {
  let used = 0;
  for (const b of bag || []) { const [w, h] = cellOf(b); used += w * h; }
  return Math.max(0, 60 - used);
}

export class ChoTroi {

  tBan() { const o = this.xem || this.sapMinh(), L = this.api.luat().choTroi || {}; return o.thueBan ?? (o.thueMua == null ? L.thueBan : null) ?? 0; }

    for (const [k, t] of [["MakeAdvBtn", "Lá»i rao: chá»¯ trÃªn báº£ng hiá»‡u khi bÃ y bÃ¡n"], ["MarkPriceBtn", "Äá»‹nh giÃ¡: báº¥m mÃ³n trong hÃ nh trang Ä‘á»ƒ Ä‘áº·t giÃ¡ niÃªm yáº¿t (thu nháº­p) â€” mÃ³n lÃªn sáº¡p"], ["MakeStallBtn", "Rao bÃ¡n: ngá»“i bÃ y bÃ¡n á»Ÿ chá»— Ä‘ang Ä‘á»©ng (trong thÃ nh) â€” Ä‘i luyá»‡n cÃ´ng / thoÃ¡t game sáº¡p váº«n má»Ÿ"]]) w.node(k).title = t;
  }

  // ---------- khung RAO BÃN ----------
  _sap() {
    const w = this.W.get("sap"), box = w.node("ItemBox"), ib = w.def.sec.ItemBox;
    // ná»n lÆ°á»›i cá»§a hÃ¬nh client trong suá»‘t (ini Trans 1) â€” lÃ³t ná»n tá»‘i dÆ°á»›i lÆ°á»›i cho khá»i lá»™ chá»¯ / cáº£nh phÃ­a sau

  // ben: má»Ÿ cáº¡nh trÃ¡i HÃ nh trang (cháº¿ Ä‘á»™ Äá»‹nh giÃ¡)
  moSapMinh(ben) {

  }
  xemSap(k) {
    return this.api.cho({ viec: "xem", k }).then((j) => {
      if (!j || !j.xem) return;
      if (j.xem.minh) return this.moSapMinh();
      const w = this.W.get("sap");
      if (!w.visible) Object.assign(w.el.style, { left: "236px", top: "96px" }); // cáº¡nh pháº£i báº£ng nhiá»‡m vá»¥ gÃ³c trÃ¡i (ini 40 / 145 Ä‘Ã¨ lÃªn báº£ng Ä‘Ã³)
      this.xem = j.xem; this._veSap(); w.show(); this.api.P.audio.ui("click");
    });
  }
  _veSap() {
    const w = this.W.get("sap"), h = this.api.hero(); if (!h) return;
    const M = this.sapMinh(), S = this.xem || { ten: h.name, minh: true, qc: M.qc, ds: M.ds || [] }, set = w.def.sec.Settings || {};
    w.set("Owner", S.ten);
    w.node("Owner").title = S.qc ? `Lá»i rao: ${S.qc}` : "ChÆ°a cÃ³ lá»i rao";
    const box = w.node("ItemBox"), B = w.def.sec.ItemBox.unitBorder ?? 2;
    box.querySelectorAll(".jw-it").forEach((e) => e.remove());
    for (const it of S.ds) {
      const x = ItemDB.item(it.k); if (!x || it.x == null) continue;
      const [cw, ch] = x.c || [1, 1], el = document.createElement("div"), so = x.thuoc || x.phu || x.ktc;
      el.className = "jw-it";
      Object.assign(el.style, { left: it.x * UNIT + "px", top: it.y * UNIT + "px", width: cw * UNIT + "px", height: ch * UNIT + "px" });
      let html = "";
      for (let j = 0; j < ch; j++) for (let i = 0; i < cw; i++) html += `<i class="jw-cell sap" style="left:${i * UNIT + B}px;top:${j * UNIT + B}px;width:${UNIT - 2 * B}px;height:${UNIT - 2 * B}px;background:rgba(${(set.bGSpriteColor || [243, 194, 70]).join(",")},0.26);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px ${rgb(set.bGBorderColor || [100, 80, 30])}"></i>`;
      el.innerHTML = html + (x.ic ? `<img class="jw-icon" src="assets/web/icon/${esc(x.ic)}" alt="">` : "") + (so && it.n > 1 ? `<b class="jw-n">${it.n}</b>` : "");
      const t = this.tMua(), tb = this.tBan();
      const goiY = S.minh
        ? [`GiÃ¡ niÃªm yáº¿t : ${fmtMoney(it.gia)}`, `Báº¡n nháº­n: ${fmtMoney(it.gia - Math.floor((it.gia * tb) / 100))}${tb ? ` (trá»« thuáº¿ ${tb}%)` : ""}`, `NgÆ°á»i mua tráº£: ${fmtMoney(it.mua)} (gá»“m thuáº¿ ${t}%)`, "Báº¥m: Ä‘á»‹nh giÃ¡ láº¡i Â· Chuá»™t pháº£i: khÃ´ng bÃ¡n (vá» hÃ nh trang)"]
        : [`GiÃ¡ bÃ¡n (gá»“m thuáº¿ ) : ${fmtMoney(it.mua)}`, `Thuáº¿ ngÆ°á»i mua: ${t}%`, "Báº¥m: mua"];
      el.onmousemove = (e) => this.gw._showTip(it, e, goiY);
      el.onmouseleave = () => this.gw._hideTip();
      el.onclick = (e) => { this.gw._hideTip(); if (S.minh) this.dinhGiaMon(it, e, true); else this.gw._tradeOpen("sap", { ...it, sapK: S.k, chu: S.ten }); };
      el.oncontextmenu = (e) => { e.preventDefault(); this.gw._hideTip(); if (S.minh) this.thuHoi(it); else this.gw._tradeOpen("sap", { ...it, sapK: S.k, chu: S.ten }); };
      box.appendChild(el);
    }
  }
  thuHoi(it) { return this.api.cho({ viec: "thuHoi", u: it.u }); }
  // khung mua bÃ¡n báº¥m XÃ¡c nháº­n (windows.js _trade "sap")

  // ---------- khung Ä‘á»‹nh giÃ¡ ----------
  _gia() {
    const w = this.W.get("dinhgia"), sec = w.def.sec;
    const inp = document.createElement("input");
    inp.className = "jw-num"; inp.maxLength = 12; inp.inputMode = "numeric"; inp.spellcheck = false; inp.autocomplete = "off"; inp.name = "gia-ban";

    o.appendChild(inp);

    w.el.appendChild(them);
    const so = () => Math.max(0, parseInt(inp.value, 10) || 0);
    const upd = () => {
      const n = so(), t = this.tMua(), tb = this.tBan();
      them.innerHTML = n ? `= ${esc(fmtMoney(n))}<br>Báº¡n nháº­n: ${esc(fmtMoney(n - Math.floor((n * tb) / 100)))}${tb ? ` (trá»« thuáº¿ ${tb}%)` : ""}<br>NgÆ°á»i mua tráº£: ${esc(fmtMoney(n + Math.floor((n * t) / 100)))} (gá»“m thuáº¿ ${t}%)` : `GiÃ¡ niÃªm yáº¿t: ngÆ°á»i mua tráº£ thÃªm ${t}%${tb ? `, báº¡n nháº­n bá»›t ${tb}%` : ""} (thuáº¿)`;
    };
    inp.oninput = () => { inp.value = inp.value.replace(/\D/g, "").replace(/^0+/, ""); upd(); };
    const ok = () => {
      const G = this.gia; if (!G) return;
      const n = so(); if (!n) return this.api.msg("Nháº­p giÃ¡ niÃªm yáº¿t (lÆ°á»£ng) â€” sá»‘ tiá»n báº¡n nháº­n khi bÃ¡n Ä‘Æ°á»£c");
      this.api.cho({ viec: "dinhGia", u: G.it.u, gia: n }).then((j) => { if (j && this.gia === G) w.hide(); });
    };
    inp.onkeydown = (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); if (e.key === "Enter") ok(); else if (e.key === "Escape") w.hide(); };
    w.on("OkBtn", ok).on("CancelBtn", () => { const G = this.gia; w.hide(); if (G && G.tren) this.thuHoi(G.it); });
    w.node("CancelBtn").title = "KhÃ´ng bÃ¡n: mÃ³n trÃªn sáº¡p vá» hÃ nh trang";
    w.cb.hide = () => { this.gia = null; inp.blur(); };
    this._giaInp = inp; this._giaUpd = upd;
  }
  // khung giÃ¡ ngay trÃªn chá»— báº¥m (nhÆ° client â€” ini Left 0 Top 0: engine Ä‘áº·t cáº¡nh mÃ³n)
  dinhGiaMon(it, e, tren) {
    const w = this.W.get("dinhgia"), x = ItemDB.item(it.k); if (!x) return;
    if (!tren && it.het) return this.api.msg("Ngá»±a cÃ³ háº¡n cá»§a Ká»³ TrÃ¢n CÃ¡c khÃ´ng bÃ y bÃ¡n Ä‘Æ°á»£c");
    if (!tren && it.kbh) return this.api.msg("KhÃ´ng thá»ƒ Ä‘áº·t vÃ o váº­t pháº©m Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘Æ°á»£c khÃ³a báº£o hiá»ƒm!"); // client G_STR_NO_BINDITEM (anh 05/11)
    this.gia = { it, tren: !!tren };
    w.set("ObjectName", x.n.trim());
    this._giaInp.value = tren && it.gia ? String(it.gia) : "";
    this._giaUpd();
    const r = this.W.root.getBoundingClientRect(), s = r.width / 1024 || 1, m = w.def.sec.Main;
    const cx = e ? (e.clientX - r.left) / s : 512, cy = e ? (e.clientY - r.top) / s : 384;
    const yTren = cy - m.h - 14; // trÃªn chá»— báº¥m; sÃ¡t mÃ©p trÃªn (mÃ³n hÃ ng Ä‘áº§u cá»§a tÃºi) thÃ¬ dÆ°á»›i chá»— báº¥m
    w.el.style.left = Math.round(Math.max(0, Math.min(1024 - m.w, cx - m.w / 2))) + "px";
    w.el.style.top = Math.round(Math.max(0, Math.min(768 - m.h - 60, yTren < 30 ? cy + 24 : yTren))) + "px";
    w.show(); this.api.P.audio.ui("click");
    if (!document.body.classList.contains("dt")) { this._giaInp.focus(); this._giaInp.select(); }
  }

  // ---------- khung lá»i rao ----------
  _qc() {

  get on() { return !!(this.el && this.el.classList.contains("on")); }
  toggle(force) {
    if (!this.el) this.build();
    const on = force ?? !this.on;
    this.el.classList.toggle("on", on);
    clearInterval(this.live);
    if (on) { this.render(); this.live = setInterval(() => this.refreshLive(), 400); }
  }

  build() {
    const el = (this.el = document.createElement("div"));
    el.className = "dv";
    el.innerHTML = `<div class="dv-head"><b>CÃ´ng cá»¥ thá»­</b>${[["char", "NhÃ¢n váº­t"], ["mob", "QuÃ¡i"], ["item", "Äá»“"], ["map", "Báº£n Ä‘á»“"], ["ut", "á»¦y thÃ¡c"], ["pld", "Phong LÄƒng Äá»™"], ["dt", "DÃ£ Táº©u"], ["st", "SÃ¡t thá»§"], ["va", "VÆ°á»£t áº¢i"], ["tk", "Tá»‘ng Kim"], ["btg", "Boss TG"]]
      .map(([k, n]) => `<button class="dv-tab" data-tab="${k}">${n}</button>`).join("")}<button data-act="close" title="ÄÃ³ng (phÃ­m \`)">âœ•</button></div><div class="dv-body"></div>`;
    document.body.appendChild(el);
    el.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      const t = e.target.closest("[data-tab],[data-act]");
      if (!t) return;
      if (t.dataset.tab) { this.tab = t.dataset.tab; this.render(); return; }
      this.act(t.dataset.act, t);
    });
    el.addEventListener("input", (e) => this.onInput(e.target));
    el.addEventListener("change", (e) => this.onInput(e.target, true));
    el.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => { if (e.key === "Escape") this.toggle(false); e.stopPropagation(); });
    // kÃ©o báº£ng báº±ng thanh tiÃªu Ä‘á» (mÃ n nhá» báº£ng che nhÃ¢n váº­t)
    el.querySelector(".dv-head").addEventListener("pointerdown", (e) => {
      if (e.target.closest("button")) return;
      const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(), ox = e.clientX - r.left, oy = e.clientY - r.top;
      const mv = (ev) => { el.style.left = Math.max(0, Math.min(innerWidth - 60, ev.clientX - ox)) + "px"; el.style.top = Math.max(0, Math.min(innerHeight - 30, ev.clientY - oy)) + "px"; };
      const up = () => { removeEventListener("pointermove", mv); removeEventListener("pointerup", up); };
      addEventListener("pointermove", mv); addEventListener("pointerup", up);
      e.preventDefault();
    });
  }

  // ---------- váº½ tháº» ----------
  render() {
    if (!this.el) return;
    this.el.querySelectorAll(".dv-tab").forEach((b) => b.classList.toggle("on", b.dataset.tab === this.tab));
    const body = this.el.querySelector(".dv-body");
    body.innerHTML = this[{ char: "tabChar", mob: "tabMob", item: "tabItem", map: "tabMap", ut: "tabUt", pld: "tabPld", dt: "tabDt", st: "tabSt", va: "tabVa", vd: "tabVd", btg: "tabBtg", tk: "tabTk", ld: "tabLd", dn: "tabDn" }[this.tab]]();
    if (this.tab === "ut" && !this.ut.tt) this.utXem();
    if (this.tab === "pld" && !this.pl.tt) this.hd("pld", { viec: "xem" });
    if (this.tab === "dt" && !this.dt.tt) this.hd("dt", { viec: "xem" });
    if (this.tab === "st" && !this.st.tt) this.hd("st", { viec: "xem" });
    if (this.tab === "va" && !this.va.tt) this.hd("va", { viec: "xem" });
    if (this.tab === "vd" && !this.vd.tt) this.hd("vd", { viec: "xem" });
    if (this.tab === "mob") this.fillMobs();
    if (this.tab === "item") { if (!this.pack) this.loadPack(); else this.fillItems(); }
    this.refreshLive();
  }

    h.skPts = null; fixPoints(h);

        return api.gotoZone(z).then(() => { api.msg("Äáº¿n " + z.n); this.render(); });
      }
      case "tp": {
        const X = +val("tx"), Y = +val("ty"), mm = P.hud.mmMap;
        if (!Number.isFinite(X) || !Number.isFinite(Y) || !mm) return;
        const [x, y] = mm.fromClient(X, Y);
        if (w.teleport(x, y)) { api.snapCam(); api.msg(`Dá»‹ch chuyá»ƒn tá»›i ${X}/${Y}`); } else api.msg(`KhÃ´ng cÃ³ chá»— Ä‘á»©ng gáº§n ${X}/${Y}`);
        return;
      }
      case "speed": P.dev.speed = v; api.msg(`Tá»‘c Ä‘á»™ game Ã—${v}`); return this.render();
      case "pick": this.sel = t.dataset.k; this.el.querySelectorAll('[data-list="items"] .dv-it').forEach((e) => e.classList.toggle("on", e.dataset.k === this.sel)); return this.showItem();
      case "bagAdd": return this.bagAdd(t.dataset.k);
      case "dongMo": {
        const x = this.item(this.sel); this.dong = this.dong && this.dong.k === this.sel ? null : x && { k: x.k, s: this.heCoDinh(x) ?? 0, L: [] };
        this.showItem(); if (this.dong) this.taiDx().then(() => { const b = this.el.querySelector("[data-dong]"); if (b) b.scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest" }); }).catch(() => {});
        return;
      }
      case "dongTao": return this.dongTao();
      case "dongMax": {
        const D = this.dong, x = D && this.item(D.k); if (!x || !this.dx) return;
        D.L.forEach((l, i) => { const g = this.dongChon(x.t, i, D.s).find((c) => c.a === l.a); if (g) { const r = this.dongRow(g, l.lv); l.v = Math.max(r.p[0][0], r.p[0][1]); } });
        return this.veDong();
      }
      case "wear": return this.wear(t.dataset.k, t.dataset.i == null ? null : +t.dataset.i);
      case "bagDel": { const i = +t.dataset.i; h.bag.splice(i, 1); api.save(); this.fillBag(); return this.refreshLive(); }
      case "facSet": return this.setFaction(val("fac"));
      case "skMax": return this.skillsMax(true);
      case "skReset": return this.skillsMax(false);
      case "skOpen": return api.openSkills();
      case "bookLearn": return this.books(true);
      case "bookForget": return this.books(false);
      case "looksReset": { const n = Object.keys(h.equip || {}).filter((s) => unwear(h, s)).length; h.looks = {}; api.applyLooks(); api.save(); this.fillBag(); this.refreshLive(); return api.msg(`ThÃ¡o ${n} mÃ³n vá» tÃºi`); }
    }
  }

  // Ä‘áº·t cáº¥p: Ä‘iá»ƒm tiá»m nÄƒng / ká»¹ nÄƒng tÃ­nh láº¡i theo cáº¥p má»›i (World.setLevel)
  setLevel(n) {
    const api = this.api, h = api.hero(), w = api.world();
    n = Math.max(1, Math.min(MAX_LV, Math.round(n) || 1));
    const up = n > h.lvl;
    w.setLevel(n);
    if (up) api.P.audio.ui("levelup");
    api.save(); api.msg(`Cáº¥p ${n} Â· ${h.pts} Ä‘iá»ƒm tiá»m nÄƒng chÆ°a cá»™ng`); this.refreshLive();
  }

  // kinh nghiá»‡m: nhÆ° giáº¿t quÃ¡i (World.gainExp â€” Ä‘á»§ má»‘c báº£ng client thÃ¬ lÃªn cáº¥p, +5 tiá»m nÄƒng +1 ká»¹ nÄƒng má»—i cáº¥p)
  addExp(n) {
    const api = this.api, h = api.hero(), lv0 = h.lvl;
    api.world().gainExp(n);
    api.save();
    if (h.lvl === lv0) api.msg(`Kinh nghiá»‡m +${fmt(n)}`);
    this.refreshLive();
  }

  // ---------- quÃ¡i ----------
  zoneOf(id) { return this.api.P.maps.zones.find((z) => z.kind === "chÃ­nh" && (z.m.includes(id) || z.boss === id)); }
  fillMobs() {
    const sel = this.el.querySelector('[data-in="mobId"]'); if (!sel) return;
    const P = this.api.P, w = this.api.world(), here = new Set([...w.zone.m, w.zone.boss]), q = fold(this.mob.q.trim());
    const list = Object.entries(P.mons).map(([id, d]) => ({ id: +id, d, here: here.has(+id) }))
      .filter((x) => !q || fold(x.d.n).includes(q) || String(x.id) === q)
      .sort((a, b) => b.here - a.here || a.d.n.localeCompare(b.d.n, "vi"));
    if (this.mob.id == null && list.length) this.mob.id = list[0].id;
    sel.innerHTML = list.map((x) => `<option value="${x.id}"${x.id === this.mob.id ? " selected" : ""}>${x.here ? "â˜… " : ""}${esc(x.d.n)} (#${x.id})</option>`).join("");
    this.mobInfo();
  }
  mobInfo() {
    const e = this.el.querySelector('[data-live="mobInfo"]'), d = this.api.P.mons[this.mob.id]; if (!e) return;
    if (!d) { e.textContent = ""; return; }
    const z = this.zoneOf(this.mob.id);
    e.textContent = `${d.n} Â· hÃ¬nh ${d.anim} Â· ${d.ranged ? "Ä‘Ã¡nh xa" : "cáº­n chiáº¿n"} Â· ${z ? (z.boss === this.mob.id ? "trÃ¹m " : "") + z.n + ` (${z.lo}â€“${z.hi})` : "khÃ´ng thuá»™c bÃ£i nÃ o"}`;
  }
  spawn() {
    const api = this.api, w = api.world(), p = w.player, M = this.mob;
    if (M.id == null || !api.P.mons[M.id]) return api.msg("Chá»n quÃ¡i trÆ°á»›c");
    const lvl = M.lvl === "" ? undefined : Math.max(1, Math.min(200, +M.lvl || 1));
    let n = 0;
    const series = M.series === "" ? undefined : +M.series;
    for (let i = 0; i < M.n; i++) if (w.spawnMob(M.boss, 0, { id: M.id, lvl, series, near: [p.x, p.y], aggro: M.aggro })) n++;
    api.msg(`Sinh ${n} ${api.P.mons[M.id].n}${lvl ? " cáº¥p " + lvl : ""}${series != null ? " há»‡ " + ["Kim", "Má»™c", "Thá»§y", "Há»a", "Thá»•"][series] : ""}${M.boss ? " (trÃ¹m)" : ""}`);
  }

  // ---------- Ä‘á»“ ----------
  // kho Ä‘á»“ dÃ¹ng chung (ItemDB náº¡p 1 láº§n; báº¥m láº¡i tháº» Äá»“ khi Ä‘ang táº£i khÃ´ng táº£i trÃ¹ng)
  async loadPack() {
    try {
      const p = await ItemDB.load();
      for (const x of p.items) if (!x._f) x._f = fold(x.n + " " + x.ln);
      this.pack = p;
      if (this.on && this.tab === "item") this.render();
    } catch (e) { const n = this.el.querySelector('[data-live="itemCount"]'); if (n) n.textContent = "KhÃ´ng táº£i Ä‘Æ°á»£c kho Ä‘á»“: " + e.message; }
  }
  item(k) { return ItemDB.item(k); }
  svText(x) { return [1, 2, 3].filter((s) => x.sv & (1 << (s - 1))).map((s) => "S" + s).join(","); }
  row(x, extra = "") {
    const g = this.pack.groups[x.gr] || "", col = GROUP_COL[g] || "#fff", ic = x.ic ? `<img loading="lazy" src="assets/web/icon/${esc(x.ic)}" alt="">` : "<img alt=\"\">";
    return `<div class="dv-it${x.k === this.sel ? " on" : ""}" data-act="pick" data-k="${esc(x.k)}">${ic}<div style="flex:1;min-width:0"><span style="color:${col}">${esc(x.n)}</span>` +
      `<small>${esc(this.pack.types[x.t] || "")} Â· cáº¥p ${x.lv} Â· ${esc(g)} Â· ${this.svText(x)}${SLOT_OF[x.t] ? (x.g ? " Â· máº·c Ä‘Æ°á»£c, hiá»‡n trÃªn ngÆ°á»i" : " Â· máº·c Ä‘Æ°á»£c") : ""}</small></div>${extra}</div>`;
  }
  fillItems() {
    const box = this.el.querySelector('[data-list="items"]'); if (!box || !this.pack) return;
    const F = this.f, h = this.api.hero(), q = fold(F.q.trim()).split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
    const svBit = F.sv === "all" ? 7 : 1 << ((F.sv === "hero" ? h.server : +F.sv) - 1);
    const hit = this.pack.items.filter((x) => (x.sv & svBit) && (F.t === "" || x.t === +F.t) && (!F.gr || this.pack.groups[x.gr] === F.gr) && q.every((w) => x._f.includes(w)));
    this.el.querySelector('[data-live="itemCount"]').textContent = `${fmt(hit.length)} mÃ³n${hit.length > LIST_MAX ? ` â€” hiá»‡n ${LIST_MAX} mÃ³n Ä‘áº§u, gÃµ thÃªm Ä‘á»ƒ lá»c` : ""}`;
    box.innerHTML = hit.slice(0, LIST_MAX).map((x) => this.row(x)).join("");
    this.fillBag();
    if (this.sel) this.showItem();
  }
  fillBag() {
    const box = this.el.querySelector('[data-list="bag"]'), h = this.api.hero(); if (!box || !this.pack) return;
    box.innerHTML = (h.bag || []).map((b, i) => { const x = this.item(b.k); return x ? this.row(x, `${SLOT_OF[x.t] ? `<button data-act="wear" data-k="${esc(x.k)}" data-i="${i}">Máº·c</button>` : ""}<button data-act="bagDel" data-i="${i}">Bá»</button>`) : ""; }).join("") || '<div class="dv-note">TÃºi trá»‘ng</div>';
  }
  async showItem() {
    const box = this.el.querySelector("[data-detail]"), x = this.item(this.sel); if (!box || !x) return;
    const h = this.api.hero(), g = this.pack.groups[x.gr] || "";
    const warn = [!(x.sv & (1 << (h.server - 1))) ? `khÃ´ng cÃ³ á»Ÿ S${h.server}` : "", x.x >= 0 && x.x !== (h.sex === "f" ? 1 : 0) ? (x.x ? "Ä‘á»“ ná»¯" : "Ä‘á»“ nam") : ""].filter(Boolean);
    const head = `<b style="color:${GROUP_COL[g] || "#fff"}">${esc(x.n)}</b>${warn.length ? ` <span class="t3">(${warn.join(", ")})</span>` : ""}\n` +
      `<span class="dv-note">${esc(x.k)} Â· ${esc(x.ln)}</span>`;
    const btn = `<div class="r"><button data-act="bagAdd" data-k="${esc(x.k)}">ThÃªm vÃ o tÃºi</button>${SLOT_OF[x.t] ? `<button data-act="wear" data-k="${esc(x.k)}">Máº·c thá»­</button>` : ""}` +
      `${DONG_LOAI(x) ? `<button data-act="dongMo"${this.dong && this.dong.k === x.k ? ' class="on"' : ""}>Táº¡o theo dÃ²ngâ€¦</button>` : ""}</div>`;
    this.veDong();
    box.innerHTML = head + "\nâ€¦" + btn;
    try {
      const T = await ItemDB.text(x.k);
      if (this.sel !== x.k) return;
      box.innerHTML = head + [["t1", T[0]], ["t2", T[1]], ["t3", T[2]]].filter(([, s]) => s).map(([c, s]) => `\n<span class="${c}">${esc(s)}</span>`).join("") + btn;
    } catch (e) { box.innerHTML = head + `\n<span class="t3">KhÃ´ng táº£i Ä‘Æ°á»£c chá»¯ mÃ³n: ${esc(e.message)}</span>` + btn; }
  }
  bagAdd(k) {
    const api = this.api, h = api.hero(), x = this.item(k); if (!x) return;
    (h.bag = h.bag || []).push({ k, n: 1, dev: true });
    api.save(); api.msg(`ThÃªm ${x.n} vÃ o tÃºi`); this.fillBag(); this.refreshLive();
  }

  // ---------- táº¡o trang bá»‹ theo dÃ²ng tá»± chá»n (anh 29/10 "dev tool thÃªm cÃ¡i táº¡o trang bá»‹ theo dÃ²ng tá»± chá»n") ----------
  // Báº£ng dÃ²ng xanh cá»§a client (assets/data/dong-xanh.json â€” magicattrib.txt, mÃ¡y chá»§ gieo dÃ²ng tá»« chÃ­nh báº£ng nÃ y: may-chu/do.js gieoDong). Luáº­t
  // nhÆ° mÃ¡y chá»§: dÃ²ng 1, 3, 5 tiá»n tá»‘, 2, 4, 6 háº­u tá»‘ (dÃ²ng áº©n â€” chá»‰ thuá»™c tÃ­nh cÃ³ há»‡ = há»‡ cá»§a mÃ³n); thuá»™c tÃ­nh cÃ³ trá»ng sá»‘ > 0 á»Ÿ loáº¡i mÃ³n
  // (w[t]); 1 mÃ³n khÃ´ng cÃ³ 2 dÃ²ng cÃ¹ng thuá»™c tÃ­nh; sá»‘ trong khoáº£ng cá»§a cáº¥p dÃ²ng (p[0]). MÃ³n vÃ o tÃºi nhÆ° "ThÃªm vÃ o tÃºi" (api.save -> mÃ¡y chá»§
  // quan-tri/nv, chá»‰ tÃ i khoáº£n quáº£n trá»‹; mÃ¡y chá»§ giá»¯ dÃ²ng vÃ¬ khÃ³a cÃ³ trong báº£ng). Há»‡ cá»‘ Ä‘á»‹nh cá»§a mÃ³n (do-goc series / ngá»±a) thÃ¬ khÃ´ng chá»n há»‡.
  taiDx() { return (this._dx = this._dx || fetch("assets/data/dong-xanh.json").then((r) => r.json()).then((j) => { this.dx = j; })); }
  heCoDinh(x) { return ItemDB.base(x.k).series ?? (x.t === 10 && x.s >= 0 ? x.s : null); }
  // thuá»™c tÃ­nh chá»n Ä‘Æ°á»£c á»Ÿ dÃ²ng i cá»§a mÃ³n loáº¡i t, há»‡ s: [{ a, k, rows: [cáº¥p tÄƒng dáº§n] }]
  dongChon(t, i, s) {
    const pre = i % 2 === 0 ? 1 : 0, by = new Map();
    for (const r of this.dx.rows) {
      if (!(r.w[t] > 0) || r.pre !== pre || (!pre && r.se !== s)) continue;
      if (!by.has(r.a)) by.set(r.a, { a: r.a, k: r.k, rows: [] });
      by.get(r.a).rows.push(r);
    }
    for (const g of by.values()) g.rows.sort((p, q) => p.lv - q.lv);
    return [...by.values()].sort((p, q) => this.tenDong(p.k).localeCompare(this.tenDong(q.k), "vi"));
  }
  // cÃ¢u cá»§a dÃ²ng (magicdesc cá»§a client â€” tip.json) vá»›i chá»— sá»‘ thay báº±ng x
  tenDong(k) {
    const M = (this.api.P.skillTip || {}).magic || {};
    return String(M[ItemDB.serDmg[k] || k] || k).replace(/<\/?color(?:=[^>]*)?>/gi, "").replace(/#[dsxm]1[+\-~]?/g, "x");
  }
  dongRow(g, lv) { return g.rows.find((r) => r.lv === lv) || g.rows[g.rows.length - 1]; }
  // Ä‘á»•i há»‡: bá» tá»« dÃ²ng Ä‘áº§u tiÃªn khÃ´ng cÃ²n há»£p (háº­u tá»‘ cá»§a há»‡ cÅ©) trá»Ÿ Ä‘i
  dongSua() {
    const D = this.dong, x = this.item(D.k);
    const i = D.L.findIndex((l, j) => !this.dongChon(x.t, j, D.s).some((c) => c.a === l.a));
    if (i >= 0) D.L.length = i;
  }
  veDong() {
    const box = this.el && this.el.querySelector("[data-dong]"); if (!box) return;
    const D = this.dong, x = D && this.item(D.k);
    if (!x || D.k !== this.sel) { box.innerHTML = ""; return; }
    if (!this.dx) { box.innerHTML = `<div class="dv-note">Äang táº£i báº£ng dÃ²ng xanhâ€¦</div>`; this.taiDx().then(() => this.veDong()).catch((e) => { box.innerHTML = `<div class="dv-note">KhÃ´ng táº£i Ä‘Æ°á»£c báº£ng dÃ²ng xanh: ${esc(e.message)}</div>`; }); return; }
    const fixed = this.heCoDinh(x);
    let html = `<div class="r"><b>Táº¡o ${esc(x.n)} theo dÃ²ng tá»± chá»n</b></div>
      <div class="r"><span class="k">NgÅ© hÃ nh</span>${fixed != null ? `<span>${HE[fixed]} (cá»‘ Ä‘á»‹nh cá»§a mÃ³n)</span>`
        : `<select data-in="dongS">${HE.map((n, i) => `<option value="${i}"${i === D.s ? " selected" : ""}>${n}</option>`).join("")}</select>`}</div>`;
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      if (i > 0 && !D.L[i - 1]) break; // dÃ²ng trÆ°á»›c cÃ²n trá»‘ng
      const C = this.dongChon(x.t, i, D.s), l = D.L[i], g = l && C.find((c) => c.a === l.a);
      const co = new Set(D.L.filter((q, j) => q && j !== i).map((q) => q.a)); // thuá»™c tÃ­nh Ä‘Ã£ cÃ³ á»Ÿ dÃ²ng khÃ¡c: khÃ´ng chá»n trÃ¹ng
      html += `<div class="r"><span class="k">DÃ²ng ${i + 1} <small>${i % 2 ? "háº­u tá»‘" : "tiá»n tá»‘"}</small></span>
        <select data-in="dongA" data-i="${i}" style="flex:1;min-width:0"><option value="">â€” khÃ´ng â€”</option>${C.map((c) => `<option value="${c.a}"${g && c.a === g.a ? " selected" : ""}${co.has(c.a) ? " disabled" : ""}>${esc(this.tenDong(c.k))}${co.has(c.a) ? " (Ä‘Ã£ cÃ³)" : ""}</option>`).join("")}</select>`;
      html += `</div>`;
      // cáº¥p dÃ²ng + sá»‘ á»Ÿ hÃ ng dÆ°á»›i (báº£ng cÃ´ng cá»¥ háº¹p â€” Ã´ thuá»™c tÃ­nh Ä‘Æ°á»£c rá»™ng cáº£ hÃ ng)
      if (g) { const r = this.dongRow(g, l.lv); html += `<div class="r" style="padding-left:82px"><select data-in="dongLv" data-i="${i}">${g.rows.map((q) => `<option value="${q.lv}"${q.lv === r.lv ? " selected" : ""}>cáº¥p dÃ²ng ${q.lv}</option>`).join("")}</select>
        <input data-in="dongV" data-i="${i}" type="number" style="width:72px" value="${l.v}"><small>khoáº£ng ${r.p[0][0]}â€“${r.p[0][1]}</small></div>`; }
    }
    html += `<div class="dv-note">DÃ²ng 1, 3, 5 tiá»n tá»‘; 2, 4, 6 háº­u tá»‘ = dÃ²ng áº©n (chá»‰ thuá»™c tÃ­nh há»£p há»‡ cá»§a mÃ³n). 1 mÃ³n khÃ´ng cÃ³ 2 dÃ²ng cÃ¹ng thuá»™c tÃ­nh. Sá»‘ máº·c Ä‘á»‹nh = má»©c cao nháº¥t cá»§a cáº¥p dÃ²ng.</div>
      <div class="r"><button data-act="dongTao">Táº¡o vÃ o tÃºi</button><button data-act="dongMax">Má»i dÃ²ng sá»‘ cao nháº¥t</button></div>`;
    box.innerHTML = html;
  }
  dongInput(t, changed) {
    const D = this.dong, x = D && this.item(D.k); if (!x || !this.dx) return;
    const k = t.dataset.in, i = +t.dataset.i;
    if (k === "dongV") { if (D.L[i]) D.L[i].v = t.value; return; }
    if (!changed) return; // Ã´ chá»n: Ä‘á»£i change (váº½ láº¡i thay Ã´)
    if (k === "dongS") { D.s = +t.value; this.dongSua(); }
    else if (k === "dongA") {
      const g = t.value === "" ? null : this.dongChon(x.t, i, D.s).find((c) => c.a === +t.value);
      if (!g) D.L.length = i; else { const r = g.rows[g.rows.length - 1]; D.L[i] = { a: g.a, lv: r.lv, v: r.p[0][1] }; }
    } else if (k === "dongLv" && D.L[i]) { const g = this.dongChon(x.t, i, D.s).find((c) => c.a === D.L[i].a), r = g && this.dongRow(g, +t.value); if (r) { D.L[i].lv = r.lv; D.L[i].v = r.p[0][1]; } }
    this.veDong();
  }
  dongTao() {
    const api = this.api, h = api.hero(), D = this.dong, x = D && this.item(D.k); if (!x || !this.dx) return;
    const s = this.heCoDinh(x) ?? D.s, d = [], dung = new Set();
    for (let i = 0; i < D.L.length; i++) {
      const l = D.L[i], g = this.dongChon(x.t, i, s).find((c) => c.a === l.a);
      if (!g) return api.msg(`DÃ²ng ${i + 1}: thuá»™c tÃ­nh khÃ´ng há»£p vá»‹ trÃ­ / há»‡ cá»§a mÃ³n â€” chá»n láº¡i`);
      if (dung.has(l.a)) return api.msg(`DÃ²ng ${i + 1}: trÃ¹ng thuá»™c tÃ­nh vá»›i dÃ²ng trÆ°á»›c (1 mÃ³n khÃ´ng cÃ³ 2 dÃ²ng cÃ¹ng thuá»™c tÃ­nh)`);
      dung.add(l.a);
      const [a, b] = this.dongRow(g, l.lv).p[0], lo = Math.min(a, b), hi = Math.max(a, b);
      d.push([g.k, Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, Math.round(+l.v || 0)))]);
    }
    (h.bag = h.bag || []).push({ k: x.k, s, d, dev: true });
    api.save(); api.msg(`Táº¡o ${x.n} há»‡ ${HE[s]}, ${d.length} dÃ²ng vÃ o tÃºi`); this.fillBag(); this.refreshLive();
  }
  // máº·c thá»­ tá»« danh má»¥c (from = null) hoáº·c máº·c mÃ³n trong tÃºi (from = chá»‰ sá»‘ tÃºi; mÃ³n cÅ© á»Ÿ Ã´ Ä‘Ã³ tráº£ vá» tÃºi)
  wear(k, from = null) {
    const api = this.api, h = api.hero(), x = this.item(k); if (!x) return;
    const slot = wear(h, k, from);
    if (!slot) return api.msg(`${x.n}: khÃ´ng máº·c Ä‘Æ°á»£c`);
    const look = api.applyLooks();
    api.save(); this.fillBag(); this.refreshLive();
    const notes = x.g ? (look.notes || []).filter((s) => PARTS[x.g].includes(s.split(" ")[0])) : [];
    api.msg(`Máº·c ${x.n} (Ã´ ${slot}${x.g ? `, kiá»ƒu dÃ¡ng ${x.g} #${x.id}` : ""})` + (notes.length ? " â€” thiáº¿u hÃ¬nh: " + notes.join("; ") : ""));

export function hanhDong(hint) {
  const ds = [];
  for (const dong of [].concat(hint || [])) for (const d of String(dong).split(" Â· ")) {
    for (const [re, loai, mod, th] of HANH) {
      const m = re.exec(d.trim()); if (!m) continue;
      const chu = m[1].split(/ \(| â€” /)[0].trim();
      if (chu && !/^cáº§m lÃªn$/i.test(chu)) ds.push({ chu: chu[0].toUpperCase() + chu.slice(1), loai, mod, th });
      break;
    }
  }
  return ds.sort((a, b) => a.th - b.th);
}

// Cá»¡ giao diá»‡n (_datCo) dÃ¹ng initial-scale cá»§a viewport; lÃºc toÃ n mÃ n hÃ¬nh (Fullscreen API) Chromium Ã©p tá»‰ lá»‡ trang = 1 -> cáº£nh láº«n nÃºt to ra 1 / cá»¡
// láº§n. BÃ¹: <html> zoom = cá»¡ (Z), vÃ  cho mÃ£ game tháº¥y tá»a Ä‘á»™ nhÆ° lÃºc tá»‰ lá»‡ trang = cá»¡: innerWidth / innerHeight, getBoundingClientRect, clientX /
// clientY (x / y) cá»§a sá»± kiá»‡n chuá»™t / cháº¡m tháº­t chia Z, elementFromPoint nhÃ¢n Z (zoom chuáº©n cá»§a Chromium: 4 thá»© Ä‘Ã³ theo Ä‘iá»ƒm mÃ n hÃ¬nh, cÃ²n kÃ­ch
// thÆ°á»›c CSS theo Ä‘iá»ƒm Ä‘Ã£ zoom â€” Ä‘o 31/10). Sá»± kiá»‡n tá»± táº¡o (_chamâ€¦) Ä‘Ã£ mang tá»a Ä‘á»™ cá»§a game -> giá»¯ nguyÃªn. Z = 1: nhÆ° trÃ¬nh duyá»‡t
let Z = 1, daCai = false;
function caiZoom() {
  daCai = true;
  const d = (o, k) => Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(o, k);
  for (const k of ["innerWidth", "innerHeight"]) { const g = d(window, k).get; Object.defineProperty(window, k, { configurable: true, enumerable: true, get() { return g.call(window) / Z; } }); }
  const rect = Element.prototype.getBoundingClientRect;
  Element.prototype.getBoundingClientRect = function () { const r = rect.call(this); return Z === 1 ? r : new DOMRect(r.x / Z, r.y / Z, r.width / Z, r.height / Z); };
  const efp = Document.prototype.elementFromPoint;
  Document.prototype.elementFromPoint = function (x, y) { return efp.call(this, x * Z, y * Z); };
  const doi = (P, k, thatThoi) => { const g = d(P, k).get; Object.defineProperty(P, k, { configurable: true, enumerable: true, get() { const v = g.call(this); return Z === 1 || (thatThoi && !this.isTrusted) ? v : v / Z; } }); };
  for (const k of ["clientX", "clientY", "x", "y"]) doi(MouseEvent.prototype, k, true);
  if (typeof Touch !== "undefined") for (const k of ["clientX", "clientY"]) doi(Touch.prototype, k, false);
}
function datZoom(z) {
  if (Math.abs(z - Z) < 1e-4) return;
  if (!daCai) caiZoom();
  Z = z; document.documentElement.style.zoom = z === 1 ? "" : String(z);
  dispatchEvent(new Event("resize"));
}

// giá»¯ giao diá»‡n mÃ¡y tÃ­nh nhÆ° trÆ°á»›c (mÃ n ngang tháº¥p â‰¤ 500 váº«n theo _datMode)
function laDienThoai() {
  const ua = navigator.userAgent || "", nho = Math.min(screen.width, screen.height) < 600;
  return nho && (/iPhone|iPod|Android.+Mobile|Windows Phone|Mobile.+Safari/i.test(ua) || (navigator.maxTouchPoints > 0 && matchMedia("(pointer: coarse)").matches));
}

  _cuaBdl() {
    const cv = (this.bdlCv = this.el.querySelector(".dt-bdl canvas"));
    let c = null;
    cv.addEventListener("pointerdown", (e) => {
      const B = this.bdl; if (!B || c) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      try { cv.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch {}
      c = { id: e.pointerId, x0: e.clientX, y0: e.clientY, vx: B.vx, vy: B.vy, keo: false };
    });
    cv.addEventListener("pointermove", (e) => {
      const B = this.bdl; if (!c || e.pointerId !== c.id || !B) return;
      const dx = e.clientX - c.x0, dy = e.clientY - c.y0;
      if (!c.keo && Math.hypot(dx, dy) > 10) c.keo = true;
      if (c.keo && B.keo) { B.vx = c.vx - dx / B.k; B.vy = c.vy - dy / B.k; this._veBdl(true); }
    });
    const tha = (e) => {
      if (!c || e.pointerId !== c.id) return;
      const B = this.bdl, keo = c.keo; c = null;

  const ok = ItemDB.pack.items.filter((x) => x.gr === "xanh" && x.t === t && (p == null || x.p === p) && (ItemDB.base(x.k).lv || 1) <= L);
  if (!ok.length) return null;
  const cap = Math.max(1, Math.min(10, Math.floor(L / 10))), cls = ok.map((x) => ItemDB.base(x.k).cl || 1).filter((c) => c <= cap);
  const cl = cls.length ? Math.max(...cls) : Math.min(...ok.map((x) => ItemDB.base(x.k).cl || 1));
  const L2 = ok.filter((x) => (ItemDB.base(x.k).cl || 1) === cl);
  return L2[Math.floor(Math.random() * L2.length)];
}
function mac(h, L, t, p) {
  const x = chonNen(L, t, p); if (!x) return;
  const slot = wear(h, x.k); if (!slot) return;
  const s = ri(0, 4);
  Object.assign(h.equip[slot], { u: ++h.uN, s, d: gieoDong(t, ItemDB.base(x.k).cl || 1, s, SO_DONG), m: L });
}

// NhÃ¢n váº­t máº«u phÃ¡i fac (khÃ³a skills.json factions) cáº¥p L. DÆ°á»›i cáº¥p 10 (chÆ°a nháº­p phÃ¡i): khÃ´ng vÃµ cÃ´ng, Ä‘Ã¡nh Ä‘Ã²n thÆ°á»ng.
export function nhanVatMau(P, fac, L) {
  const F = P.factions.find((f) => f.key === fac), lo = LO[fac], series = F ? F.series : 0;
  const st = P.chr.start.find((s) => s.series === series && s.sex === 0) || P.chr.start[0];
  const h = { name: "Máº«u " + fac + " " + L, sex: "m", series, start: { ...st }, lvl: L, exp: 0, gold: 0, attr: { str: 0, dex: 0, vit: 0, eng: 0 },
    equip: {}, bag: [], looks: {}, uN: 0, skills: {}, oChieu: {}, books: [], auto: AUTO_DEF(), mau: { fac, L } };
  if (F && L >= 10) { h.fac = F.id ?? P.factions.indexOf(F); h.facKey = fac; }
  // Ä‘iá»ƒm tiá»m nÄƒng
  const tot = 5 * (L - 1), plan = DIEM[lo.kieu]; let used = 0;
  for (const [k, f] of Object.entries(plan)) { h.attr[k] = Math.floor(tot * f); used += h.attr[k]; }
  h.attr.vit += tot - used;
  // Ä‘á»“: vÅ© khÃ­ Ä‘Ãºng lá»™ + 9 Ã´
  mac(h, L, lo.vk[0], lo.vk[1]);
  for (const [t] of O_DO) mac(h, L, t, null); // nháº«n thá»© 2: wear tá»± vÃ o Ring2
  if (h.facKey) chiaDiem(P, h, fac, L);
  return h;
}

// Ä‘iá»ƒm ká»¹ nÄƒng (cáº¥p âˆ’ 1): chiÃªu chÃ­nh tá»‘i Ä‘a â†’ chiÃªu há»— trá»£ chiÃªu chÃ­nh (addskilldamage) â†’ bá»‹ Ä‘á»™ng há»£p vÅ© khÃ­ â†’ 3 bÃ¹a lá»£i â†’ vÃ²ng sÃ¡ng â†’
// chiÃªu há»“i mÃ¡u â†’ 1 bÃ¹a háº¡i; má»—i chiÃªu tá»›i cáº¥p tá»‘i Ä‘a cá»§a nÃ³
function chiaDiem(P, h, fac, L) {
  const db = P.skillDb, F = P.factions.find((f) => f.key === fac), lo = LO[fac], wk = vuKhi(h);
  const coThe = F.skills.filter((id) => db[id] && (db[id].req || 0) <= L && (db[id].req || 0) <= 120);
  let con = L - 1;
  const sk = h.skills, them = (id, cap = 20) => { if (!id || !db[id] || sk[id] || con <= 0) return; const n = Math.min(cap, db[id].max || 20, con); if (n > 0) { sk[id] = n; con -= n; } };
  const ch = [...lo.chieu].reverse().find(([r]) => r <= L), main = ch ? ch[1] : 0;
  them(main);
  const hoTro = coThe.filter((id) => Object.entries(db[id].lv || {}).some(([k, a]) => /^addskilldamage\d+$/.test(k) && a.some((p) => p && p[0] === main)));
  for (const id of hoTro) them(id);
  for (const id of coThe) if (kindOf(db[id], db) === "passive" && eqtOk(db[id], wk)) them(id);
  const bua = coThe.filter((id) => kindOf(db[id], db) === "buff" && !isHeal(db[id], 1) && eqtOk(db[id], wk)).slice(-3);
  for (const id of bua) them(id);
  const vong = coThe.filter((id) => kindOf(db[id], db) === "aura").pop();
  them(vong);
  const hoi = coThe.find((id) => kindOf(db[id], db) === "buff" && isHeal(db[id], 1));
  them(hoi);
  // bÃ¹a háº¡i ra trÆ°á»›c lÃªn con má»›i nháº¯m (Trá»£ Thá»§ "BÃ¹a háº¡i trÆ°á»›c"): chiÃªu bÃ¹a háº¡i há»c Ä‘Æ°á»£c cao nháº¥t
  const hai = coThe.filter((id) => kindOf(db[id], db) === "curse" && eqtOk(db[id], wk)).pop();
  them(hai);
  const A = h.auto.danh;
  A.chieu = main; A.bua = [0, 1, 2].map((i) => (bua[i] && sk[bua[i]] ? bua[i] : 0)); A.vong = vong && sk[vong] ? vong : 0; A.hai = [hai && sk[hai] ? hai : 0, 0, 0];
  A.hoi = hoi && sk[hoi] ? { on: 1, id: hoi, pct: 50 } : { on: 0, id: 0, pct: 50 };
  h.oChieu = { trai: main, phai: A.vong || 0 };
}
function vuKhi(h) {
  const w = h.equip && h.equip.Weapon, x = w && ItemDB.item(w.k);
  if (!x) return -1;
  if (x.t === 1) return 100 + (x.p | 0);
  return (x.p | 0) === 6 ? -1 : x.p | 0;
}

// Cháº¡y bÃ£i zone vá»›i nhÃ¢n váº­t h trong `phut` phÃºt game. heSo = há»‡ sá»‘ kinh nghiá»‡m (cau-hinh.json kinhNghiem), canBang = cau-hinh.json
// canBang (há»‡ sá»‘ theo bÃ£i + trÃ¹m â€” nhÆ° mÃ¡y chá»§). Tráº£ sá»‘ má»—i giá».
export async function doBai(P, zone, h, { phut = 10, heSo = 3.5, canBang = null, cfg = {}, noiCong = 0 } = {}) {
  const CB = (canBang && canBang.bai && canBang.bai[zone.id]) || {};
  await napDong();
  const T = { tiLeTien: 0.25, tienTB: 10, tienTrum: 50, roiThuong: 0.01, roiTrum: 0.2, giaBan: 20, dongThuong: 0.39, dongTrum: 1.6, ...cfg };
  const Ps = Object.create(P); Ps.audio = IM; Ps.npc = Object.create(P.npc); Ps.npc.ensure = () => {}; // khÃ´ng táº£i hÃ¬nh quÃ¡i
  const map = await GameMap.load(P.maps, zone.map);
  const w = new World(Ps, map, zone, h, { npcs: [], vcOpen: true, canBang, noiCong }); // noiCong: luáº­t riÃªng S1 Ná»™i cÃ´ng (cau-hinh.json)
  w.auto = true; w.neo = [w.player.x, w.player.y];
  const L = h.lvl, need = P.chr.exp[L - 1] || Infinity, kq = { quai: 0, trum: 0, kn: 0, tien: 0, chet: 0, sl: 0, nl: 0, tienThuoc: 0, giay: 0 };
  w.onKill = (m) => {
    kq[m.boss ? "trum" : "quai"]++;
    const dl = m.lvl - L, k = dl <= -10 ? 0.5 : dl >= 10 ? 0.1 : 1;
    kq.kn += Math.floor((m.exp || 0) * k * heSo * (CB.kinhNghiem ?? 1)); // trÃ¹m: m.exp Ä‘Ã£ nhÃ¢n há»‡ sá»‘ trÃ¹m (World.spawnMob)
    kq.tien += m.boss ? m.lvl * T.tienTrum * (CB.tien ?? 1) + T.roiTrum * T.giaBan * m.lvl * (1 + 2 * T.dongTrum)
      : T.tiLeTien * m.lvl * T.tienTB * (CB.tien ?? 1) + T.roiThuong * T.giaBan * m.lvl * (1 + 2 * T.dongThuong);
  };
  let chet = false;
  w.onRevive = () => { chet = true; };
  const th = (THUOC.filter(([c]) => L >= c).pop() || THUOC[0]), xSL = ItemDB.item(th[1]), xNL = ItemDB.item(th[2]);
  const end = phut * 60, p = w.player;
  let t = 0;
  while (t < end) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 1800 && t < end; i++) {
      w.update(STEP); t += STEP;
      if (chet) {
        chet = false; kq.chet++; t += PHAT_CHET;
        kq.kn -= Math.min(500000, Math.floor((need * 10) / 1000));
        const s = map.randomSpot(Math.random); if (s) [p.x, p.y] = s;
        p.hp = p.hpMax; p.mp = p.mpMax; p.deadT = 0; p.reviving = false; p.target = null; p.path = null; p.cast = null; w.setAct(p, "stand");
        w.neo = [p.x, p.y];
        for (const m of w.mobs) { m.aggro = false; m.target = null; }
      }
      if (p.hp > 0 && !p.potHp && p.hp < p.hpMax * SL_UONG && xSL && w.drink(xSL)) { kq.sl++; kq.tienThuoc += xSL.gia || 0; }
      if (p.hp > 0 && !p.potMp && p.mp < p.mpMax * NL_UONG && xNL && w.drink(xNL)) { kq.nl++; kq.tienThuoc += xNL.gia || 0; }
    }
    await nhuong();
  }
  kq.giay = t;
  const g = 3600 / t, r = (v) => Math.round(v * g);
  return {
    bai: zone.n, lo: zone.lo, hi: zone.hi, fac: h.mau && h.mau.fac, cap: L,
    quaiGio: r(kq.quai + kq.trum), trumGio: r(kq.trum), chetGio: +(kq.chet * g).toFixed(2), knGio: r(kq.kn), tienGio: r(kq.tien),
    thuocGio: r(kq.sl + kq.nl), tienThuocGio: r(kq.tienThuoc), mau: p.hpMax, dmg: p.dmg, chieu: h.auto.danh.chieu, kyNang: { ...h.skills },
    // Ä‘á»™ bá»n (26/10): sá»‘ láº§n ra Ä‘Ã²n / bá»‹ Ä‘Ã¡nh trÃºng máº¥t mÃ¡u / sang vÃ¹ng báº£n Ä‘á»“ khÃ¡c má»—i giá» (World.hao â€” may-chu/do.js hao)
    danhGio: r(w.hao[0]), trungGio: r(w.hao[1]), vungGio: r(w.hao[2]),
    // luyá»‡n ká»¹ nÄƒng (29/10): sá»‘ láº§n chiÃªu luyá»‡n trÃºng quÃ¡i má»—i giá» (World.luyenDem â€” vocong.js misHit)
    luyenGio: Object.fromEntries([...(w.luyenDem || new Map())].map(([id, n]) => [id, r(n)])),
  };
}

// Äo cáº£ loáº¡t: má»—i bÃ£i chÃ­nh (bai = danh sÃ¡ch mÃ£ bÃ£i: cáº£ bÃ£i phá»¥), nhÃ¢n váº­t cáº¥p giá»¯a bÃ£i (cáº¥p tháº¥p nháº¥t + 5) cá»§a 10 phÃ¡i -> trung vá»‹ má»—i
// bÃ£i. onTien(sá»‘ lÆ°á»£t xong)
export async function doCacBai(P, { phut = 15, heSo = 3.5, canBang = null, bai = null, onTien = null } = {}) {
  await napDong();
  const med = (a) => { const s = [...a].sort((x, y) => x - y); return s[Math.floor(s.length / 2)]; };
  const zones = P.maps.zones.filter((z) => (bai ? bai.includes(z.id) : z.kind === "chÃ­nh")).sort((a, b) => a.lo - b.lo), out = [];
  let n = 0;
  for (const z of zones) {
    const L = Math.min(200, z.lo + 5), rs = [];
    for (const f of L < 10 ? ["shaolin"] : Object.keys(LO)) { rs.push(await doBai(P, z, nhanVatMau(P, f, L), { phut, heSo, canBang })); if (onTien) onTien(++n); }
    const k = (key) => med(rs.map((r) => r[key]));
    out.push({ id: z.id, bai: z.n, cap: L, lo: z.lo, hi: z.hi, quaiGio: k("quaiGio"), quaiMin: Math.min(...rs.map((r) => r.quaiGio)), quaiMax: Math.max(...rs.map((r) => r.quaiGio)),
      chetGio: k("chetGio"), knGio: k("knGio"), tienGio: k("tienGio"), tienThuocGio: k("tienThuocGio"), phai: Object.fromEntries(rs.map((r) => [r.fac, r.quaiGio])) });
  }
  return out;
}

// Hiá»‡u á»©ng trÃºng Ä‘Ã²n cá»§a client (kho assets/web/fx â€” tools/build-fx-pack.mjs). Má»—i hiá»‡u á»©ng = 1 Ä‘áº¡n cá»§a settings/missles.txt:
// hÃ¬nh lÃºc trÃºng (AnimFile4) xáº¿p ngang cÃ¡c khung, Ä‘iá»ƒm neo cx / cy Ä‘áº·t vÃ o Ä‘iá»ƒm trÃºng, nÃ¢ng lÃªn MissleHeight; 1 khung má»—i `interval`
// vÃ²ng engine (18 vÃ²ng / giÃ¢y); váº½ Ã— scale nhÆ° má»i hÃ¬nh kho web.
// ÄÃ²n thÆ°á»ng cá»§a nhÃ¢n váº­t theo vÅ© khÃ­ (clientweaponskill.txt): weaponFx(kiá»ƒu dÃ¡ng vÅ© khÃ­) -> Ä‘áº¡n (63 tay khÃ´ng / kiáº¿m / Ä‘aoâ€¦, 64
// thÆ°Æ¡ng / cÃ´n); tiáº¿ng trÃºng cá»§a Ä‘áº¡n (náº¿u client cÃ³ file): sound(Ä‘áº¡n) -> Ä‘Æ°á»ng dáº«n cho GameAudio.play.
// Ãm khÃ­ (mÃ³n loáº¡i "VÅ© khÃ­ táº§m xa"): basic(kiá»ƒu dÃ¡ng, true) -> Ä‘áº¡n 65 táº§m 320, cÃ³ hÃ¬nh bay (AnimFile2, 16 hÆ°á»›ng) â€” drawFly váº½ Ä‘áº¡n Ä‘ang
// bay, flight(Ä‘áº¡n) = tá»‘c Ä‘á»™ / thá»i gian sá»‘ng theo client.
