const BASE = "assets/web/fx/";
const TICK = 1 / 18;

export class FxPack {
  static async load(base = BASE) {
    const r = await fetch(base + "fx.json");
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error("KhÃ´ng Ä‘á»c Ä‘Æ°á»£c fx.json");
    const meta = await r.json(), imgs = {}, flyImgs = {};
    const img = (file, to, id) => new Promise((ok) => { const im = new Image(); im.onload = im.onerror = ok; im.src = base + file; to[id] = im; });
    await Promise.all(Object.entries(meta.fx).flatMap(([id, f]) => [img(f.file, imgs, id), f.fly ? img(f.fly.file, flyImgs, id) : null]));
    return new FxPack(meta, imgs, flyImgs);
  }
  constructor(meta, imgs, flyImgs = {}) { this.M = meta; this.imgs = imgs; this.flyImgs = flyImgs; }
  has(id) { return !!this.M.fx[id]; }
  weaponFx(lookId) { return (this.M.weapon || {})[lookId] || 63; } // kiá»ƒu dÃ¡ng ngoÃ i báº£ng (Ä‘á»“ Ä‘á»i má»›i): Ä‘Ã²n thÆ°á»ng 53 -> Ä‘áº¡n 63
  sound(id) { const f = this.M.fx[id]; return f && f.sound ? "../fx/" + f.sound : null; } // GameAudio.play tÃ­nh tá»« assets/web/sound/
  // Ä‘Ã²n thÆ°á»ng theo vÅ© khÃ­ Ä‘ang cáº§m: lookId = kiá»ƒu dÃ¡ng vÅ© khÃ­, ranged = mÃ³n loáº¡i "VÅ© khÃ­ táº§m xa" (Ã¡m khÃ­; kiá»ƒu dÃ¡ng cá»§a Ã¡m khÃ­ láº«n vá»›i
  // vÅ© khÃ­ cáº­n chiáº¿n nÃªn pháº£i xÃ©t loáº¡i mÃ³n) -> { fx: Ä‘áº¡n, range: AttackRadius cá»§a vÃµ cÃ´ng (Ä‘Æ¡n vá»‹ client), fly: Ä‘áº¡n bay tá»›i má»¥c tiÃªu }
  basic(lookId, ranged) {
    const id = ranged && this.M.ranged ? this.M.ranged : this.weaponFx(lookId), f = this.M.fx[id];
    const sk = Object.values(this.M.skill || {}).find((s) => s.fx === id);
    return { fx: id, range: sk ? sk.range : 75, fly: !!(f && f.fly) };
  }
  // Ä‘áº¡n bay: { speed: Ä‘Æ¡n vá»‹ client / vÃ²ng engine, life: sá»‘ vÃ²ng sá»‘ng (háº¿t vÃ²ng chÆ°a tá»›i má»¥c tiÃªu thÃ¬ máº¥t) }
  flight(id) { const f = this.M.fx[id]; return f && f.fly ? { speed: f.speed, life: f.life } : null; }
  duration(id) { const f = this.M.fx[id]; return f ? f.n * f.interval * TICK : 0; }
  // t = giÃ¢y tá»« lÃºc trÃºng; (x, y) = Ä‘iá»ƒm trÃºng trÃªn báº£n Ä‘á»“; h = Ä‘á»™ cao Ä‘áº¡n (MissleHeight, Ä‘Æ¡n vá»‹ client)
  draw(ctx, id, t, x, y, h = 10) {
    const f = this.M.fx[id], im = this.imgs[id];
    if (!f || !im || !im.complete) return;
    const k = Math.floor(t / (f.interval * TICK));
    if (k >= f.n) return;
    const s = this.M.scale, prev = ctx.globalCompositeOperation;
    if (f.blend === "add") ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "lighter";
    ctx.drawImage(im, k * f.w, 0, f.w, f.h, Math.round(x - f.cx * s), Math.round(y - (f.cy + h) * s), Math.round(f.w * s), Math.round(f.h * s));
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = prev;
  }
  // Ä‘áº¡n Ä‘ang bay á»Ÿ (x, y) trÃªn máº·t Ä‘áº¥t (nÃ¢ng lÃªn MissleHeight); (dx, dy) = hÆ°á»›ng bay theo logic (dy Ä‘Ã£ Ã— 2 nhÆ° ldist); t = giÃ¢y Ä‘Ã£ bay
  drawFly(ctx, id, dx, dy, t, x, y) {
    const f = this.M.fx[id], fl = f && f.fly, im = this.flyImgs[id];
    if (!fl || !im || !im.complete) return;
    const per = Math.max(1, Math.floor(fl.n / fl.dirs)), dir = dirOfN(dx, dy, fl.dirs);
    const k = dir * per + (Math.floor(t / (fl.interval * TICK)) % per);
    const s = this.M.scale, prev = ctx.globalCompositeOperation;
    if (fl.blend === "add") ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "lighter";
    ctx.drawImage(im, k * fl.w, 0, fl.w, fl.h, Math.round(x - fl.cx * s), Math.round(y - (fl.cy + f.height) * s), Math.round(fl.w * s), Math.round(fl.h * s));
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = prev;
  }
}

// hÆ°á»›ng trong n hÆ°á»›ng theo vÃ©c-tÆ¡ (dx, dy): 0 = xuá»‘ng, theo chiá»u kim Ä‘á»“ng há»“ â€” giá»‘ng dirOf cá»§a src/dir.js (n = 8)
const dirOfN = (dx, dy, n) => (Math.round(Math.atan2(-dx, dy) / ((Math.PI * 2) / n)) % n + n) % n;

}

// PhÃ­m táº¯t cá»§a client (ui\autoexec.lua -> assets/ui/hud/hud.json hotkeys / phrases â€” tools/build-hud-pack.mjs).
// Äá»•i phÃ­m báº¥m sang tÃªn phÃ­m client ("Ctrl+`", "Alt+1", "Shift+1", "F3", "NUM2", "Q", "Esc", "Del", "Left"â€¦), tra viá»‡c client gáº¯n vá»›i
// phÃ­m (Open([[status]]), Switch([[horse]]), ShortcutSkill(0), SayPhrase(3), MoveTo(16, 0), Zoom([[in]])â€¦) rá»“i gá»i viá»‡c tÆ°Æ¡ng á»©ng
// cá»§a game (act). Viá»‡c game chÆ°a cÃ³ -> bÃ¡o 1 cÃ¢u (act.todo).

//   const K = new Hotkeys(hud.hotkeys, act); addEventListener("keydown", (e) => K.handle(e));

// e.code -> tÃªn phÃ­m client
const CODE = { Escape: "Esc", Delete: "Del", Insert: "Insert", Tab: "Tab", Enter: "Enter", NumpadEnter: "Enter", ArrowLeft: "Left", ArrowRight: "Right",
  ArrowUp: "Up", ArrowDown: "Down", Backquote: "`", Equal: "=", Minus: "-", NumpadAdd: "+", NumpadSubtract: "-", PrintScreen: "PrintScreen", Space: "Space" };

export function keyName(e) {
  const c = e.code || "";
  let k = /^Key[A-Z]$/.test(c) ? c.slice(3) : /^Digit\d$/.test(c) ? c.slice(5) : /^Numpad\d$/.test(c) ? "NUM" + c.slice(6) : /^F\d{1,2}$/.test(c) ? c : CODE[c];
  if (!k) return null;
  let shift = e.shiftKey;
  if (c === "Equal" && shift) { k = "+"; shift = false; } // "+" cá»§a client = phÃ­m +, khÃ´ng tÃ­nh Shift
  return (e.ctrlKey ? "Ctrl+" : "") + (e.altKey ? "Alt+" : "") + (shift ? "Shift+" : "") + k;
}

// "Open([[status]])" -> ["Open", ["status"]]; "MoveTo(16, 0)" -> ["MoveTo", [16, 0]]
export function parseCmd(s) {
  const m = /^\s*(\w+)\((.*)\)\s*$/.exec(s || "");
  if (!m) return null;
  const args = m[2].trim() ? m[2].split(",").map((a) => { a = a.trim(); const t = /^\[\[(.*)\]\]$/.exec(a) || /^"(.*)"$/.exec(a); return t ? t[1] : +a; }) : [];
  return [m[1], args];
}

// tÃªn viá»‡c client -> chá»¯ hiá»‡n khi game chÆ°a cÃ³
const TODO = {
  RequestScriptTable: "Báº£ng sá»± kiá»‡n", Replay: "Ghi hÃ¬nh", GMCommand_1: "Lá»‡nh GM", SwitchPrivateMsgMode: "Cháº¿ Ä‘á»™ tin máº­t", OpenFuLiBattleReportUi: "Chiáº¿n bÃ¡o phÃºc lá»£i",
};

export class Hotkeys {
  constructor(list, act) {
    this.act = act;
    this.map = new Map();
    for (const h of list || []) if (!this.map.has(h.key)) this.map.set(h.key, h.cmd); // phÃ­m trÃ¹ng: dÃ²ng Ä‘áº§u tháº¯ng
  }
  cmdOf(name) { return this.map.get(name) || null; }
  // true náº¿u phÃ­m cÃ³ viá»‡c (Ä‘Ã£ cháº·n máº·c Ä‘á»‹nh cá»§a trÃ¬nh duyá»‡t)
  handle(e) {
    const name = keyName(e), cmd = name && this.map.get(name);
    if (!cmd) return false;
    const p = parseCmd(cmd);
    if (!p) return false;
    e.preventDefault();
    this.run(p[0], p[1], name);
    return true;
  }
  run(fn, a, key) {
    const act = this.act;
    switch (fn) {
      case "Open": return act.open(a[0], key);
      case "Switch": return act.toggle(a[0], key);
      case "Focus": return act.focusChat();
      case "ClearMessage": return act.clearChat();
      case "ShortcutSkill": return act.skill(a[0], key);
      case "ShortcutUseItem": return act.useItem(a[0], key);
      case "SayPhrase": return act.phrase(a[0]);
      case "MoveTo": return act.move(a[0] / 8); // client: 0, 8, 16 â€¦ 56 = 8 hÆ°á»›ng Ã— 8 (hÆ°á»›ng engine 64 báº­c)
      case "TurnTo": return act.turn(a[0] ? 1 : -1);
      case "Zoom": return act.zoom(a[0] === "in" ? 1 : -1);
      case "ExitGame": case "Exit": return act.exit();
      case "PrintScreen": return act.screenshot();
      default: return act.todo(`${key}: ${TODO[fn] || TODO[fn.replace(/_\d+$/, "_1")] || fn} â€” chÆ°a cÃ³`);
    }
  }
}

  setInfo(get) {
    this.info = get; this.infoI = 0; this.infoAt = 0;
    const el = this.top.querySelector(".jx-logo"), L = this.M.logo;
    el.title = L.tip;
    el.onmouseenter = () => { this.infoOver = true; this.tickInfo(performance.now(), true); };

    el.onmousedown = () => (el.style.color = rgb(L.sel));

  }
  netState(ms) { const N = this.M.logo.net; return ms == null ? N[N.length - 1] : N.find((n) => n.ping != null && ms < n.ping) || N[N.length - 1]; }
  tickInfo(now, force) {
    if (!this.el || !this.info) return;
    if (now - this.infoAt >= 3000) { this.infoI++; this.infoAt = now; force = true; }
    if (!force && now - (this.infoDrawn || 0) < 500) return;
    this.infoDrawn = now;
    const L = this.M.logo, s = this.info(), d = new Date(), z = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, "0");
    const net = this.netState(s.ping);
    const items = [
      [L.text, L.color],
      [`${z(d.getHours())}:${z(d.getMinutes())}:${z(d.getSeconds())} ${z(d.getDate())}-${z(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${d.getFullYear()}`, L.color],
      [s.server, L.color],
      [`Trá»±c tuyáº¿n: ${s.online}`, L.color],
      [s.ping == null ? net.msg : `${net.msg} ${Math.round(s.ping)} ms`, net.color],
      ...(s.ky ? [[s.ky, L.color]] : []), // chá»¯ kÃ½ báº£n gá»‘c (anh 11/11 â€” an-ky.js KY_NGAN)
    ];
    const [t, c] = items[this.infoI % items.length], el = this.top.querySelector(".jx-logo");
    if (force && (!s.ky || ((kyChuan() ^ 0x5a5a1234) >>> 0) !== 1475302667)) voKy("dáº£i trÃªn");
    if (el.textContent !== t) el.textContent = t;
    el.style.color = rgb(this.infoOver ? L.over : c);
  }

// ruá»™t thanh: sÃ¡ng á»Ÿ trÃªn, tá»‘i dáº§n xuá»‘ng dÆ°á»›i (giá»‘ng thanh client)
function grad([r, g, b]) {
  const k = (f) => `rgb(${Math.min(255, Math.round(r * f))},${Math.min(255, Math.round(g * f))},${Math.min(255, Math.round(b * f))})`;
  return `linear-gradient(${k(1.35)} 0%, ${k(1)} 45%, ${k(0.62)} 100%)`;
}

// Äáº·t menu báº­t lÃªn cáº¡nh 1 pháº§n tá»­ ("up": bÃªn trÃªn, "down": bÃªn dÆ°á»›i); báº¥m ra ngoÃ i thÃ¬ Ä‘Ã³ng
export function popup(m, anchor, dir = "up") {
  document.body.appendChild(m);
  m.style.left = Math.max(4, Math.min(innerWidth - m.offsetWidth - 4, anchor.left)) + "px";
  m.style.top = (dir === "up" ? anchor.top - m.offsetHeight - 4 : anchor.bottom + 4) + "px";
  setTimeout(() => addEventListener("pointerdown", function off(e) { if (!m.contains(e.target)) { m.remove(); removeEventListener("pointerdown", off); } }), 0);
}

// chá»¯ cá»§a Tra cá»©u: thoÃ¡t HTML rá»“i Ä‘á»•i 3 tháº» mÃ u <y> vÃ ng, <g> xanh, <c> cam
const md = (t) => esc(t).replace(/&lt;(\/?)(y|g|c)&gt;/g, (_, d, k) => (d ? "</span>" : `<span class="hd-${k}">`));
const boDau = (s) => String(s || "").normalize("NFD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "").replace(/Ä‘/g, "d").replace(/Ä/g, "D").toLowerCase();
const THU = ["Chá»§ nháº­t", "Thá»© Hai", "Thá»© Ba", "Thá»© TÆ°", "Thá»© NÄƒm", "Thá»© SÃ¡u", "Thá»© Báº£y"], THU_NGAN = ["CN", "T2", "T3", "T4", "T5", "T6", "T7"];

const vnD = (t) => new Date(t + VN);
const hmCua = (t) => { const d = vnD(t); return p2(d.getUTCHours()) + ":" + p2(d.getUTCMinutes()); };
const ngayCua = (t) => vnD(t).toISOString().slice(0, 10);

  const p = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(ms / 60000));
  if (p >= 1440) return `${Math.floor(p / 1440)} ngÃ y`;
  return p >= 60 ? `${Math.floor(p / 60)} giá»${p % 60 ? " " + (p % 60) : ""}` : `${p} phÃºt`;
};

  canThe() {

  // má»¥c "hd" (hoáº·c "thuong") cá»§a 1 hoáº¡t Ä‘á»™ng: theo lá»‹ch (id) rá»“i theo tá»« khÃ³a tÃªn
  mucHd(id, tu) {

  }

  }

  tt(x, now) {

    if (x.toi) return ["CÃ²n " + con(x.toi - now), "sap"];
    return ["â€”", "qua"];
  }
  gio(x, now) {

  }
  // giá» láº§n tá»›i tháº­t (Sáº¯p diá»…n ra, chi tiáº¿t â€” khÃ´ng viáº¿t táº¯t "Giá» cháºµn"): hÃ´m nay HH:MM, mai "Mai HH:MM", xa hÆ¡n "T7 HH:MM"
  gioToi(x, now) {
    if (!x.toi) return "";
    if (ngayCua(x.toi) === ngayCua(now)) return hmCua(x.toi);
    const mai = ngayCua(now + 86400e3) === ngayCua(x.toi);
    return (mai ? "Mai " : THU_NGAN[vnD(x.toi).getUTCDay()] + " ") + hmCua(x.toi);
  }
  dsGio() {
    const now = this.now(), L = (this.L && this.L.ds) || [];
    const k = (x) => (x.dang ? 0 : x.bat && x.toi ? 1 : 2) * 1e14 + (x.dang ? x.tu : x.toi || 9e13);
    return L.slice().sort((a, b) => k(a) - k(b));
  }
  soNgay(id) { const T = this.L && this.L.toi; return T ? T[id] : undefined; }

    if (v === undefined) return id === "teDan" && this.L && this.L.toi ? ["â€”", "qua"] : ["â€¦", ""]; // teDan: mÃ¡y chá»§ chÆ°a cÃ³ bang há»™i Ä‘á»£t 2

    const [n, m] = v, s = `${n}/${m}${id === "uyThac" ? " giá»" : ""}`;

  }
  tienDo() {

    return [a, b];
  }
  sapToi() {
    const now = this.now(), o = [];
    for (const x of (this.L && this.L.ds) || []) {
      if (x.dang) o.push({ id: x.id, t: 0, gio: x.tu ? hmCua(x.tu) : "", ten: x.ten, chu: x.den ? "Ä‘ang diá»…n ra â€” cÃ²n " + con(x.den - now) : "Ä‘ang diá»…n ra", dang: 1 });
      else if (x.bat && x.toi) o.push({ id: x.id, t: x.toi, gio: this.gioToi(x, now), ten: x.ten, chu: "cÃ²n " + con(x.toi - now) });
    }
    return o.sort((a, b) => a.t - b.t).slice(0, 4);
  }

  chiTiet(id) {

  // ---------- váº½ (mÃ¡y tÃ­nh / Ä‘iá»‡n thoáº¡i ngang: khung client) ----------
  // tháº» NgÅ© hÃ nh (TroThu.nguHanhDom): cÃ¡ch máº·c Ä‘á»“ ngÅ© hÃ nh theo há»‡ vÅ© khÃ­ â€” báº¥m Ä‘á»•i há»‡ thÃ¬ váº½ láº¡i
  _veNh(el) {

    if (this.dt && this.dt.isConnected) { // Ä‘iá»‡n thoáº¡i (anh 09/11 "lÃ m theo pháº§n nhÃ¢n váº­t áº¥y, size = cÃ¡i Ä‘Ã³"): nÃºt chá»n há»‡ + khung trang bá»‹ Ä‘Ãºng cá»¡ khung NhÃ¢n váº­t (dienthoai.js _xepCuaSo: to nháº¥t Ã— 1,3, vá»«a bá» ngang)

  ve() {

  }

    const now = this.now(), G = this.dsGio(), [a, b] = this.tienDo();
    if (!this.chon) this.chon = (G[0] && G[0].id) || "phongHoa";
    const dg = (x) => { const [t, c] = this.tt(x, now); return `<div class="hd-r${this.chon === x.id ? " on" : ""}" data-lich="${x.id}"><span class="c1">${esc(x.ten)}</span><span class="c2 hd-sap">${esc(this.gio(x, now))}</span><span class="c3 hd-${c}">${esc(t)}</span></div>`; };

export function giaSua(it, L = { gia: 50, dong: 16 }) {

}

export function canWear(hero, it) {
  if (isPotion(it)) return true;
  const g = ItemDB.base(it.k);
  if ((hero.lvl || 1) < (g.lv || 1) || g.reborn) return false;
  if (g.sex && g.sex !== hero.sex) return false;
  if (g.str || g.dex) { const c = diemCo(hero); if ((g.str && c.str < g.str) || (g.dex && c.dex < g.dex)) return false; }
  return true;
}

// Chá»‰ sá»‘ cá»™ng tá»« Ä‘á»“ Ä‘ang máº·c: chá»‰ sá»‘ gá»‘c (do-goc.json) + dÃ²ng xanh cÃ³ tÃ¡c dá»¥ng (dÃ²ng áº©n chÆ°a kÃ­ch thÃ¬ khÃ´ng). Ngá»±a chá»‰ tÃ­nh khi Ä‘ang
// cÆ°á»¡i. Tráº£ vá» B cho rules.heroStats.
export function equipStats(hero, riding) {
  const B = { str: 0, dex: 0, vit: 0, eng: 0, life: 0, mana: 0, stamina: 0, res: { fire: 0, cold: 0, light: 0, poison: 0, phys: 0 }, resAll: 0,
    wdmg: null, dmgAdd: 0, dmgPct: 0, elem: { poison: 0, cold: 0, fire: 0, light: 0 }, atkSpeed: 0, castSpeed: 0, moveSpeed: 0, ar: 0, arPct: 0, def: 0,
    lifeRegen: 0, lifeSteal: 0, thorns: 0, luck: 0, ignoreDef: 0, tgph: 0, tglc: 0, tgc: 0, tgtd: 0, dmg2mana: 0, manaRegen: 0, stRegen: 0, hutSinh: 0, hutNoi: 0,
    elemMagic: { physics: 0, cold: 0, fire: 0, light: 0, poison: 0 } };
  for (const [slot, it] of Object.entries(hero.equip || {})) {
    if (!it || !it.k || (slot === "Horse" && !riding) || it.ben === 0) continue; // Ä‘á»™ bá»n 0: khÃ´ng cÃ²n tÃ¡c dá»¥ng (may-chu/do.js)
    const g = ItemDB.base(it.k);
    if (slot === "Weapon" && g.dmg) B.wdmg = g.dmg;
    B.arPct += g.arPct || 0; B.def += g.def || 0; B.moveSpeed += g.move || 0; B.stamina += g.stamina || 0;
    B.life += g.life || 0; B.resAll += g.resAll || 0; B.lifeRegen += g.lifeRegen || 0;
    const kich = soKich(hero, slot, it);
    for (const [i, [k, v]] of (it.d || []).entries()) {
      if (!coTacDung(i, kich)) continue;
      if (RES_LINE[k]) B.res[RES_LINE[k]] += v;
      else if (ELEM_LINE[k]) B.elem[ELEM_LINE[k]] += v;
      else if (STAT_LINE[k]) B[STAT_LINE[k]] += v;
      else if (MAGIC_LINE[ItemDB.serDmg[k]]) B.elemMagic[MAGIC_LINE[ItemDB.serDmg[k]]] += v;
    }
  }
  return B;
}
// sá»©c máº¡nh / thÃ¢n phÃ¡p / sinh khÃ­ / ná»™i cÃ´ng Ä‘ang cÃ³ = Ä‘iá»ƒm gá»‘c + Ä‘iá»ƒm Ä‘Ã£ cá»™ng + dÃ²ng xanh cÃ³ tÃ¡c dá»¥ng cá»§a Ä‘á»“ Ä‘ang máº·c â€” yÃªu cáº§u cá»§a mÃ³n so vá»›i
// sá»‘ nÃ y nhÆ° client (engine KItemList::EnoughAttrib so vá»›i m_nCurStrengthâ€¦, Ä‘Ã£ cá»™ng Ä‘á»“ Ä‘ang máº·c; thÃ¡o Ä‘á»“ khÃ´ng báº¯t thÃ¡o mÃ³n khÃ¡c â€” anh 30/10
// "cÃ¡c dÃ²ng sinh khÃ­ sá»©c máº¡nh thÃ¢n phÃ¡p trÃªn trang bá»‹ khÃ´ng cá»™ng vÃ o chá»‰ sá»‘ nhÆ° trÃªn client"). GIá»NG may-chu/do.js diemCo
export function diemCo(hero) {
  const B = equipStats(hero, false), s = hero.start || {}, a = hero.attr || {};
  return { str: (s.str || 0) + (a.str || 0) + B.str, dex: (s.dex || 0) + (a.dex || 0) + B.dex, vit: (s.vit || 0) + (a.vit || 0) + B.vit, eng: (s.eng || 0) + (a.eng || 0) + B.eng };
}

// loáº¡i vÅ© khÃ­ Ä‘ang cáº§m cho giá»›i háº¡n vÅ© khÃ­ cá»§a vÃµ cÃ´ng (skills.txt EqtLimit): âˆ’1 tay khÃ´ng (cáº£ triá»n thá»§ â€” vÅ© khÃ­ quyá»n, p 6), 0 kiáº¿m,
// 1 Ä‘ao, 2 cÃ´n, 3 thÆ°Æ¡ng, 4 chÃ¹y, 5 song Ä‘ao (p cá»§a mÃ³n cáº­n chiáº¿n), 100 + p Ã¡m khÃ­ (0 phi tiÃªu, 1 phi Ä‘ao, 2 tá»¥ tiá»…n)
export function weaponKind(hero) {
  const w = hero.equip && hero.equip.Weapon, x = w && ItemDB.item(w.k);
  if (!x) return -1;
  if (x.t === 1) return 100 + (x.p | 0);
  return (x.p | 0) === 6 ? -1 : x.p | 0;
}

// Ä‘ang cáº§m Ã¡m khÃ­ (vÅ© khÃ­ táº§m xa) -> Ä‘Ã²n thÆ°á»ng báº¯n Ä‘áº¡n bay, sÃ¡t thÆ°Æ¡ng theo ThÃ¢n phÃ¡p
export function syncRanged(hero) {
  const w = hero.equip && hero.equip.Weapon, x = w && ItemDB.item(w.k);
  if (x && x.t === 1) hero.ranged = true; else delete hero.ranged;
}

// kiá»ƒu dÃ¡ng Ä‘ang hiá»‡n: Ä‘á»“ Ä‘ang máº·c, xuá»‘ng ngá»±a (nÃºt LÃªn xuá»‘ng ngá»±a) thÃ¬ bá» ngá»±a
export const looksOf = (hero) => ({ ...(hero.looks || {}), ...(hero.rideOff ? { horse: 0 } : {}) });

// CÃ´ng cá»¥ thá»­: máº·c mÃ³n k (from = chá»‰ sá»‘ mÃ³n trong tÃºi, hoáº·c null = mÃ³n má»›i khÃ´ng dÃ²ng). MÃ³n cÅ© á»Ÿ Ã´ Ä‘Ã³ tráº£ vÃ o tÃºi. Tráº£ vá» Ã´ Ä‘Ã£ máº·c
// hoáº·c null náº¿u mÃ³n khÃ´ng máº·c Ä‘Æ°á»£c. main.js gá»­i káº¿t quáº£ lÃªn mÃ¡y chá»§ (tÃ i khoáº£n quáº£n trá»‹).
export function wear(hero, k, from = null) {
  const x = ItemDB.item(k); if (!x) return null;
  let slot = SLOT_OF[x.t]; if (!slot) return null;
  hero.equip = hero.equip || {};
  if (slot === "Ring1" && hero.equip.Ring1 && !hero.equip.Ring2) slot = "Ring2";
  const old = hero.equip[slot];
  let it = { k, d: [] };
  if (from != null && hero.bag && hero.bag[from] && hero.bag[from].k === k) it = hero.bag.splice(from, 1)[0];
  if (old) (hero.bag = hero.bag || []).push(old);
  hero.equip[slot] = it;
  hero.looks = hero.looks || {};
  const ox = old && ItemDB.item(old.k);
  if (ox && ox.g) delete hero.looks[ox.g];
  if (x.g) hero.looks[x.g] = x.id;
  syncRanged(hero);
  return slot;
}
// CÃ´ng cá»¥ thá»­: thÃ¡o mÃ³n á»Ÿ Ã´ slot vá» tÃºi
export function unwear(hero, slot) {
  const it = hero.equip && hero.equip[slot]; if (!it) return null;
  delete hero.equip[slot];
  const x = ItemDB.item(it.k);
  if (x && x.g && hero.looks) delete hero.looks[x.g];
  (hero.bag = hero.bag || []).push(it);
  syncRanged(hero);
  return it.k;
}

function selectScreen() {

    const sp = P.ui.focus[f.series + (h.sex === "f" ? "f" : "m")];

// csVao: Ä‘ang vÃ o game â€” Ä‘iá»‡n thoáº¡i cháº¡m nhÃ¢n váº­t Ä‘ang chá»n = vÃ o (anh 01/11), cháº¡m 2 láº§n nhanh khÃ´ng vÃ o 2 láº§n
let csVao = false;
function csEnter() {
  if (csVao) return;
  const h = CS.slots[CS.sel];
  try { localStorage.setItem(SLOT_PTR, String(CS.sel)); } catch {}
  if (!h) return serverScreen(CS.sel);
  if (utDang(CS.sel, h)) utXoa(); // vÃ o láº¡i nhÃ¢n váº­t Ä‘ang á»§y thÃ¡c: bá» dÃ²ng nháº¯c (mÃ¡y chá»§ tráº£ báº£ng tá»•ng káº¿t á»Ÿ nhá»‹p Ä‘áº§u)
  hero = h; csVao = true; enterGame().catch(fail).finally(() => { csVao = false; });
}

addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (!$("#s-select").classList.contains("on")) return;
  if ((KAT && KAT.dangHoi()) || (e.target && /^(INPUT|TEXTAREA|SELECT)$/.test(e.target.tagName))) return; // Ä‘ang há»i máº­t kháº©u cáº¥p 2 / Ä‘ang gÃµ Ã´ chá»¯
  if (e.key === "ArrowLeft" || e.key === "ArrowRight") { CS.sel = (CS.sel + (e.key === "ArrowLeft" ? SLOT_N - 1 : 1)) % SLOT_N; CS.del = -1; csPanel(); }
  else if (e.key === "Enter") csEnter();
});

function mergeFullMaps(maps, hud, full) {
  for (const [k, m] of Object.entries(full.maps)) {
    maps.maps[k] = m;

  }

  for (const z of full.zones) if (!maps.zones.some((x) => x.map === z.map)) maps.zones.push(z);
}

function revivePoint(zone, map) { const l = revivePoints(zone, map); return l.length ? l[Math.floor(Math.random() * l.length)] : null; }
function revivePoints(zone, map) {
  const m = P.maps.maps[zone.map], c = m && m.client, s = P.maps.scale, pts = c && c.region && P.revive.maps[c.id], out = [], E = 150;
  for (const [lx, ly] of Object.values(pts || {})) {
    const x = (lx - c.region[0] * 512) * s, y = ((ly - c.region[1] * 1024) / 2) * s;
    const cx = Math.min(map.w - E, Math.max(E, x)), cy = Math.min(map.h - E, Math.max(E, y));
    if (Math.hypot(cx - x, cy - y) > 300) continue;
    const i = map.nearestCell(cx, cy, 20);
    if (i >= 0) out.push(map.center(i));
  }
  return out;
}

function npcApi() {

    doiPhaiCase: (key) => (hero && hero.fac == null && hero.doiPhai ? `DoiPhaiMoi:${key}` : null),

      if (hero.doiPhai) return; // Ä‘ang chá» Ä‘á»•i phÃ¡i: bÃ¡i nháº­p qua mÃ¡y chá»§ (doiPhaiFn â€” chiÃªu 90 / 120 mang sang), khÃ´ng vÃ o phÃ¡i á»Ÿ trÃ¬nh duyá»‡t
      // Ä‘Ã£ cÃ³ phÃ¡i thÃ¬ khÃ´ng Ä‘á»•i á»Ÿ Ä‘Ã¢y (soÃ¡t 11/11: lá»‡nh nháº­p phÃ¡i cháº¡y láº¡i lÃºc khung NPC phÃ¡i khÃ¡c Ä‘ang má»Ÿ tá»«ng Ä‘á»•i phÃ¡i á»Ÿ trÃ¬nh duyá»‡t)
      const f = P.factions.find((x) => x.key === key); if (!f || hero.fac != null) return;

    },
    setCamp: (n) => { hero.camp = n; save(); },

    // "Khu vá»±c bang há»™i" (Ä‘á»£t 4): chá»‰ thÃ nh viÃªn bang, khu vá»±c bang Ä‘ang má»Ÿ (luat().khuBang.bat)
    // VÃµ SÆ° "Hoáº¡t Ä‘á»™ng bÃ¡o Ä‘Ã¡p Ã¢n sÆ°" (anh 16/11): mÃ¡y chá»§ chÆ°a cÃ³ sá»± kiá»‡n (LUAT khÃ´ng cÃ³ baoDapAnSu) thÃ¬ áº©n; cÃ³ thÃ¬ luÃ´n hiá»‡n (ngoÃ i ngÃ y: bÃ¡o Ä‘Ã£ káº¿t thÃºc / chÆ°a báº¯t Ä‘áº§u)

    travel: (id) => { const m = P.maplist.maps[id]; P.hud.msg(`${m ? m.name : "Báº£n Ä‘á»“ " + id}: chÆ°a cÃ³ trong game`); },

// Báº£n Ä‘á»“ nhá»: áº£nh + Ä‘á»•i tá»a Ä‘á»™ báº£n Ä‘á»“ web <-> tá»a Ä‘á»™ hiá»‡n trÃªn client (X = x logic / 256, Y = y logic / 512 â€” nhÆ° Ã´ tá»a Ä‘á»™
// cá»§a client; x logic = vÃ¹ng Ã— 512 + x mÃ n hÃ¬nh, y logic = vÃ¹ng Ã— 1024 + 2 Ã— y mÃ n hÃ¬nh; báº£n Ä‘á»“ web = mÃ n hÃ¬nh client Ã— 0.75)
function setHudMap() {
  const m = P.maps.maps[world.zone.map], c = m && m.client, reg = c && c.region ? c.region : [0, 0], s = P.maps.scale;
  const fromClient = (X, Y) => [((X + 0.5) * 256 - reg[0] * 512) * s, (((Y + 0.5) * 512 - reg[1] * 1024) / 2) * s];
  P.hud.setMap({ key: world.zone.map, name: world.zone.n + (world.chung ? " (chung)" : ""), toClient: (x, y) => [Math.floor((reg[0] * 512 + x / s) / 256), Math.floor((reg[1] * 1024 + (2 * y) / s) / 512)], fromClient });
  world.fromClient = fromClient; // Trá»£ Thá»§ tá»± Ä‘Ã¡nh theo tá»a Ä‘á»™
}

// tienDo) haiGiay giÃ¢y; Ä‘i / Ä‘Ã¡nh / bá»‹ Ä‘Ã¡nh / cháº¿t lÃ  há»ng (progressconfig.txt dÃ²ng 1: EVENT_MOVE, EVENT_ATTACK, EVENT_ATTACKED, EVENT_DEATHâ€¦);
// Ä‘á»§ giá» -> mÃ¡y chá»§ phÃ¡t 1 cÃ¢y; cÃ¢y vá»«a hÃ¡i áº©n cd giÃ¢y (mÃ¡y chá»§ cÅ©ng cháº·n hÃ¡i láº¡i)
let haiDang = null;
function haiCay(n) {
  if (!hero || !world || haiDang || !GW) return;
  const id = n.mc.cay;
  haiDang = { id };
  const p0 = world.player; p0.target = null; if (p0.act === "attack") world.setAct(p0, "stand"); // hÃ¡i: thÃ´i Ä‘Ã¡nh má»¥c tiÃªu cÅ© (vá»«a háº¡ quÃ¡i canh)
  Net.minhChu(hero.slot | 0, { viec: "haiBat", cay: id }).then((j) => {
    const w = world, p = w && w.player;
    if (!p) { haiDang = null; return; }
    const x0 = p.x, y0 = p.y, hp0 = p.hp, t0 = performance.now(), ms = (j.haiGiay || 3) * 1000;
    let tm = 0;
    const het = (ok) => { clearInterval(tm); haiDang = null; GW.tienDo(null); if (!ok) P.hud.msg("Thu tháº­p bá»‹ giÃ¡n Ä‘oáº¡n"); };
    GW.tienDo("Äang thu tháº­p", 0);
    tm = setInterval(() => {
      const q = world && world.player;
      if (world !== w || !q || q.hp <= 0 || q.hp < hp0 || q.path || q.goal || Math.hypot(q.x - x0, q.y - y0) > 4 || /attack|magic/.test(q.act || "")) return het(false);
      const k = (performance.now() - t0) / ms;
      GW.tienDo("Äang thu tháº­p", Math.min(1, k));
      if (k < 1) return;
      het(true);
      Net.minhChu(hero.slot | 0, { viec: "hai", cay: id }).then((r) => { applyServer(r); if (r.msg) P.hud.msg(r.msg, MAU_TIN.tien); if (GW) GW.refresh(true); anCay(w, id, r.cd); })
        .catch((e) => { if (e.ma !== "het-phien") P.hud.canh(e.message); });
    }, 50);
  }).catch((e) => { haiDang = null; if (e.ma !== "het-phien") P.hud.canh(e.message); });
}
// cÃ¢y vá»«a hÃ¡i: bá» khá»i bÃ£i giay giÃ¢y rá»“i tráº£ láº¡i (nhÆ° gatherobj.lua KillNpcWithIdx â€” cÃ¢y má»c láº¡i)
function anCay(w, id, giay) {
  const i = w.npcs.findIndex((q) => q.mc && q.mc.cay === id); if (i < 0) return;
  const n = w.npcs[i]; w.npcs.splice(i, 1);
  setTimeout(() => { if (world === w && !w.npcs.includes(n)) w.npcs.push(n); }, (giay || 60) * 1000);
}

// má»›i thá»­ láº¡i 1 láº§n
let phMua = null, phMuaLuc = 0;
function phMuaTick() {
  const w = world, T = hero.auto.treo, p = w.player;
  if (!laPh(w.zone) || !w.auto || !phO() || p.hp <= 0) { if (phMua) { phMua = null; w.holdMove = false; } return; }
  if (!phMua) {
    const can = (T.thuocOn && hpPotions() <= T.thuoc) || (T.nlOn && mpPotions() <= T.nl);
    if (!can || !T.mua.some((m) => m.on) || performance.now() < phMuaLuc) return;
    const n = w.npcs.filter((x) => x.ph === "qn").sort((a, b) => ldist(p.x, p.y, a.x, a.y) - ldist(p.x, p.y, b.x, b.y))[0]; if (!n) return;
    phMua = { n, t0: performance.now() }; P.hud.msg("Trá»£ Thá»§: sáº¯p háº¿t thuá»‘c â€” vá» QuÃ¢n Nhu quan mua");
  }
  w.holdMove = true; if (p.target) { p.target = null; p.path = null; }
  if (ldist(p.x, p.y, phMua.n.x, phMua.n.y) > 80 && performance.now() - phMua.t0 < 25000) { if (!p.goal) w.walkTo(phMua.n.x, phMua.n.y); return; }
  if (phMua.dang) return;
  phMua.dang = true;
  const truoc = hpPotions() + mpPotions();
  doItem({ act: "thanh", ban: 0, mua: T.mua.filter((m) => m.on).map((m) => [m.k, m.n]) }).finally(() => {
    for (const m of T.mua) if (m.on && potCount(m.k)) quickAdd(m.k);
    // khÃ´ng mua thÃªm Ä‘Æ°á»£c bÃ¬nh nÃ o (thiáº¿u tiá»n / tÃºi Ä‘áº§y): 5 phÃºt sau má»›i thá»­ láº¡i â€” khÃ´ng cháº¡y Ä‘i cháº¡y láº¡i bá» Ä‘Ã¡nh
    const duoc = hpPotions() + mpPotions() > truoc;
    if (!duoc) P.hud.canh("Trá»£ Thá»§: khÃ´ng mua Ä‘Æ°á»£c thuá»‘c á»Ÿ QuÃ¢n Nhu quan (thiáº¿u tiá»n hoáº·c hÃ nh trang Ä‘áº§y) â€” Ä‘Ã¡nh tiáº¿p, 5 phÃºt sau thá»­ láº¡i");
    phMua = null; phMuaLuc = performance.now() + (duoc ? 60000 : 300000); if (world) world.holdMove = false;
  });
}

function vaTickDoi(w, D) {

function npcBan(n, id) {

  if (!k || !S) return false;

// trá»« bÃ¬nh á»Ÿ tÃºi trong mÃ¡y (m: mÃ£ mÃ³n -> sá»‘ bÃ¬nh); chá»“ng háº¿t bÃ¬nh thÃ¬ bá»
function bagMinus(m) {
  if (!m.size || !hero.bag) return;
  for (const [u, n] of m) { const it = hero.bag.find((b) => b.u === u); if (it && it.n != null) it.n -= n; }
  hero.bag = hero.bag.filter((b) => b.n == null || b.n > 0);
}

function drink(it) {

function quickSkill(id, byKey) {

  const s = P.skillDb[id], k = kindOf(s, P.skillDb), p = world.player, O = (hero.oChieu = hero.oChieu || {});
  if (!s) return false;

  if (k === "jump") { const [x, y] = truocMat(world.skRange(id, 1)); return world.castAt(id, null, x, y); } // báº¥m Ã´ báº±ng chuá»™t / cháº¡m Ã´: nháº£y tháº³ng vá» phÃ­a trÆ°á»›c

const MUC_GAN = 150, DON_THUONG_R = 80;
function mucGan(R) {
  const p = world.player, xa = (m) => ldist(p.x, p.y, m.x, m.y) - (m.radius || 0);
  if (p.target && p.target.alive && world.mobs.includes(p.target) && xa(p.target) <= R + MUC_GAN) return p.target;
  let best = null, bd = R + MUC_GAN;
  for (const m of world.mobs) { if (!m.alive) continue; const d = xa(m); if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = m; } }
  return best;
}

function truocMat(R) { const p = world.player, a = ((p.dir | 0) * Math.PI) / 4; return [p.x - Math.sin(a) * R, p.y + (Math.cos(a) * R) / 2]; }

function autoDrink() {

  if (p.hp <= 0 || p.sit || world.resting) return;
  if (laLd(world.zone)) return; // lÃ´i Ä‘Ã i (anh 15/11 D9): Trá»£ Thá»§ khÃ´ng hoáº¡t Ä‘á»™ng trong sÃ¢n â€” khÃ´ng tá»± uá»‘ng thuá»‘c (uá»‘ng tay váº«n Ä‘Æ°á»£c); cáº£ lÃºc bÃ¹ quÃ£ng tab áº©n (simulate)
  // Trá»£ Thá»§ tháº» PK (anh 06/11 â€” trong tráº­n Tá»‘ng Kim, Ä‘ang tá»± Ä‘Ã¡nh): uá»‘ng theo má»©c "SL < / NL <" cá»§a tháº» PK thay má»©c tá»«ng dÃ²ng tháº» Thuá»‘c (dÃ²ng táº¯t cÅ©ng
  // uá»‘ng), loáº¡i thuá»‘c váº«n theo dÃ²ng tháº» Thuá»‘c
  const K = world.auto && world.pk ? world.pk() : null;
  for (const r of hero.auto.thuoc) {
    if (!r.on && !K) continue;
    // tháº» PK: má»©c SL / NL cá»§a tháº»; Ä‘ang lui vá» doanh (World.pkLuiDang) thÃ¬ uá»‘ng tá»›i má»©c ra tráº­n láº¡i = max(K.ra, K.vePct + 1) nhÆ° World.pkLuiTick (soÃ¡t
    // 06/11 â€” khÃ´ng thÃ¬ Ä‘á»©ng á»Ÿ doanh mÃ£i)
    const [v, max, e] = r.loai === "hp" ? [p.hp, p.hpMax, p.potHp] : [p.mp, p.mpMax, p.potMp], pct = K ? (r.loai === "hp" ? (world.pkLuiDang ? Math.max(K.sl, K.ra, K.vePct + 1) : K.sl) : K.nl) : r.pct;
    if (v * 100 < max * pct && !(e && e.n > 0)) {
      const c = r.k && chongIt(r.k);
      if (c && drink(c)) return;
      // chá»n "báº¥t ká»³" / háº¿t loáº¡i Ä‘Ã£ chá»n: uá»‘ng thuá»‘c khÃ¡c trong tÃºi cÃ³ há»“i loáº¡i Ä‘Ã³ â€” cáº£ thuá»‘c há»“i cáº£ hai (anh 03/11 "báº¥t kÃ¬ loáº¡i thuá»‘c sinh / ná»™i nÃ o cÅ©ng
      // tÃ¡c dá»¥ng vá»›i cÃ¡c loáº¡i há»“i cáº£ 2 nhÆ° há»“i thiÃªn hay ngÅ© hoa"; báº£n trÆ°á»›c dÃ²ng ná»™i lá»±c bá» qua thuá»‘c há»“i cáº£ hai): thuá»‘c má»™t loáº¡i trÆ°á»›c, rá»“i thuá»‘c há»“i cáº£
      // hai (Ä‘áº¯t â€” VÆ°á»£t áº¢i / Ká»³ TrÃ¢n CÃ¡c), má»—i nhÃ³m chá»“ng Ã­t bÃ¬nh nháº¥t trÆ°á»›c
      const hp = r.loai === "hp", st = (hero.bag || []).filter((b) => b.n > 0 && thuocHoi(b.k, hp)).sort((a, b) => !a.tk - !b.tk || caHai(a.k) - caHai(b.k) || a.n - b.n)[0];
      if (st && drink(st)) return;
    }
  }
}

function xeToi(z, at, chung, khongDi) {

  P.hud.msg(`Ngá»“i yÃªn chÆ°a? ChÃºng ta Ä‘i ${z.n}`); // cÃ¢u client (SelStation)
  if (tr != null && laQc(z)) P.hud.msg(`Äá»™i trÆ°á»Ÿng ${doiTt.truong} Ä‘ang á»Ÿ ${z.n} báº£n ${tr ? "quÃ¡i chung" : "quÃ¡i riÃªng"} â€” vÃ o cÃ¹ng báº£n`);

function xeTick() {
  const w = world, p = w.player, d = diXe;
  if (!TOWN_KINDS.has(w.zone.kind) || zoneLoad || p.hp <= 0) return;
  if (!d.t0) d.t0 = performance.now();
  const n = xaPhuNpc(w);
  w.resting = false; if (p.sit) w.sit(false);
  // tá»± Ä‘Ã¡nh chá»‰ cháº¡y (nhÆ° giá»¯ chuá»™t â€” World.holdMove): khÃ´ng lao vÃ o Ä‘Ã¡nh má»™c nhÃ¢n á»Ÿ Ba LÄƒng trÃªn Ä‘Æ°á»ng tá»›i Xa phu
  w.holdMove = true; p.target = null;
  if (n && ldist(p.x, p.y, n.x, n.y) > 80 && performance.now() - d.t0 < 30000) { if (!p.goal) w.walkTo(n.x, n.y); return; }
  diXe = null; w.holdMove = false;
  // tá»± lÃ m nhiá»‡m vá»¥ ngÃ y (tulam.js) / Boss HoÃ ng Kim (bossTick): sang thÃ´n / thÃ nh khÃ¡c, tá»›i báº£n Ä‘á»“ nhiá»‡m vá»¥ sÃ¡t thá»§ (báº£n quÃ¡i chung)
  if (d.sat) { const v = satNv(); if (v && moBai(v.z)) xeSat(v); else P.hud.msg("Trá»£ Thá»§: chÆ°a cÃ³ nhiá»‡m vá»¥ sÃ¡t thá»§ hoáº·c chÆ°a vÃ o Ä‘Æ°á»£c bÃ£i cá»§a boss"); return; }
  const z = P.maps.zones.find((x) => x.id === d.z), c = hero.diemCu;
  if (z && d.thanh) return w.zone.bang && TOWN_KINDS.has(z.kind) ? khuXaPhu(z.id, true) : xeThanh(z); // khu vá»±c bang: sang thÃ nh qua Xa phu khu (lá»™ phÃ­ â€” Ä‘á»£t 4); bÃ£i luyá»‡n cÃ´ng / boss á»Ÿ bÃ£i: miá»…n phÃ­
  if (z) xeToi(z, c && c.z === z.id ? [c.x, c.y] : null, d.c);
}

    if (T.sua.on && doSap(T.sua.pct)) { const kt = kimTeTui(); if (kt) { if (performance.now() - kimTeLuc > 10000) { kimTeLuc = performance.now(); dungVat(kt); } return; } }

  const chayToi = (n, t0) => {

function veBai(w = world, treo = true, dau = "ÄÃ£ há»“i phá»¥c") {

  const T = hero.auto.treo, theoT = T.on && T.bai != null, back = P.maps.zones.find((z) => z.id === (theoT ? T.bai : hero.farmZone));
  const bc = !!back && laQc(back) && (theoT ? !!T.chung : !!hero.farmChung), tenB = back ? back.n + (bc ? " (quÃ¡i chung)" : "") : ""; // bc: vá» báº£n quÃ¡i chung
  if (back && !moBai(back)) { P.hud.msg(`${dau} â€” ${chuaMo(back)}`); oLai(); }
  // anh 31/10 khuya ("lÃªn map mÃ  khÃ´ng mang theo thá»• Ä‘á»‹a phÃ¹"): báº­t mua Thá»• Äá»‹a PhÃ¹ mÃ  trong tÃºi váº«n khÃ´ng cÃ³ (tÃºi Ä‘áº§y / thiáº¿u tiá»n) thÃ¬ á»Ÿ
  // láº¡i thÃ nh â€” ra bÃ£i rá»“i khÃ´ng tá»± vá» thÃ nh Ä‘Æ°á»£c
  else if (back && world.auto && T.phu && T.phu.on && !phuTrongTui()) { P.hud.canh(`Trá»£ Thá»§: khÃ´ng mua Ä‘Æ°á»£c Thá»• Äá»‹a PhÃ¹ (tÃºi Ä‘áº§y hoáº·c thiáº¿u tiá»n) â€” á»Ÿ láº¡i ${world.zone.n}, chÆ°a ra ${tenB}`); oLai(); }
  else if (back && world.auto) { P.hud.msg(`${dau} â€” Ä‘i Xa phu vá» ${tenB}`); diXe = { z: back.id, t0: 0, c: bc }; }
  else { P.hud.msg(`${dau}${back ? ` â€” nÃ³i chuyá»‡n vá»›i Xa phu Ä‘á»ƒ vá» ${tenB}` : ""}`); oLai(); }

function baiTreo() {
  const T = hero.auto.treo, z = P.maps.zones.find((x) => x.id === (T.on && T.bai != null ? T.bai : hero.farmZone));
  if (z && moBai(z)) return { z: z.id, c: laQc(z) && (T.on && T.bai != null ? !!T.chung : !!hero.farmChung) };
  const ds = P.maps.zones.filter((x) => FARM_KINDS.has(x.kind) && !x.chiThuyen && moBai(x)).sort((a, b) => b.lo - a.lo);
  return ds.length ? { z: ds[0].id, c: false } : null;
}
// viá»‡c á»Ÿ thÃ nh xong: ra thÃ nh mÃ  khÃ´ng Ä‘á»¡ Ä‘Æ°á»£c -> thÃ´i vá» vÃ¬ lÃ½ do Ä‘Ã³; ngá»“i dÆ°á»¡ng sá»©c (Ä‘áº§y sinh lá»±c sáºµn thÃ¬ onRested cháº¡y ngay)
function nghiThanh(T) {
  const t = thanh.truoc || {};
  if (!conChoMon(T) && freeCells() <= t.tui) treoNghi.tui = true;
  if (hpPotions() <= T.thuoc && hpPotions() <= t.thuoc) treoNghi.thuoc = true;
  if (mpPotions() <= T.nl && mpPotions() <= t.nl) treoNghi.nl = true;
  if (T.sua.on && doSap(T.sua.pct)) treoNghi.sua = true; // khÃ´ng Ä‘á»§ tiá»n sá»­a
  thanh.buoc = "nghi"; world.resting = true;
}

let bossTheo = 0, bossDi = null, bossVe = 0, bossDaDi = 0;

function bossSauThanh() {
  const b = bossSong(), B = hero.auto.boss;
  if (!b || !(bossDi || (B.quay && bossTheo === b.u) || ((B.tuDi || (b.sk && B.sk !== 0)) && bossDaDi === b.u))) return false; // b.sk: siÃªu boss sá»± kiá»‡n (anh 18/11)

  P.hud.msg(`Trá»£ Thá»§: Ä‘i tá»›i boss tháº¿ giá»›i ${b.ten} (${b.tenBai}${b.noi ? " " + b.noi : ""})`);
  return true;
}
function bossTick() {
  const w = world; if (!w || !hero || !hero.auto) return;
  const B = hero.auto.boss, b = bossSong(), p = w.player;
  if (!w.auto) { bossDi = null; return; }
  if (b && w.bossGan(false)) bossTheo = b.u;
  if (!b) { // boss cháº¿t / háº¿t giá»: Trá»£ Thá»§ Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘Æ°a Ä‘i -> viá»‡c á»Ÿ thÃ nh rá»“i vá» bÃ£i treo mÃ¡y
    bossTheo = 0; bossDi = null;
    if (bossVe && B.veBai && TOWN_KINDS.has(w.zone.kind) && !thanh && !diXe && !zoneLoad) { bossVe = 0; P.hud.msg("Trá»£ Thá»§: boss tháº¿ giá»›i Ä‘Ã£ háº¿t â€” bÃ¡n / mua rá»“i vá» bÃ£i treo mÃ¡y"); thanh = { buoc: "di", t0: performance.now(), why: "boss tháº¿ giá»›i Ä‘Ã£ háº¿t" }; }
    else if (bossVe && !TOWN_KINDS.has(w.zone.kind)) bossVe = 0;
    return;
  }
  // siÃªu boss sá»± kiá»‡n (anh 18/11 â€” boss.sk máº·c Ä‘á»‹nh báº­t, má»i cáº¥p): Ä‘ang á»Ÿ thÃ nh thÃ¬ Ä‘i tháº³ng tá»›i boss (bÃ£i luyá»‡n cÃ´ng: nhÆ° tuDi bÃªn dÆ°á»›i)
  // Ä‘ang bÃ¡n / mua á»Ÿ thÃ nh (thanh): chá»‰ ghi nháº­n â€” xong viá»‡c onRested -> bossSauThanh Ä‘Æ°a Ä‘i tá»›i boss
  if (b.sk && B.sk !== 0 && bossDaDi !== b.u && TOWN_KINDS.has(w.zone.kind) && !diXe && !zoneLoad && p.hp > 0) {
    bossDaDi = b.u; bossVe = b.u;
    if (thanh) { P.hud.msg(`Trá»£ Thá»§: siÃªu boss ${b.ten} xuáº¥t hiá»‡n â€” xong viá»‡c á»Ÿ thÃ nh sáº½ Ä‘i tá»›i boss`); return; }
    bossDi = { u: b.u }; P.hud.msg(`Trá»£ Thá»§: siÃªu boss ${b.ten} xuáº¥t hiá»‡n â€” Ä‘i tá»›i boss (${b.tenBai}${b.noi ? " " + b.noi : ""})`);
    return;
  }
  // boss má»›i xuáº¥t hiá»‡n (má»—i boss 1 láº§n): tá»± Ä‘i tá»« bÃ£i luyá»‡n cÃ´ng
  if (((B.tuDi && (hero.lvl || 1) >= B.cap) || (b.sk && B.sk !== 0)) && bossDaDi !== b.u && FARM_KINDS.has(w.zone.kind) && !w.zone.chiThuyen && !thanh && !diXe && !zoneLoad && !camPhu()) {
    bossDaDi = b.u;
    if (veThanh(`boss tháº¿ giá»›i ${b.ten} xuáº¥t hiá»‡n`)) bossVe = b.u;
    return;
  }
  if (!bossDi || thanh || diXe || zoneLoad || p.hp <= 0) return;
  if (bossDi.u !== b.u) { bossDi = null; return; }
  // tá»›i gáº§n: tá»± Ä‘Ã¡nh nháº¯m boss (World.nearestMob â€” cáº£ khi táº¡m dá»«ng á»Ÿ thÃ nh). Hoáº¡t Ä‘á»™ng (anh 04/11 lÆ°á»£t 25): tá»± Ä‘Ã¡nh chá»‰ trong pháº¡m vi quanh mÃ¬nh
  // (World.hdR) -> Ä‘i tá»›i cÃ¡ch boss 3/4 pháº¡m vi má»›i thÃ´i; boss Ä‘Ã£ tháº¥y (BTG_GAN) thÃ¬ Ä‘i tháº³ng tá»›i nÃ³ (boss Ä‘uá»•i ngÆ°á»i khÃ¡c ra xa chá»— xuáº¥t hiá»‡n)
  const bm = w.bossGan(false);
  if (bm && ldist(p.x, p.y, bm.x, bm.y) <= w.hdR() * 0.75) { bossDi = null; p.goal = null; p.path = null; return; }
  if (w.zone.id !== b.bai) {
    if (TOWN_KINDS.has(w.zone.kind) && !bossDi.xe) { bossDi.xe = 1; diXe = { z: b.bai, t0: 0, thanh: 1 }; }
    else if (FARM_KINDS.has(w.zone.kind)) veThanh(`Ä‘i tá»›i boss tháº¿ giá»›i ${b.ten}`);
    return;
  }
  if (!bossDi.den) bossDi.den = performance.now();
  if (performance.now() - bossDi.den > 180000) { P.hud.canh(`Trá»£ Thá»§: 3 phÃºt chÆ°a tá»›i Ä‘Æ°á»£c chá»— boss ${b.ten} â€” thÃ´i tá»± Ä‘i tá»›i boss`); bossDi = null; return; }
  if (!p.goal && !p.target) w.walkTo(bm ? bm.x : b.x, bm ? bm.y : b.y);
}

// Trá»£ Thá»§ Æ°u tiÃªn "Tinh anh / Thá»§ lÄ©nh / Boss" (anh 12/11 "auto Ä‘Ã¡nh quÃ¡i, náº¿u chá»n Æ°u tiÃªn Ä‘Ã¡nh boss, tinh anh thÃ¬ lÃªn ngá»±a trong lÃºc di chuyá»ƒn Ä‘áº¿n vá»‹ trÃ­ Ä‘Ã³"):

const NGUA_BOSS_XA = 450, NGUA_BOSS_LAI = 10000;

function nguaBoss() {

  if (!w.auto || !A || A.uuTien !== "dacbiet" || !m || !m.alive || !(m.boss || m.dacBiet || m.btg) || p.manual || p.hp <= 0 || p.sit || w.resting) return;

// Äang tá»± Ä‘Ã¡nh: tráº¡ng thÃ¡i cá»§a mÃ³n háº¿t (hero.buff â€” mÃ¡y chá»§ Ä‘áº¿m) mÃ  trong tÃºi cÃ²n thÃ¬ dÃ¹ng 1 bÃ¬nh; háº¿t Há»“i ThiÃªn TÃ¡i Táº¡o ÄÆ¡n mÃ  cÃ³ Há»“i thiÃªn
// tÃ¡i táº¡o lá»… bao thÃ¬ rÃºt dung.leBao.n viÃªn (mÃ¡y chá»§ do.js dungVat leBao â€” mang tá»‘i Ä‘a 60 bÃ¬nh thuá»‘c). Má»—i láº§n 1 mÃ³n; mÃ¡y chá»§ khÃ´ng cho (Ä‘Ã£ cÃ³
// hiá»‡u quáº£, Ä‘á»§ 60 bÃ¬nhâ€¦) thÃ¬ mÃ³n Ä‘Ã³ 5 phÃºt sau má»›i thá»­ láº¡i
const HTD = "potion:44", LE_BAO_HTD = "ms:2527";
const tuDungLuc = new Map();
let tuDungDang = false;
function tuDungTick() {
  const w = world, A = hero.auto.dung, t = performance.now();
  if (!w || !w.auto || tuDungDang || w.player.hp <= 0 || zoneLoad) return;
  const conBuff = (b) => ((hero.buff || {})[b] || 0) - (performance.now() - buffLuc) / 1000 > 0;
  const thu = (k, lam, duoc) => {
    if (t < (tuDungLuc.get(k) || 0)) return false;
    tuDungLuc.set(k, t + 30000); tuDungDang = true;
    lam().finally(() => { tuDungDang = false; if (!duoc()) tuDungLuc.set(k, performance.now() + 300000); });
    return true;
  };
  // mÃ³n Ä‘Ã£ chá»n á»Ÿ Trá»£ Thá»§ tháº» Thuá»‘c (A.ds â€” lá»™, hoÃ n; anh 31/10 láº§n 3 thanh xá»• xuá»‘ng): háº¿t hiá»‡u quáº£ thÃ¬ dÃ¹ng 1 mÃ³n
  for (const r of A.ds || []) {
    const D = r.on && (ItemDB.item(r.k) || {}).dung; if (!D || D.loai !== "trangThai" || conBuff(D.buff)) continue;
    if (laVatTk(r.k) && !TongKim.laTo()) continue; // hoÃ n Tá»‘ng Kim: chá»‰ dÃ¹ng trong chiáº¿n trÆ°á»ng (ngoÃ i tráº­n mÃ¡y chá»§ khÃ´ng cho â€” khá»i chá» 5 phÃºt)
    const it = (hero.bag || []).find((x) => x.k === r.k && x.n > 0);
    if (it && thu(r.k, () => dungVat(it), () => conBuff(D.buff))) return;
  }
  const lb = A.leBao.on && !potCount(HTD) && (hero.bag || []).find((x) => x.k === LE_BAO_HTD);
  if (lb) thu(LE_BAO_HTD, () => dungVat(lb, { n: A.leBao.n }).then(() => { if (potCount(HTD)) quickAdd(HTD); }), () => potCount(HTD) > 0);
}

// ---------- Tá»• Ä‘á»™i (anh 28/10 láº§n 4 â€” may-chu/to-doi.js; khung Láº­p nhÃ³m: windows.js _team; Trá»£ Thá»§ tháº» ÄÃ¡nh quÃ¡i: hero.auto.doi) ----------

const DOI_GAN = 600;
let doiTt = null, doiLuc = 0;
const moiDaHoi = new Set(), moiLuc = new Map(), moiTuVao = new Set();
function doiApply(d) {
  doiTt = d && d.tv ? d : null;
  if (world) world.coDoi = !!(doiTt && doiTt.mo && doiTt.truong === hero.name); // cá» Ä‘á»™i trÆ°á»Ÿng trÃªn Ä‘áº§u mÃ¬nh (Ä‘á»™i cÃ²n nháº­n ngÆ°á»i)
  if (world) world.doiTen = doiTt ? new Set(doiTt.tv.map((x) => x.ten).filter((n) => n !== hero.name)) : null; // vÃ²ng sÃ¡ng cá»§a Ä‘á»“ng Ä‘á»™i (World.vongDoi)
  for (const t of (d && d.bao) || []) P.hud.msg(t); // cÃ¢u client MSG_TEAM_* (may-chu/to-doi.js)
  const cho = [];
  for (const m of (d && d.moi) || []) {

function khuLam(b, im) {

// "VÃ o bang nÃ y" (khung Bang phÃ¡i) / Trá»£ Thá»§ vá» "nhÃ " lÃ  bÃ£i bang (xeToi): mÃ¡y chá»§ xÃ©t (thÃ nh viÃªn, bang cÃ³ khu, chá»— Ä‘ang Ä‘á»©ng â€” HOP-DONG-DOT-4 2.1) rá»“i tráº£ di

// vÃ o game mÃ  chá»— lÆ°u á»Ÿ bÃ£i bang (nhÆ° tkDangNhap): há»i mÃ¡y chá»§ cÃ²n Ä‘Æ°á»£c á»Ÿ khu khÃ´ng -> { zone, at } (Ä‘Ãºng chá»— cÅ© / Ä‘iá»ƒm vÃ o khu má»›i) | null (vÃ o á»Ÿ Ba LÄƒng huyá»‡n â€”
// START_ZONE, cÃ¢u bÃ¡o khuTinCho). Chá» tá»‘i Ä‘a 6 giÃ¢y
async function khuDangNhap(v) {
  let j = null;
  try { j = await Promise.race([khuLam({ viec: "dangNhap", z: v.z }, true), new Promise((r) => setTimeout(() => r(null), 6000))]); } catch { j = null; }
  const ve = (P.maps.zones.find((z) => z.id === START_ZONE) || {}).n || "Ba LÄƒng huyá»‡n";
  if (!j) { khuTinCho.push(`MÃ¡y chá»§ chÆ°a tráº£ lá»i vá» khu vá»±c bang há»™i â€” vÃ o game á»Ÿ ${ve}`); return null; }
  if (j.loi) { if (!j.boQua && j.ma !== "het-phien") khuTinCho.push(`${j.loi} â€” vÃ o game á»Ÿ ${ve}`); return null; }
  for (const t of j.tin || []) khuTinCho.push(t);
  const z = j.vao && P.maps.zones.find((x) => x.id === j.vao.z && x.bang);
  if (!z) return null;
  return { zone: z, at: j.vao.z === v.z && Number.isFinite(v.x) && Number.isFinite(v.y) ? [v.x, v.y] : Array.isArray(j.vao.at) ? j.vao.at : null };
}
// NPC khu vá»±c bang (npc-them.json bhVai): nhÃ  tÃ¡c phÆ°á»ng theo cáº¥p tÃ¡c phÆ°á»ng cá»§a bang mÃ¬nh (bhCapTP), cá»™t biá»ƒu tÆ°á»£ng theo cáº¥p bang (bhCapBang); chÆ°a cÃ³ dá»¯ liá»‡u bang (khuDl

const khuHien = (n) => {

  return true;
};

// Xa phu khu (client tong_chefu.lua): "Nhá»¯ng nÆ¡i Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘i qua" = bÃ£i luyá»‡n cÃ´ng (miá»…n phÃ­ nhÆ° Xa phu thÃ nh â€” xaPhuFn WayPointFun); "Nhá»¯ng thÃ nh thá»‹ Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘i qua" = Ba LÄƒng huyá»‡n /
// Biá»‡n Kinh, lá»™ phÃ­ khuBang.xaPhu.gia (mÃ¡y chá»§ trá»« â€” khuXaPhu)
function khuXaPhuMo(n) {
  if (!NPCD || !hero) return;

  NPCD.choose("msgsel", "InfoText", noi("Xa phu: Äáº¡i hiá»‡p muá»‘n Ä‘i Ä‘Ã¢u?"), [
    ["Nhá»¯ng nÆ¡i Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘i qua", () => xeHien(xaPhuFn("WayPointFun"), n)],

      [...den.map((d) => [gia > 0 ? `${d.n} [${fmtMoney(gia)}]` : d.n, () => khuXaPhu(d.z)]), ["ÄÃ¢u cÅ©ng khÃ´ng muá»‘n Ä‘i!", null]])],
    ["ÄÃ¢u cÅ©ng khÃ´ng muá»‘n Ä‘i!", null]]);

// hiá»‡n káº¿t quáº£ xaPhuFn ({ text, opts } | { close } | Promise) á»Ÿ khung tá»± dá»±ng (Xa phu khu): lá»±a chá»n dáº¡ng chuá»—i (vd "BanBai:225") Ä‘á»•i thÃ nh hÃ m â€” NPCD.show cáº§n NPC Ä‘ang má»Ÿ
function xeHien(r, n) {
  if (!r || !NPCD || !hero) return;
  if (typeof r.then === "function") return void r.then((x) => xeHien(x, n), () => {});
  if (r.close) return;
  NPCD.choose("msgsel", "InfoText", richText(r.text, hero.name, n.name), (r.opts || []).map(([t, f]) => [t, typeof f === "string" ? () => xeHien(xaPhuFn(f), n) : f]));
}
// Xa phu khu -> thÃ nh z (mÃ¡y chá»§ trá»« lá»™ phÃ­, tráº£ di). troThu: Trá»£ Thá»§ Ä‘i Xa phu (xeTick) â€” lá»—i (thiáº¿u tiá»nâ€¦) bÃ¡o Ä‘á» "Trá»£ Thá»§: â€¦" rá»“i dá»«ng; gá»i láº¡i trong 10 giÃ¢y bá» qua.
// NgÆ°á»i báº¥m: lá»—i thÃ nh lá»i Xa phu (cÃ¢u client "Tá»« bang há»™i Ä‘áº¿n cÃ¡c Ä‘áº¡i thÃ nh thá»‹ cáº§n 800 lÆ°á»£ngâ€¦")
function khuXaPhu(z, troThu) {
  if (!hero || zoneLoad) return;
  if (troThu) { if (performance.now() - khuXeLuc < 10000) return; khuXeLuc = performance.now(); }
  khuLam({ viec: "xaPhu", den: z }, true).then((j) => {
    if (!j || j.boQua || j.ma === "het-phien") return;
    if (j.loi) {
      if (troThu) { P.hud.canh("Trá»£ Thá»§: " + j.loi); diXe = null; }
      else if (NPCD && hero) NPCD.talk([richText(j.loi, hero.name, "Xa phu")], 0, null);
      return;
    }
    for (const t of j.tin || []) P.hud.msg(t);
    if (j.di) diPld(j.di);
  });
}

function khuLamMoi() {
  if (!world || !world.zone.bang || !hero) return;
  const con = 30000 - (performance.now() - khuMoiLuc);
  if (con > 0) { if (!khuMoiHen) khuMoiHen = setTimeout(() => { khuMoiHen = 0; khuLamMoi(); }, con); return; }
  khuMoiLuc = performance.now();
  const cu = khuDl;
  khuLam({ viec: "xem" }, true).then((j) => {
    const K = j && !j.loi ? j.khu : null, w = world;
    if (!K || !w || !w.zone.bang || zoneLoad) return;
    if (cu && (cu.cap | 0) === (K.cap | 0) && JSON.stringify(cu.tp || {}) === JSON.stringify(K.tp || {})) return;
    gotoZone(w.zone, { at: [w.player.x, w.player.y] }).catch(fail);
  });
}

function ruongDat() {

  }
  if (w.npcs.some((q) => q.rtb && !co.has(q.rtb))) w.npcs = w.npcs.filter((q) => !q.rtb || co.has(q.rtb));

// sáº¡p khÃ´ng Ä‘á»©ng Ä‘Ã¨ NPC tháº­t (anh 10/11 "sáº¡p cá»§a ngÆ°á»i khÃ¡c Ä‘Ã¨ lÃªn NPC DÃ£ Táº©u"): NPC trÃ´ng sáº¡p dáº¡t ra vÃ²ng SAP_CACH quanh NPC gáº§n nháº¥t, vá» phÃ­a sáº¡p Ä‘ang Ä‘á»©ng, chá»— Ä‘i Ä‘Æ°á»£c khÃ´ng sÃ¡t NPC khÃ¡c;
// bÃ y sáº¡p má»›i sÃ¡t NPC thÃ¬ khÃ´ng cho (moSap). Chá»§ sáº¡p ngá»“i á»Ÿ chá»— cÅ© váº«n lÃ  chá»— cÅ© (báº¥m NPC tháº­t luÃ´n trÆ°á»›c â€” mouseAct)
const SAP_CACH = 110;
const npcSat = (w, x, y, r) => w.npcs.filter((q) => !q.sap && q.role !== "dummy" && ldist(q.x, q.y, x, y) < r);
function sapDat(w, x, y) {
  const L = npcSat(w, x, y, SAP_CACH).sort((a, b) => ldist(a.x, a.y, x, y) - ldist(b.x, b.y, x, y));
  if (!L.length) return [x, y];
  const g = L[0], a0 = Math.atan2((y - g.y) * 2, x - g.x);
  for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
    const a = a0 + (i % 2 ? 1 : -1) * Math.ceil(i / 2) * (Math.PI / 8), X = g.x + Math.cos(a) * SAP_CACH, Y = g.y + (Math.sin(a) * SAP_CACH) / 2;
    if (w.map.walkable(X, Y) && !npcSat(w, X, Y, SAP_CACH * 0.9).length) return [X, Y];
  }
  return [x, y];
}
// chá»§ sáº¡p Ä‘ang ngá»“i Ä‘Ãºng chá»— sáº¡p: báº£ng hiá»‡u trÃªn Ä‘áº§u chá»§, khÃ´ng cÃ³ NPC trÃ´ng sáº¡p
function sapTick(ngay) {
  const w = world, t = performance.now();
  if (!w || !w.sapDs || (!ngay && t - sapLuc < 300)) return;
  sapLuc = t;
  const bang = new Map(), giu = new Set();
  for (const s of w.sapDs) {
    const minh = s.ten === hero.name, chu = minh ? w.player : w.others.get(s.ten);
    if (chu && (minh ? chu.sit : chu.act === "sit") && ldist(chu.x, chu.y, s.x, s.y) <= SAP_GAN) { bang.set(s.ten, s.qc); continue; }
    giu.add(s.k);
    let n = w.npcs.find((q) => q.sap === s.k);
    if (!n) { n = { t: Math.random() * 2, dir: 4, kind: "npc", role: "talk", sap: s.k, type: SAP_HINH[(s.hinh | 0) % SAP_HINH.length], x: s.x, y: s.y }; w.npcs.push(n); P.npc.ensure(n.type, "stand1").catch(() => {}); }
    if (n.gx !== s.x || n.gy !== s.y) { const [X, Y] = sapDat(w, s.x, s.y); Object.assign(n, { gx: s.x, gy: s.y, x: X, y: Y }); } // sáº¡p Ä‘Ã¨ NPC tháº­t: dáº¡t ra
    Object.assign(n, { name: `Sáº¡p cá»§a ${s.ten}`, qc: s.qc });
  }
  if (w.npcs.some((q) => q.sap && !giu.has(q.sap))) w.npcs = w.npcs.filter((q) => !q.sap || giu.has(q.sap));
  w.bangHieu = bang;
}

const RS_NAC = 0.15, RS_MIN = 1, RS_THAP = 30;
let rs = 1, rsXau = 0, rsCho = null;
function resize() {
  dpr = Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1); vw = innerWidth; vh = innerHeight;
  cv.width = Math.round(vw * dpr * rs); cv.height = Math.round(vh * dpr * rs);
}
function rsTick(f, jsMs) {
  const tk = !!(world && TongKim.laTo()), han = khungNenNay() || (DT && DT.on && DT.khung && DT.khung <= RS_THAP); // game tá»± hÃ£m khung (cá»­a sá»• ná»n / Ä‘iá»‡n thoáº¡i): khÃ´ng tÃ­nh
  let moi = rs;
  if (!tk) { moi = 1; rsXau = 0; }
  else if (!han && f < RS_THAP && jsMs < 500 / f) { if (++rsXau >= 6) { rsXau = 0; moi = Math.max(RS_MIN, Math.round((rs - RS_NAC) * 100) / 100); } }
  else rsXau = 0;
  if (moi !== rs) rsCho = moi; // Ä‘á»•i Ä‘áº§u khung káº¿ (loop â€” ngay trÆ°á»›c lÃºc váº½, khÃ´ng lá»™ khung Ä‘en)
}

  const cx = m.w <= W ? (m.w - W) / 2 : Math.max(0, Math.min(m.w - W, px - W / 2));
  const cy = m.h <= H ? (m.h - H) / 2 : Math.max(0, Math.min(m.h - H, py - H * (DT ? DT.neoY() : 0.55))); // Ä‘iá»‡n thoáº¡i dá»c: giá»¯a pháº§n cáº£nh cÃ²n tháº¥y
  return [Math.round(cx), Math.round(cy)];
}

  return true;

const HOLD_T = 0.15, HOLD_MIN = 12;
let hold = null;
function holdStart(e) {
  if (e.button !== 0) return;
  hold = { id: e.pointerId, cx: e.clientX, cy: e.clientY, at: performance.now() };
  try { cv.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch {}
  world.holdMove = true;
}
function holdEnd() {
  if (!hold) return;
  hold = null;
  if (!world) return;
  world.holdMove = false;
  if (world.auto) { const p = world.player; p.goal = null; p.path = null; p.manual = false; world.neo = [p.x, p.y]; }
}
function holdTick(now) {
  if (!hold || now - hold.at < HOLD_T * 1000 || hold.thang) return; // thang: cáº§n Ä‘ang cháº¡y tháº³ng (joyMove)
  hold.at = now; world.holdMove = true; // (Ä‘á»•i bÃ£i giá»¯a lÃºc giá»¯: World má»›i)
  const p = world.player; if (p.hp <= 0 || p.dash || p.sit || (p.once && p.target && p.target.alive) || p.cast || p.queueSelf) return;
  const x = hold.cx / zoom + cam.x, y = hold.cy / zoom + cam.y;
  if (ldist(p.x, p.y, x, y) < HOLD_MIN) return; // con trá» ngay trÃªn ngÆ°á»i: Ä‘á»©ng
  if (p.goal && ldist(p.goal[0], p.goal[1], x, y) < 6 && p.path && p.path.length) return;
  world.clickGround(x, y);
}

// Anh 01/11 ("joystick kÃ©o Ä‘i ráº¥t khá»±ng, di chuyá»ƒn vÃ  linh hoáº¡t ráº¥t kÃ©m"): á»Ÿ bÃ£i nhiá»u cÃ¢y / Ä‘Ã¡ Ä‘oáº¡n 150 tháº³ng hay vÆ°á»›ng -> rÆ¡i xuá»‘ng tÃ¬m Ä‘Æ°á»ng
// theo Ã´ má»—i 0,15 giÃ¢y (giáº­t, Ä‘Æ°á»ng vÃ²ng). Nay thá»­ thÃªm gÃ³c lá»‡ch Â±15Â° â€¦ Â±90Â° vÃ  Ä‘oáº¡n ngáº¯n hÆ¡n (JOY_DOAN) trÆ°á»›c khi tÃ¬m Ä‘Æ°á»ng
const JOY_R = 120, JOY_DI = 150, JOY_DOAN = [1, 0.6, 0.3], JOY_GOC = [0, 0.26, -0.26, 0.52, -0.52, 0.79, -0.79, 1.05, -1.05, 1.31, -1.31, 1.57, -1.57];
function joyMove(d) {
  if (!world) return;
  if (!d) { if (hold && hold.id === "joy") { holdEnd(); const p = world.player; p.goal = null; p.path = null; } return; }
  if (!hold || hold.id !== "joy") { holdEnd(); hold = { id: "joy", at: 0 }; world.holdMove = true; }
  const p = world.player, M = world.map;
  hold.cx = (p.x - cam.x) * zoom + d[0] * JOY_R; hold.cy = (p.y - cam.y) * zoom + d[1] * JOY_R; hold.thang = false;
  // cáº§n Ä‘Æ°á»£c Æ°u tiÃªn hÆ¡n chiÃªu (anh 31/10 láº§n 2 "Ä‘ang kÃ©o chiÃªu mÃ  kÃ©o thanh di chuyá»ƒn thÃ¬ nhÃ¢n váº­t Æ°u tiÃªn di chuyá»ƒn"): bá» Ä‘Ã²n Ä‘ang chá» â€” chiÃªu
  // nháº¯m 1 con (once: cháº¡y tá»›i con Ä‘Ã³ rá»“i ra), chiÃªu vÃ o khoáº£ng khÃ´ng chá» vung xong (queueAt); Ä‘ang vung / ra chiÃªu dá»Ÿ thÃ¬ xong má»›i cháº¡y
  p.once = null; p.queueAt = null;
  // anh 04/11 lÆ°á»£t 25 ("Ä‘Ã¡nh boss, kÃ©o joystick nÃ³ k Ä‘i, pháº£i báº¥m vÃ  Ä‘Ã¨ ra chá»— khÃ¡c thÃ¬ nhÃ¢n váº­t má»›i di chuyá»ƒn"): bá» má»¥c tiÃªu / Ä‘á»“ / NPC Ä‘ang tá»›i cáº£
  // lÃºc Ä‘ang vung / ra chiÃªu dá»Ÿ (nhÆ° cháº¡m Ä‘áº¥t â€” World.clickGround; chiÃªu dá»Ÿ váº«n ra vÃ o con Ä‘Ã£ nháº¯m â€” p.cast.target). TrÆ°á»›c chá»‰ bá» khi Ä‘i tháº³ng Ä‘Æ°á»£c, mÃ 
  // Ä‘ang ra chiÃªu thÃ¬ thoÃ¡t sá»›m -> tá»± Ä‘Ã¡nh ra chiÃªu káº¿ liá»n vÃ o boss (p.target cÃ²n), cáº§n khÃ´ng bao giá» cháº¡y
  if (p.hp > 0) { p.talkTo = null; p.target = null; p.loot = null; }
  if (p.hp <= 0 || p.dash || p.sit || p.cast || p.queueSelf) return;
  for (const f of JOY_DOAN) for (const a of JOY_GOC) {
    if (f < 1 && Math.abs(a) > 1.06) continue; // Ä‘oáº¡n ngáº¯n: chá»‰ lá»‡ch tá»›i 60Â° (lá»‡ch 75â€“90Â° chá»‰ khi Ä‘oáº¡n dÃ i â€” trÆ°á»£t dá»c tÆ°á»ng)
    const c = Math.cos(a), s = Math.sin(a), ux = d[0] * c - d[1] * s, uy = d[0] * s + d[1] * c, k = (JOY_DI * f) / (Math.hypot(ux, 2 * uy) || 1), x = p.x + ux * k, y = p.y + uy * k;
    if (M.walkable(x, y) && M.clear(p.x, p.y, x, y)) { p.talkTo = null; p.target = null; p.loot = null; p.goal = [x, y]; p.path = [[x, y]]; p.manual = true; hold.thang = true; return; }
  }

  clear(ax, ay, bx, by) {

    const x1 = Math.floor(bx / cw), y1 = Math.floor(by / ch), dx = bx - ax, dy = by - ay, sx = Math.sign(dx), sy = Math.sign(dy);
    if (!ok(x, y) || !ok(x1, y1)) return false;

    for (let guard = W + H + 4; (x !== x1 || y !== y1) && guard > 0; guard--) {
      if (Math.abs(tx - ty) < 1e-9) { // qua Ä‘Ãºng gÃ³c Ã´

      } else if (tx < ty) { x += sx; tx += tdx; } else { y += sy; ty += tdy; }
      if (!ok(x, y)) return false;
    }
    return true;
  }

  nearestCell(x, y, r = 12) {

    if (i >= 0 && this.grid[i]) return i;
    const cx = Math.floor(x / this.cw), cy = Math.floor(y / this.ch);

    for (let dy = -r * 2; dy <= r * 2; dy++) for (let dx = -r; dx <= r; dx++) {

      if (X < 0 || Y < 0 || X >= this.gw || Y >= this.gh || !this.grid[Y * this.gw + X]) continue;
      const d = Math.hypot(dx * this.cw, dy * this.ch * 2);
      if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = Y * this.gw + X; }
    }
    return best;
  }

  // A* trÃªn lÆ°á»›i (chi phÃ­ theo logic: Ã´ vuÃ´ng cw Ã— 2ch), rá»“i rÃºt gá»n Ä‘iá»ƒm báº±ng clear(). Tráº£ vá» [[x,y], â€¦] (khÃ´ng gá»“m Ä‘iá»ƒm Ä‘áº§u)
  // hoáº·c null náº¿u khÃ´ng tá»›i Ä‘Æ°á»£c. maxNodes giá»›i háº¡n cÃ´ng sá»©c cho quÃ¡i. nang > 1: A* náº·ng heuristic (Ä‘Æ°á»ng cÃ³ thá»ƒ dÃ i hÆ¡n chÃºt, má»Ÿ Ã­t nÃºt hÆ¡n nhiá»u â€” báº¥m NPC
  // á»Ÿ xa: World.clickNpc tÃ¬m láº¡i khi láº§n thÆ°á»ng háº¿t ngÃ¢n sÃ¡ch)
  path(ax, ay, bx, by, maxNodes = 20000, nang = 1) {

    const s = this.nearestCell(ax, ay), t = this.nearestCell(bx, by);

    // khÃ¡c vÃ¹ng liá»n (Ä‘áº£o, háº­u doanh Tá»‘ng Kim chá»‰ ná»‘i báº±ng báº«y dá»‹ch chuyá»ƒnâ€¦): khÃ´ng bao giá» tá»›i Ä‘Æ°á»£c â€” tráº£ null ngay, khá»i tÃ¬m háº¿t ngÃ¢n sÃ¡ch (dá»±ng lÆ°á»›i giá»¯ nguyÃªn cáº£
    // vÃ¹ng liá»n: comp Ä‘Ãºng vá»›i _nb trÃªn lÆ°á»›i). SoÃ¡t 13/11: Trá»£ Thá»§ "Theo sau" ngÆ°á»i Ä‘ang á»Ÿ háº­u doanh -> walkTo tÃ¬m láº¡i 150000 nÃºt má»—i bÆ°á»›c

    // Ba LÄƒng ~3 MB / láº§n, Biá»‡n Kinh ~17 MB / láº§n -> dá»n rÃ¡c liÃªn tá»¥c, giáº­t). Ã” chá»‰ cÃ³ giÃ¡ trá»‹ khi dáº¥u = lÆ°á»£t hiá»‡n táº¡i (gen): khÃ´ng pháº£i xÃ³a cáº£ lÆ°á»›i

    if (++S.gen >= 0x7ffffff0) { S.dau.fill(0); S.gen = 1; }

    const gOf = (i) => ((dau[i] | 1) === (gen | 1) ? g[i] : Infinity);

      }

    cells.reverse();

    pts[pts.length - 1] = this.walkable(bx, by) ? [bx, by] : pts[pts.length - 1];
    // rÃºt gá»n: tá»« Ä‘iá»ƒm hiá»‡n táº¡i nháº£y tá»›i Ä‘iá»ƒm xa nháº¥t cÃ²n Ä‘i tháº³ng Ä‘Æ°á»£c
    const out = [];
    let cx = ax, cy = ay, k = 0;
    while (k < pts.length) {
      let j = pts.length - 1;
      while (j > k && !this.clear(cx, cy, pts[j][0], pts[j][1])) j--;
      out.push(pts[j]); [cx, cy] = pts[j]; k = j + 1;
    }
    return out;
  }

  // Äiá»ƒm Ä‘i Ä‘Æ°á»£c ngáº«u nhiÃªn; avoid(x, y) tráº£ true thÃ¬ bá» (vd quÃ¡ gáº§n ngÆ°á»i chÆ¡i / quÃ¡i khÃ¡c)
  randomSpot(rand, avoid, tries = 200) {
    for (let k = 0; k < tries; k++) {
      let x, y;
      if (this.grid) { [x, y] = this.center(this.cells[Math.floor(rand() * this.cells.length)]); }
      else { x = 150 + rand() * (this.w - 300); y = 150 + rand() * (this.h - 300); }
      if (!avoid || !avoid(x, y)) return [x, y];
    }
    return null;
  }
}

// HÃ ng Ä‘á»£i Æ°u tiÃªn nhá» nháº¥t (Ä‘á»‘ng nhá»‹ phÃ¢n) cho A*
class Heap {
  constructor() { this.k = []; this.v = []; }
  get size() { return this.k.length; }
  push(key, pri) {
    const K = this.k, V = this.v; let i = K.length; K.push(key); V.push(pri);
    while (i > 0) { const p = (i - 1) >> 1; if (V[p] <= V[i]) break; [K[p], K[i]] = [K[i], K[p]]; [V[p], V[i]] = [V[i], V[p]]; i = p; }
  }
  pop() {
    const K = this.k, V = this.v, top = K[0], lk = K.pop(), lv = V.pop();
    if (K.length) {
      K[0] = lk; V[0] = lv; let i = 0;
      for (;;) {
        const l = i * 2 + 1, r = l + 1; let m = i;
        if (l < K.length && V[l] < V[m]) m = l;
        if (r < K.length && V[r] < V[m]) m = r;
        if (m === i) break;
        [K[m], K[i]] = [K[i], K[m]]; [V[m], V[i]] = [V[i], V[m]]; i = m;
      }
    }
    return top;
  }
}

// World.hit gá»i khi má»™c nhÃ¢n Äƒn Ä‘Ã²n: cá»™ng sÃ¡t thÆ°Æ¡ng, mÃ¡u vá» Ä‘áº§y (cá»c Ä‘áº£o Táº©y Tá»§y: máº¥t mÃ¡u tháº­t, háº¿t mÃ¡u thÃ¬ vá»¡)
export function mocNhanTrung(world, m, v) {
  const d = m.dps, t = world.time;
  if (t - d.last > NGHI) { d.t0 = t; d.fight = 0; }
  d.fight += v; d.total += v; d.hits++; d.max = Math.max(d.max, v); d.last = t;
  if (!m.coc) { m.hp = m.hpMax; return; }
  if (m.hp > 0) return;
  m.hp = 0; m.alive = false; m.deadT = 0; world.setAct(m, "die");
  if (world.player.target === m) world.player.target = null;
}

// dv: Ä‘Æ¡n vá»‹ (máº·c Ä‘á»‹nh "lÆ°á»£ng"; dÃ²ng Xu cá»§a tÃºi: "xu")
export function fmtMoney(n, dv = "lÆ°á»£ng") {
  const neg = n < 0; n = Math.floor(Math.abs(n || 0));
  const uc = Math.floor(n / 1e8), van = Math.floor((n % 1e8) / 1e4), luong = n % 1e4, p = [];
  if (uc) p.push(uc + " á»©c");
  if (van) p.push(van + " váº¡n");
  if (luong || !p.length) p.push(String(luong));
  return (neg ? "-" : "") + p.join(" ") + " " + dv;
}

  save(hero) {
    if (!this.me || !hero) return;
    const o = hero.slot | 0;
    this.me.nv[o] = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(hero));

  },

        }
      }
    } finally {

      if (this._again) { this._again = false; this.flush(); }
    }
  },

export function richText(s, name, npcName = "") {
  s = String(s || "").replace(/\{TEN\}|%s/g, name).replace(/\{NPC\}/g, npcName)
    .replace(/^\s*(<#>)?\s*<link=[^>]*>[^<]*<link>\s*(<#>)?\s*:?\s*/i, "").replace(/<link=[^>]*>([^<]*)<link>/gi, "$1")
    .replace(/^[^<]*<#>\s*:\s*/, "").replace(/<#>|<dec>|<npc>/gi, "");
  let out = "", open = false;
  for (const part of s.split(/(<color(?:=[^>]*)?>|<enter>)/i)) {
    const m = /^<color(?:=([^>]*))?>$/i.exec(part);
    if (m) { if (open) { out += "</span>"; open = false; } if (m[1]) { out += `<span style="color:${COLOR[m[1].toLowerCase()] || m[1]}">`; open = true; } continue; }
    if (/^<enter>$/i.test(part)) { out += "<br>"; continue; }
    out += esc(part);
  }
  return out + (open ? "</span>" : "");
}

const KEO_GAN = 400, TRON_MS = 300, VE_DU = 0.05, VE_MAX = 1, VE_NHO = 0.98, VE_GIU = 12;
const CHANG_R = 110;           // tá»›i gáº§n Ä‘iá»ƒm Ä‘Ã­ch cháº·ng chá»«ng nÃ y (logic) thÃ¬ sang cháº·ng káº¿

const DUOI_X = 1.6;            // bá» Ä‘uá»•i khi má»¥c tiÃªu ra xa chá»— báº¯t Ä‘áº§u Ä‘Ã¡nh quÃ¡ táº§m hoáº¡t Ä‘á»™ng Ã— DUOI_X
const TAM_DANH = { cs: 150, tb: 160, ct: 120 }; // táº§m Ä‘Ã¡nh (logic) cá»§a tÆ°á»›ng â€” ká»‹ch báº£n client dÃ¹ng chiÃªu xa, game Ä‘Ã¡nh thÆ°á»ng

const MAU_TEN = ["#ffffff", "#ffb74d", "#6e96ff"], MAU_PHE = "#8dff8d";
const CHAN_R = 36, CHAN_MS = 1500; // trÆ°á»›c khai chiáº¿n: bÆ°á»›c vÃ o dáº£i trap cháº¯n (trapline1013 / 2012 / 3012) thÃ¬ bá»‹ Ä‘áº©y vá» trong thÃ nh

export const PhongHoa = {
  api: null, D: null, p: null, w: null, spec: null, mob: new Map(), vt: new Map(), qb: new Map(), dh: null, hpSv: new Map(), lech: 0, seq: 0,
  cho: new Map(), st: new Map(), daTT: new Map(), gui: [], dan: new Map(), npc: new Map(), chuCu: null, tinDa: 0, daRa: false, chanLuc: 0,
  guiLuc: 0, vtLuc: 0, vtDuLuc: 0, chonLuc: 0, datLuc: 0, xinLuc: 0, songLuc: 0, npcLuc: 0, duongLuc: 0,

  laTo() { return !!(this.p && this.w && this.D && this.w.zone.id === this.D.bai && this.p.u); },
  laChu() { return this.laTo() && this.p.chu === this.w.hero.name && !this.p.ket; },
  ganWorld(w) {
    this.w = w; this.p = null; this.spec = null; this.mob = new Map(); this.vt = new Map(); this.qb = new Map(); this.dh = null; this.hpSv = new Map();
    this.cho.clear(); this.st.clear(); this.daTT.clear(); this.dan.clear(); this.npc.clear(); this.gui = []; this.chuCu = null; this.daRa = false;
    if (w) {
      w.dongMinh = []; this.xinLuc = 0; this.xin();
    }
  },
  xin() { const t = performance.now(); if (t - this.xinLuc > 1000) { this.xinLuc = t; this.songLuc = t; Net.wsGui({ t: "phVao", s: this.seq }); Net.wsGui({ t: "phAn", an: document.hidden ? 1 : 0 }); } },
  gioSv() { return Date.now() + this.lech; },

  capNhat(p) {
    if (!this.w || !this.D) return;
    if (!p || p.khong) { this.p = p; return this.roi(p && p.khong ? "NgÆ°Æ¡i chÆ°a bÃ¡o danh tráº­n nÃ y â€” má»i vá» Biá»‡n Kinh." : "Tráº­n Phong Há»a LiÃªn ThÃ nh Ä‘Ã£ káº¿t thÃºc."); }
    if (this.p && this.p.u === p.u && p.gio < this.p.gio) return;
    this.lech = p.gio - Date.now();
    if (this.p && this.p.u !== p.u) { this.spec = null; this.hpSv.clear(); }
    if (p.q) { this.spec = { sv: p.sv, q: p.q }; const t = performance.now(); for (const r of p.vt || []) this.vt.set(r[0], { x: r[1], y: r[2], muc: r[3] || null, luc: t }); }
    else if (p.qd) {
      if (this.spec && this.spec.sv === p.qd.tu) {
        const M = new Map(this.spec.q.map((r) => [r[0], r]));
        for (const u of p.qd.x) { M.delete(u); this.hpSv.delete(u); }
        for (const r of p.qd.a) M.set(r[0], r);
        this.spec = { sv: p.sv, q: [...M.values()] };
      } else { this.xinLuc = 0; this.xin(); }
    }
    for (const [u, ten] of p.dan || []) this.dan.set(u, ten);
    if (p.hp) this.hpSv = new Map(p.hp); else for (const [u, v] of p.hd || []) this.hpSv.set(u, v);
    // tin trong tráº­n (Msg2MSAll cá»§a ká»‹ch báº£n): hiá»‡n cÃ¢u má»›i
    for (const [id, text, mau] of p.tin || []) if (id > this.tinDa) { this.tinDa = id; if (this.api) this.api.msg(text, mau || null); }
    this.p = p;
    this.gui = this.gui.filter((g) => g.s > (p.ack | 0));
    this.dat();
  },
  // Ä‘Æ°a ra Biá»‡n Kinh 1 láº§n (háº¿t tráº­n, chÆ°a bÃ¡o danh, khÃ´ng cÃ³ tráº­n)
  roi(cau) { if (this.daRa || !this.api) return; this.daRa = true; if (cau) this.api.msg(cau); this.api.veThanh(); },

  doan(uid) { let v = this.cho.get(uid) || 0; for (const g of this.gui) v += g.d.get(uid) || 0; return v; },

  // dá»±ng / bá» / háº¡ / Ä‘áº·t mÃ¡u cÃ¡c con trÃªn World theo tráº¡ng thÃ¡i mÃ¡y chá»§
  dat() {
    const w = this.w; if (!this.laTo() || !this.spec) return;
    const t = performance.now(), hp = this.hpSv, co = new Set(this.spec.q.map((s) => s[0])), K = this.p.khang ?? 50;
    this.datLuc = t;
    for (const [u, m] of this.mob) {
      if (co.has(u)) continue;
      const L = m.phe ? w.dongMinh : w.mobs, i = L.indexOf(m);
      if (i >= 0) L.splice(i, 1);
      if (w.player.target === m) w.player.target = null;
      this.mob.delete(u); this.qb.delete(u);
    }
    for (const s of this.spec.q) {
      const [uid, tpl, lv, he, hpMax, x0, y0, loai, vai, duong, cs, phe, st0, st1, ar, def, chieu, stChieu, toc] = s, mau = hp.get(uid) ?? 0;
      let m = this.mob.get(uid);
      if (m && !m.alive && m.duDoan && !m.daDem && mau > 0 && t - m.duDoan > DOAN_MS) { const i = w.mobs.indexOf(m); if (i >= 0) w.mobs.splice(i, 1); this.mob.delete(uid); m = null; }
      if (!m) {
        if (mau <= 0) continue;
        const v = this.vt.get(uid), at = v ? [v.x, v.y] : [x0, y0];
        m = w.spawnMob(loai === 1, 0, { id: tpl, lvl: lv, series: he, at });
        if (!m) continue;
        if (phe) { const i = w.mobs.indexOf(m); if (i >= 0) w.mobs.splice(i, 1); w.dongMinh.push(m); }
        const D = this.D, ten = (D.mau[{ th: "tieuHieu", dt: "doiTruong", tp: "tienPhong", ct: "chuTuong", cs: "chuSoai", xe: "xe", tb: "thanBinh", ve: "veBinh", tq: "tuongQuan" }[vai]] || {}).ten || m.name;
        Object.assign(m, { vaDoi: uid, ph: 1, phe, vai, duong, cs, hpMax, hp: Math.min(hpMax, mau), dmg: [st0, st1], ar, def, name: ten, mauTen: phe ? MAU_PHE : MAU_TEN[loai] || "#ffffff",
          res: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(m.res).map(([k, r]) => [k, Math.min(r, K)])), home: phe || vai === "tb" ? [x0, y0] : [at[0], at[1]], nha: [x0, y0],
          mucTen: null, muc: null, aggro: false, walk: m.run * (toc > 0 ? toc : 1), boss: loai === 1, ta: loai === 2, dacBiet: loai !== 0, soMau: loai !== 0 || vai === "tq" });
        delete m.vc; // Ä‘Ã¡nh thÆ°á»ng nhÆ° nhau á»Ÿ má»i mÃ¡y (sÃ¡t thÆ°Æ¡ng giá»¯a NPC tÃ­nh á»Ÿ mÃ¡y chá»§ bÃ£i)
        // táº§m Ä‘Ã²n thÆ°á»ng (soÃ¡t lÆ°á»£t 92): bá» táº§m chiÃªu máº«u World.spawnMob -> ganVoCong gÃ¡n lÃºc sinh (tá»›i 300 â€” Ä‘Ã£ bá» chiÃªu mÃ  cÃ²n táº§m thÃ¬ Ä‘Ã¡nh thÆ°á»ng tá»« xa,
        // ngoÃ i táº§m vá»‡ binh / tÆ°á»›ng quÃ¢n chá»n má»¥c tiÃªu nÃªn phe mÃ¬nh khÃ´ng Ä‘Ã¡nh tráº£ Ä‘Æ°á»£c) -> táº§m gá»‘c cá»§a máº«u (nhÆ° rules.js mobStats), tÆ°á»›ng theo TAM_DANH
        m.reach = TAM_DANH[vai] ? TAM_DANH[vai] * 0.75 : ((w.P.reach && w.P.reach[tpl]) || 75) * 0.75;
        // quÃ¢n háº¡ng cao: chiÃªu mÃ¡y chá»§ chá»n Ä‘Ã¡nh ngÆ°á»i chÆ¡i (vocong.js ganChieuDs â€” táº§m Ä‘á»©ng Ä‘Ã¡nh theo chiÃªu xa nháº¥t)
        if (!phe && Array.isArray(chieu) && chieu.length && w.ganChieuDs) w.ganChieuDs(m, chieu, stChieu);
        if (vai === "xe") m.vision = 0;
        if (phe) m.active = TAM_VE * 0.75 * 2.2;
        this.mob.set(uid, m);
      }
      if (mau <= 0) { if (!m.daDem) { m.daDem = 1; if (m.alive) w.kill(m); } continue; }
      if (!m.alive) continue;
      m.hp = Math.max(1, Math.min(m.hpMax, mau - (m.phe ? 0 : this.doan(uid))));
      if (cs > (m.cs | 0)) m.cs = cs;
    }
  },

  viTri(q, ts) {
    const t = performance.now(), now = t / 1000, T = ts > 0 ? ts / 1000 : now, chu = this.p ? this.p.chu : null;
    let D = this.dh;
    if (!D || D.chu !== chu || T <= D.last - 10 || T - D.last > 10) { D = this.dh = { off: now - T, lag: 0.15, gap: VT_MS / 1000, last: T, chu }; this.qb.clear(); }
    else if (T > D.last) { D.gap = D.gap * 0.8 + Math.min(1, T - D.last) * 0.2; D.last = T; }
    const age = now - T; D.off = Math.min(D.off, age); D.lag = Math.max(D.lag * VE_NHO, age - D.off);
    for (const r of q || []) {
      this.vt.set(r[0], { x: r[1], y: r[2], muc: r[3] || null, luc: t });
      const m = this.mob.get(r[0]); if (m && (r[5] | 0) > (m.cs | 0)) m.cs = r[5] | 0;
      const B = this.qb.get(r[0]) || this.qb.set(r[0], []).get(r[0]), z = B[B.length - 1];
      if (z && T <= z.T) continue;
      if (z && T - z.T > D.gap * 1.5 + 0.05 && (z.x !== r[1] || z.y !== r[2])) B.push({ T: T - D.gap, x: z.x, y: z.y, n: z.n });
      B.push({ T, x: r[1], y: r[2], n: r[4] | 0 });
      if (B.length > VE_GIU) B.splice(0, B.length - VE_GIU);
    }
  },
  trangThai(st) {
    const w = this.w; if (!w) return;
    for (const [uid, a, b] of st || []) {
      const m = this.mob.get(uid); if (!m || !m.alive) continue;
      if (a > 0) m.stunUntil = Math.max(m.stunUntil || 0, w.time + a / 1000);
      if (b > 0) m.slowUntil = Math.max(m.slowUntil || 0, w.time + b / 1000);
      this.daTT.set(uid, [m.stunUntil || 0, m.slowUntil || 0]);
    }
  },

  // World.hit: sÃ¡t thÆ°Æ¡ng mÃ¬nh gÃ¢y cho quÃ¢n Ä‘á»‹ch m (Ä‘Ã£ trá»« á»Ÿ mÃ¡y mÃ¬nh)
  trung(m, v) {
    if (!this.laTo() || !this.mob.has(m.vaDoi) || m.phe) return;
    this.cho.set(m.vaDoi, (this.cho.get(m.vaDoi) || 0) + v);
    if (this.laChu() && !m.mucTen && m.vai !== "xe") { m.mucTen = this.w.hero.name; m.home = [m.x, m.y]; }
    const mau = this.hpSv.get(m.vaDoi);
    if (mau != null && !m.duDoan && mau - this.doan(m.vaDoi) <= 0) { m.duDoan = performance.now(); this.guiNgay(); }
  },
  ttMoi(m) {
    const w = this.w; if (!this.laTo() || !this.mob.has(m.vaDoi)) return;
    const su = m.stunUntil || 0, sl = m.slowUntil || 0, cu = this.daTT.get(m.vaDoi) || [0, 0];
    if (su <= cu[0] + 0.05 && sl <= cu[1] + 0.05) return;
    this.daTT.set(m.vaDoi, [Math.max(su, cu[0]), Math.max(sl, cu[1])]);
    this.st.set(m.vaDoi, [Math.max(0, Math.round((su - w.time) * 1000)), Math.max(0, Math.round((sl - w.time) * 1000))]);
  },
  // World.updateMob: con m (mÃ¡y chá»§ bÃ£i tá»± cháº¡y) vung trÃºng NPC muc (vá»‡ binh / tÆ°á»›ng quÃ¢n hoáº·c lÃ­nh) -> sÃ¡t thÆ°Æ¡ng nhÆ° quÃ¡i Ä‘Ã¡nh ngÆ°á»i (mobDamage),
  // gom gá»­i mÃ¡y chá»§; mÃ¡u trÃªn mÃ¡y mÃ¬nh Ä‘oÃ¡n trÆ°á»›c (mÃ¡y chá»§ bÃ¡o láº¡i)
  danhNpc(m, muc) {
    if (!this.laChu() || !muc || !muc.alive || !this.mob.has(muc.vaDoi) || !!m.phe === !!muc.phe) return;
    const d = R.mobDamage(m, muc);
    if (d.miss) { this.w.text(muc, "NÃ©", "#cfd8dc"); return; }
    this.npc.set(muc.vaDoi, (this.npc.get(muc.vaDoi) || 0) + d.v);
    muc.hp = Math.max(1, muc.hp - d.v);
    this.w.text(muc, String(d.v), muc.phe ? "#ff6b5b" : "#ffffff");
  },
  layNhip() { return Net.wsOk || !this.laTo() || (!this.cho.size && !this.st.size) ? null : this.goi(); },
  goi() {
    const s = ++this.seq, d = [...this.cho].map(([u, v]) => [u, Math.round(v)]), st = [...this.st].map(([u, [a, b]]) => [u, a, b]);
    this.gui.push({ s, d: new Map(this.cho), luc: performance.now() }); this.cho.clear(); this.st.clear();
    return { s, d, ...(st.length ? { st } : {}) };
  },
  guiNgay() { if (Net.wsOk && (this.cho.size || this.st.size)) { this.guiLuc = performance.now(); Net.wsGui({ t: "phd", ...this.goi() }); } },

  // má»—i khung hÃ¬nh (main.js)
  tick() {
    if (!this.w || !this.D) return;
    const t = performance.now(), w = this.w;
    if (t - this.songLuc >= SONG_MS) { this.songLuc = t; Net.wsGui({ t: "phAn", an: document.hidden ? 1 : 0 }); }
    if (!this.laTo()) return this.xin();
    const P = this.p;
    if (P.ket && P.ra && this.gioSv() >= P.ra) return this.roi("Tráº­n Ä‘Ã£ káº¿t thÃºc â€” má»i vá» Biá»‡n Kinh.");
    if (P.pha === "bd") this.chan(t);
    if (t - this.datLuc >= DAT_MS) this.dat();
    for (const m of this.mob.values()) if (m.alive && m.duDoan) w.kill(m);
    if ((this.cho.size || this.st.size) && t - this.guiLuc >= GUI_MS) this.guiNgay();
    if (this.gui.length && t - this.gui[0].luc > BO_CHO) this.gui = this.gui.filter((g) => t - g.luc <= BO_CHO);
    const chu = this.laChu();
    if (chu !== this.chuCu) { this.chuCu = chu; this.dh = null; this.qb.clear(); for (const m of this.mob.values()) { m.ngoai = false; m.tron = null; m.atkThay = null; m.path = null; } }
    if (chu) {
      if (t - this.chonLuc >= CHON_MS) { this.chonLuc = t; this.chonMuc(); }
      if (t - this.duongLuc >= DUONG_MS) { this.duongLuc = t; this.diDuong(); }
      if (t - this.vtLuc >= VT_MS) { this.vtLuc = t; this.baoViTri(t); }
      if (this.npc.size && t - this.npcLuc >= NPC_MS) { this.npcLuc = t; Net.wsGui({ t: "phn", d: [...this.npc].map(([u, v]) => [u, Math.round(v)]) }); this.npc.clear(); }
    } else this.theoChu();
    const ten = w.hero.name;
    for (const m of this.mob.values()) if (m.alive) m.muc = !m.mucTen ? null : m.mucTen[0] === "#" ? this.sang(m.mucTen) : m.mucTen === ten ? w.player : w.others.get(m.mucTen) || null;
  },
  sang(k) { const m = this.mob.get(+k.slice(1)); return m && m.alive ? m : null; },

  // dÃ²ng tráº¡ng thÃ¡i lÃºc á»Ÿ tráº­n (game.css #phtt â€” anh 04/11 chá»n: mÃ¡y tÃ­nh máº«u 2 = khung dá»c dÆ°á»›i báº£n Ä‘á»“ nhá», nhÃ£n trÃ¡i sá»‘ pháº£i; Ä‘iá»‡n thoáº¡i máº«u 3 = 2
  // dÃ²ng giá»¯a trÃªn, váº¡ch Ä‘iá»ƒm thá»§ thÃ nh + cá» tÆ°á»›ng quÃ¢n): bÃ¡o danh -> giá» khai chiáº¿n; Ä‘ang Ä‘Ã¡nh -> giá» cÃ²n, Ä‘iá»ƒm thá»§ thÃ nh, tÆ°á»›ng quÃ¢n cÃ²n, binh lá»±c Ä‘á»‹ch
  // (xe), Chá»§ soÃ¡i, sá»‘ con mÃ¬nh háº¡; xong -> káº¿t quáº£ + giá» vá» Biá»‡n Kinh. Káº¿t thÃºc: báº£ng káº¿t quáº£ (#phkq) â€” háº¡ / kinh nghiá»‡m trong tráº­n / thÆ°á»Ÿng
  ve(w) {
    const p = this.p, tai = !!w && this.w === w && this.laTo();
    if (!tai) { for (const el of [this.el, this.kq]) if (el && el.style.display !== "none") { el.style.display = "none"; el.dataset.sig = ""; } return; }
    if (!this.el) { this.el = document.createElement("div"); this.el.id = "phtt"; document.body.appendChild(this.el); }
    const now = this.gioSv(), mmss = (ms) => { const s = Math.max(0, Math.round(ms / 1000)); return `${Math.floor(s / 60)}:${String(s % 60).padStart(2, "0")}`; };
    const dt = document.body.classList.contains("dt"), kq = p.ket ? (p.ket === "thang" ? "thá»§ thÃ nh thÃ nh cÃ´ng" : p.ket === "huy" ? "tráº­n Ä‘Ã£ há»§y" : "thá»§ thÃ nh tháº¥t báº¡i") : "";

          + `${dong("QuÃ¢n Ä‘á»‹ch", p.dich + (p.xe ? ` (xe ${p.xe})` : ""))}${dong("Chá»§ soÃ¡i", p.soaiRa ? p.soai + "/" + p.soaiTong : "sau " + mmss(p.cs - now))}${p.me ? dong("Báº¡n háº¡", p.me.giet) : ""}`;
    const vach = dt && p.diemMax ? `<span class="vach">${Array.from({ length: p.diemMax }, (_, i) => `<u class="${i < p.diem ? (p.diem <= 6 ? "do" : "") : "mat"}"></u>`).join("")}</span>` : "";
    const co = `<span class="co">${Array.from({ length: p.tqTong || 3 }, (_, i) => `<u class="${i < p.tq ? "" : "mat"}"></u>`).join("")}</span>`;
    const h3 = !dt ? "" : p.ket ? `<div class="d1"><b>Phong Há»a LiÃªn ThÃ nh</b> <i class="${p.ket === "thang" ? "" : "du"}">${kq}</i></div><div class="d2"><em>vá» Biá»‡n Kinh sau ${mmss(p.ra - now)}</em></div>`

  veGia(v, p, goc) {

    if (typeof v === "boolean") return `<label class="qch-bat"><input type="checkbox" data-ch-p='${P(p)}'${v ? " checked" : ""}> báº­t</label>${mac}`;
    if (typeof v === "string") return (v.length > 60 ? `<textarea data-ch-p='${P(p)}' rows="2">${esc(v)}</textarea>` : `<input data-ch-p='${P(p)}' value="${esc(v)}">`) + (laMa(v) ? `<small class="qch-doc">${esc(tenMon(v))}</small>` : "") + mac; // mÃ£ mÃ³n: tÃªn mÃ³n bÃªn cáº¡nh
    if (v === null || v === undefined) return `<i class="dv-note">trá»‘ng</i>`;
    if (Array.isArray(v)) {
      const mau = Array.isArray(goc) ? goc : v, D = this.dinh(p[0]) || {}, r = rel(p), so = tim(D.so, r), bg = tim(D.bang, r);

      const docO = (c) => (laMa(c) ? tenMon(c) : Array.isArray(c) ? `1 trong ${c.map((z) => (laMa(z) ? tenMon(z) : TU[z] || z)).join(" / ")}` : typeof c === "string" && TU[c] ? TU[c] : typeof c === "number" ? so2(c) : String(c));
      const macDong = mac && Array.isArray(goc) ? `<small class="qch-mac dong">máº·c Ä‘á»‹nh: ${esc(goc.length ? goc.map((x) => (Array.isArray(x) ? x.map(docO).join(" ") : docO(x))).join(" Â· ") : "trá»‘ng")}</small>` : mac;

      if (so && (v.length ? v : mau).every((x) => typeof x === "number")) return this.veSoNhan(v, p, so) + macDong;

      const ds = v.length ? v : mau;
      if (ds.length && ds.every(oBang) && (bg || !ds.every(maMon))) return this.veBang(v, p, bg) + macDong;
      // danh sÃ¡ch mÃ³n: "máº·c Ä‘á»‹nh" ghi tÃªn mÃ³n dá»… Ä‘á»c, 1 dÃ²ng riÃªng dÆ°á»›i danh sÃ¡ch (anh 14/11: chá»¯ JSON máº·c Ä‘á»‹nh Ä‘Ã¨ lÃªn cÃ¡c dÃ²ng mÃ³n)
      if (v.length ? v.every(maMon) : mau.length && mau.every(maMon)) return this.veMon(v, p) + (mac && Array.isArray(goc) ? `<small class="qch-mac dong">máº·c Ä‘á»‹nh: ${esc(goc.length ? goc.map((x) => `${x[1] ?? 1} ${tenMon(x[0])}`).join(" Â· ") : "trá»‘ng")}</small>` : mac);

  }
  veDT(o, p, goc) {

    const phuc = (x) => laDT(x) || (Array.isArray(x) && !(x.length && x.every(prim)));
    // nhÃ£n tiáº¿ng Viá»‡t (qt-qua.js â€” anh 17/11 láº§n 2); khÃ³a chÆ°a cÃ³ nhÃ£n giá»¯ tÃªn gá»‘c
    return `<div class="qch-nhom">${ghi}${Object.keys(o).filter((k) => k[0] !== "_").map((k) => { const L = this.nhanK([...p, k]); return `<div class="qch-o${phuc(o[k]) ?   // danh sÃ¡ch [mÃ£ mÃ³n, sá»‘, (sá»‘ thá»© 3 â€” tá»‰ lá»‡â€¦)]: tÃªn mÃ³n + Ã´ sá»‘ + xÃ³a; Ã´ tÃ¬m mÃ³n theo tÃªn Ä‘á»ƒ thÃªm
  veMon(v, p) {

  // Ã´ tÃ¬m mÃ³n theo tÃªn (gá»i mÃ¡y chá»§ nhÆ° Gá»­i quÃ ) + káº¿t quáº£: báº¥m = thÃªm (themMon)

  // danh sÃ¡ch sá»‘ cÃ³ nhÃ£n tá»«ng Ã´ (qt-qua.js so: máº£ng chá»¯ | hÃ m(i) | { nhan, tong })
  veSoNhan(v, p, so) {
    const nh = typeof so === "function" ? so : Array.isArray(so) ? (i) => so[i] ?? `Ã” ${i + 1}` : typeof so.nhan === "function" ? so.nhan : (i) => `Ã” ${i + 1}`;

  }
  // báº£ng: má»—i dÃ²ng 1 máº£ng [loáº¡i / mÃ£ mÃ³n / [mÃ£â€¦], sá»‘, tá»‰ lá»‡â€¦] (qt-qua.js bang: tiÃªu Ä‘á» cá»™t; { tong } dÃ²ng Tá»•ng; { ts } trá»ng sá»‘ -> â‰ˆ % tá»«ng dÃ²ng).
  // Ã” sá»‘ sá»­a Ä‘Æ°á»£c; Ã´ mÃ£ mÃ³n hiá»‡n tÃªn mÃ³n; Ã´ loáº¡i hiá»‡n chá»¯ (TU); [mÃ£â€¦] = bá»‘c 1 trong. ThÃªm: nÃºt theo loáº¡i (chÃ©p dÃ²ng cuá»‘i cÃ¹ng loáº¡i), tÃ¬m mÃ³n (chÃ©p dÃ²ng cÃ³ mÃ³n, thay mÃ³n)

      } else { this.xinLuc = 0; this.xin(); }
    }
    for (const [u, ten] of p.dan || []) this.dan.set(u, ten);
    if (p.hp) this.hpSv = new Map(p.hp); else for (const [u, v] of p.hd || []) this.hpSv.set(u, v); // hd: chá»‰ con Ä‘á»•i mÃ¡u
    this.p = p;
    this.gui = this.gui.filter((g) => g.s > (p.ack | 0));
    this.dat();
  },

  // pháº§n mÃ¬nh Ä‘Ã£ Ä‘Ã¡nh con uid mÃ  mÃ¡y chá»§ chÆ°a nháº­n (chÆ°a gá»­i + Ä‘ang trÃªn Ä‘Æ°á»ng)
  doan(uid) { let v = (this.cho.get(uid) || 0) + (this.choPt.get(uid) || 0); for (const g of this.gui) v += (g.d.get(uid) || 0) + ((g.dp && g.dp.get(uid)) || 0); return v; },

  // sinh / bá» / háº¡ / Ä‘áº·t mÃ¡u cÃ¡c con trÃªn World theo tráº¡ng thÃ¡i mÃ¡y chá»§
  dat() {
    const w = this.w; if (!this.laTo() || !this.spec) return;
    const t = performance.now(), hp = this.hpSv, co = new Set(this.spec.q.map((s) => s[0]));
    this.datLuc = t;
    for (const [u, m] of this.mob) {
      if (co.has(u)) continue;
      if (m.alive) { m.alive = false; const i = w.mobs.indexOf(m); if (i >= 0) w.mobs.splice(i, 1); if (w.player.target === m) w.player.target = null; } // mÃ¡y chá»§ Ä‘Ã£ dá»n
      this.mob.delete(u); this.qb.delete(u);
    }
    for (const s of this.spec.q) {
      const uid = s[0], mau = hp.get(uid) ?? 0;
      let m = this.mob.get(uid);
      // Ä‘Ã£ háº¡ trÆ°á»›c á»Ÿ mÃ¡y mÃ¬nh (Ä‘Ã²n háº¡ â€” trung) mÃ  mÃ¡y chá»§ váº«n bÃ¡o cÃ²n sá»‘ng quÃ¡ DOAN_MS (khÃ´ng nháº­n Ä‘Ã²n Ä‘Ã³): bá» báº£n Ä‘Ã£ háº¡, dá»±ng láº¡i con Ä‘Ã³
      if (m && !m.alive && m.duDoan && !m.daDem && mau > 0 && t - m.duDoan > DOAN_MS) { const i = w.mobs.indexOf(m); if (i >= 0) w.mobs.splice(i, 1); this.mob.delete(uid); m = null; }
      if (!m) {
        if (mau <= 0) continue;
        const v = this.vt.get(uid);
        const sb = s[9] && w.P.satThu ? w.P.satThu.boss[s[9]] : null; // Boss SÃ¡t thá»§ chung
        m = w.spawnMob(!!s[7], 0, { id: s[1], lvl: s[2], series: s[3], at: v ? [v.x, v.y] : [s[5], s[6]], ...(s[8] ? { ta: true } : {}), ...(sb ? { sat: s[9], ten: `BOSS SÃ¡t thá»§ - ${sb.ten}` } : {}) });
        if (!m) continue;
        Object.assign(m, { vaDoi: uid, qc: 1, hpMax: s[4], hp: Math.min(s[4], mau), home: [s[5], s[6]], mucTen: null, muc: null, aggro: false });
        const D = sb && w.satDat ? w.satDat[sb.cap] : null;
        if (D) { m.dmg = D.st.slice(); m.ar = D.ar; m.def = D.def; }
        // quÃ¡i báº£n chung máº¡nh hÆ¡n (anh 03/11 "máº¡nh hÆ¡n 50% bao gá»“m cáº£ táº§n suáº¥t táº¥n cÃ´ng" â€” luáº­t quaiChung.manh; mÃ¡u mÃ¡y chá»§ Ä‘Ã£ nhÃ¢n): sÃ¡t thÆ°Æ¡ng Ã—
        // satThuong; tocDanh: vung Ä‘Ã²n + chá» giá»¯a 2 Ä‘Ã²n Ã· tocDanh, hÃ¬nh vung Ä‘Ã²n cháº¡y nhanh theo (world.js updateMob / mobDrawOpt, ngoai). Boss
        // SÃ¡t thá»§ chung giá»¯ chá»‰ sá»‘ boss nhiá»‡m vá»¥ (khÃ´ng nhÃ¢n)
        const K = sb ? null : w.qcManh;
        if (K) { m.dmg = m.dmg.map((v) => Math.round(v * (+K.satThuong || 1))); m.tocDanh = Math.max(1, +K.tocDanh || 1); }
        this.mob.set(uid, m);
      }
      if (mau <= 0) { if (!m.daDem) { m.daDem = 1; this.chet(m); } continue; }
      if (!m.alive) continue;
      m.hp = Math.max(1, Math.min(m.hpMax, mau - this.doan(uid)));
    }
  },
  // mÃ¡y chá»§ bÃ¡o cháº¿t: háº¡ trÃªn World náº¿u chÆ°a háº¡ trÆ°á»›c (khÃ´ng bÃ¡o giáº¿t â€” thÆ°á»Ÿng mÃ¡y chá»§ phÃ¡t); chá»§ bÃ£i Ä‘áº¿m Ä‘á»ƒ ra thá»§ lÄ©nh / tinh anh nhÆ° World.kill
  chet(m) {
    const w = this.w; if (m.alive) w.kill(m);
    if (!this.laChu() || m.sat) return; // Boss SÃ¡t thá»§ chung: khÃ´ng Ä‘áº¿m ra thá»§ lÄ©nh / tinh anh
    this.demBoss = m.boss ? 0 : this.demBoss + 1; this.demTA = m.ta ? 0 : this.demTA + 1;
    const cb = w.canBang || {}, Z = w.zone, song = [...this.mob.values()].filter((x) => x.alive), ds = [];
